ops.summary: Fits the gray values with a second-order polynomial surface by least squares. Corresponds to HALCON's ``fit_surface_second_order`` (computes gray-value moments and fits a second-order surface).

ops.name: hx_full_domain
ops.summary: Expands the image's domain to the full image area. Corresponds to HALCON's ``full_domain`` (expands the domain of an image to its maximum extent).

ops.name: hx_fuzzy_measure_pairs
ops.summary: Count edge pairs along the central horizontal profile (the rising boundary of a bright bar to its falling boundary) — 1-D metrology.

ops.name: hx_gabor
ops.summary: A Gabor filter (orientation theta = a*pi, frequency freq = 0.08 + 0.35b). Returns the magnitude of the response.

ops.name: hx_gen_bandfilter
ops.summary: An ideal band-filter image (an annulus in frequency, centre radius a and width b). A different operator from gen_bandpass.

ops.name: hx_gen_bandpass
ops.summary: An ideal band-pass (an annular mask in the frequency domain, inner radius a and bandwidth b).

ops.name: hx_gen_checker_region
ops.summary: Generates a checkerboard-pattern region. Corresponds to HALCON's ``gen_checker_region`` (generates a checker region).

ops.name: hx_gen_circle
ops.summary: Generates a circular region. Corresponds to HALCON's ``gen_circle`` (generates a circle).

ops.name: hx_gen_circle_sector
ops.summary: A circular-sector region (start angle b*2pi, sweep a*2pi).

ops.name: hx_gen_derivative_filter
ops.summary: A derivative filter in the frequency domain. ``a`` is the order of the derivative, ``b`` its direction.

ops.name: hx_gen_disc_se
ops.summary: Generate a disc structuring element as a region (radius a).

ops.name: hx_gen_ellipse
ops.summary: Generates an axis-aligned elliptical region. Corresponds to HALCON's ``gen_ellipse`` (generates an ellipse) -- a fixed-orientation approximation, since the original also takes a rotation-angle parameter.

ops.name: hx_gen_ellipse_sector
ops.summary: Generates an elliptical sector region. Corresponds to HALCON's ``gen_ellipse_sector`` (generates an ellipse sector).

ops.name: hx_gen_empty_region
ops.summary: Generates an empty region (all pixels 0). Corresponds to HALCON's ``gen_empty_region`` (generates an empty region).

ops.name: hx_gen_grid_region
ops.summary: Generates a grid-line region. A simplified version corresponding to the grid pattern of HALCON's ``gen_grid_region`` (generates a region from lines or pixels).

ops.name: hx_gen_highpass
ops.summary: Generates the frequency mask of an ideal high-pass filter. Corresponds to HALCON's ``gen_highpass`` (generates an ideal high-pass filter).

ops.name: hx_gen_image_proto
ops.summary: Generate a constant grey image the same size as the input (value a).

ops.name: hx_gen_lowpass
ops.summary: An ideal low-pass filter image (a central disc mask in the frequency domain, cut-off radius a).

ops.name: hx_gen_parallel_contour
ops.summary: Generate the parallel (normal-offset) contour of each contour (the signed distance comes from (a−0.5)).

ops.name: hx_gen_rectangle2
ops.summary: Generates a rectangular region at an arbitrary angle. Corresponds to HALCON's ``gen_rectangle2`` (generates a rectangle of arbitrary orientation).

ops.name: hx_get_domain
ops.summary: Get the image's domain as a region (the whole frame by default).

ops.name: hx_histo_to_thresh
ops.summary: Threshold from the valley of the histogram and binarise (valley detection, not Otsu's variance criterion — a different op).

ops.name: hx_lowlands
ops.summary: Detect the basins of the grey values (flat local minima): the region of pixels equal to their neighbourhood minimum.

ops.name: hx_mean_shape
ops.summary: Mean smoothing with an arbitrary mask (a disc). The radius r varies with a (a different op from the rectangular mean).

ops.name: hx_moments_any_xld
ops.summary: The second central moment (the spread) of all contour points, as a normalised feature.

ops.name: hx_move_region
ops.summary: Translate a region (dy = a, dx = b, taken as offsets around zero).

ops.name: hx_nonmax_dir
ops.summary: Non-maximum suppression along the gradient direction (Canny's NMS stage). Thins edges to one pixel.

ops.name: hx_opening
ops.summary: Opens a region with a disk structuring element (erosion followed by dilation). Corresponds to HALCON's ``opening`` (opens a region).

ops.name: hx_plane_deviation
ops.summary: The deviation of the grey values from their first-order plane fit, |v − plane| (flatness / defect inspection).

ops.name: hx_plateaus_center
ops.summary: Detect the centres of the grey-value plateaus (gradient ≈ 0): the centroid pixel of each flat component, as a marker region.

ops.name: hx_polar_trans_inv
ops.summary: Take the contour points as (radius, angle) and transform them back to Cartesian coordinates (the inverse of polar_trans).

ops.name: hx_radial_distort_contour
ops.summary: Apply radial distortion r' = r(1 + k r^2) to a contour (k from (a−0.5): barrel or pincushion).

ops.name: hx_rectangle1_domain
ops.summary: Shrink the image's domain to an axis-aligned rectangle (the central a×b fraction), as a region.

ops.name: hx_region_to_label
ops.summary: Turn the connected components of the region thresholded at a into a label image (normalised).

ops.name: hx_region_to_mean
ops.summary: Paint each connected region with its mean grey value (image -> image). Foreground/background split at threshold a, then labelled.

ops.name: hx_regress_contours
ops.summary: Fit a regression line to each contour and return the mean residual (the deviation from the line; a feature). Small = line-like.

ops.name: hx_select_xld_point
ops.summary: Keep only the contours whose bounding box contains the query point (normalised a, b) — a filter.

ops.name: hx_shade_height_field
ops.summary: Render the height field v with Lambertian shading (normal × light). The light is at azimuth a and elevation b.

ops.name: hx_smallest_circle_xld
ops.summary: The radius of the minimum enclosing circle of all contour points (approximated with the centroid as centre), as a normalised feature.

ops.name: hx_smallest_rect1_xld
ops.summary: The area ratio of the axis-aligned bounding box of all contour points (a feature).

ops.name: hx_smallest_rect2_xld
ops.summary: The area ratio of the minimum-area oriented rectangle (rectangle area / image area; a feature).

ops.name: hx_sort_contours
ops.summary: Sort the contours by relative position (centroid row, then column).

ops.name: hx_split_contours
ops.summary: Split each contour into segments at its dominant points (RDP; the tolerance eps comes from a).

ops.name: hx_split_skeleton_region
ops.summary: Split a one-pixel-wide skeleton at its branch points: remove the junctions (>=3 neighbours) and take the connected components.

ops.name: hx_test_closed_xld
ops.summary: The fraction of contours that are closed (end-point distance below a threshold = closed; a feature).

ops.name: hx_test_region_point
ops.summary: Whether the region contains the point (normalised a = row, b = column): 1/0 (test_region_point).

ops.name: hx_test_region_points
ops.summary: The fraction of a grid of points that lies inside the region (test_region_points).

ops.name: hx_test_self_intersect
ops.summary: The fraction of contours that self-intersect (a feature). Non-adjacent segment pairs are tested.

ops.name: hx_union_adjacent
ops.summary: Greedily join contours whose end points are close (threshold a).

ops.name: hysteresis_threshold
ops.summary: Hysteresis thresholding (``skimage.filters.apply_hysteresis_threshold``). Among pixels exceeding a low threshold (``0.2+0.3*a``), only those connected to pixels exceeding a high threshold (``0.5+0.3*b``) are kept as fore

ops.name: identity
ops.summary: Identity mapping. Mapped to HALCON's ``copy_image`` (Copy an image and allocate new memory for it.), but unlike ``copy_image``, which allocates new memory and duplicates the image, this implementation simply returns the

ops.name: illuminate
ops.summary: Unsharp-mask style local contrast enhancement. By adding back the difference ``x - sm``, where ``sm`` is a Gaussian blur (radius ``3+12*a``) subtracted from the image, onto the original, it lifts local edges and texture

ops.name: image_standardize
ops.summary: Standardises an image and maps signed deviations to an intensity image in ``[0,1]``.

ops.name: img_to_beatcube
ops.summary: Read the bright spots of the image as FMCW radar targets (range = column, velocity = row) and synthesise the complex beat cube (A,C,S).

ops.name: img_to_cimage
ops.summary: Use the image as amplitude and a phase from pixel value plus tilt to build a complex field (H,W) complex128.

ops.name: img_to_counts
ops.summary: Read one row (or column) of the image as expected photon numbers and draw a Poisson-sampled 1-D count series.

ops.name: img_to_keypoints
ops.summary: Turn the local maxima of the image into image-plane points (u, v) = (col, row), shape (N,2).

ops.name: img_to_lightfield
ops.summary: Split the image into a foreground and a background layer and build a 4-D light field (V,U,H,W) with parallax.

ops.name: img_to_matrix
ops.summary: Treat the (H,W) image as an H×W numeric matrix (sort ``matrix``) — a pure cast.

ops.name: img_to_monogenic
ops.summary: Build the single-scale monogenic signal of the image (a quaternion field (H,W,4), sort ``qimage``).

ops.name: img_to_points
ops.summary: Read the image as a height field and turn it into an (x, y, z) point cloud (N,3).

ops.name: img_to_projection_profile
ops.summary: Turns the **projection profile**, obtained by collapsing the image along 1 direction, into a 1-D signal — a basic quantity of page-layout analysis.

ops.name: img_to_rgb
ops.summary: Give a gray image a hue and saturation, producing an (H,W,3) RGB image (sort ``rgbimage``).

ops.name: img_to_signal
ops.summary: Take the intensity profile of one row (or column) of the image as a 1-D signal.

ops.name: img_to_video
ops.summary: Turn the image into a T-frame video (T,H,W) translated at constant speed.

ops.name: img_to_volume
ops.summary: Extrude the image as a height field into a (D,H,W) volume (z first).

ops.name: intensity

ops.name: intersection
ops.summary: Intersection of 2 regions (pixels in both). Corresponds to HALCON's ``intersection``. Inputs are binarized with ``> 0.5``. ``a``, ``b`` are unused.

ops.name: invert
ops.summary: Tone inversion (negative-positive reversal). Equivalent to HALCON's ``invert_image`` (Invert an image.).

ops.name: invert_image
ops.summary: Inverts the tones via ``1.0 - x`` (negative/positive inversion). This corresponds directly to HALCON's ``invert_image`` (Invert an image.) - an operation that is exactly equivalent, not an approximation.

ops.name: invert_region
ops.summary: Complement of a region (foreground/background inversion). Equivalent to HALCON's ``complement`` (Return the complement of a region.).

ops.name: it_bit_lshift
ops.summary: bit_lshift: 8-bit quantise, left-shift every pixel by round(a*7), mask to 8 bits (wrap-around, as HALCON does), and map back to [0,1]. ``b`` ignored.

ops.name: it_bit_mask
ops.summary: bit_mask: logical AND of the 8-bit image with the constant bit mask round(a*255). ``b`` is ignored.

ops.name: it_bit_rshift
ops.summary: bit_rshift: 8-bit quantise then right-shift every pixel by round(a*7) (an integer divide by 2**shift -> a coarser, darker image). ``b`` ignored.

ops.name: it_change_format

ops.name: it_crop_domain
ops.summary: crop_domain: restrict the image domain to the central ``a`` window, zeroing every pixel outside it (pixels outside the domain are undefined -> 0). ``a`` sets the kept window fraction; ``b`` is ignored.

ops.name: it_crop_part
ops.summary: crop_part: cut out the central a-fraction of the image and resample it back to HxW -- a genuine zoom-in on the centre. ``b`` is ignored.

ops.name: it_crop_rectangle1
ops.summary: crop_rectangle1: cut out the centred rectangle spanning rows/cols [a .. 1-a] and resample it back to HxW. a=0 is (near) identity; larger a zooms further in. ``b`` is ignored.

ops.name: it_full_domain

ops.name: kirsch_amp

ops.name: kirsch_dir

ops.name: kuwahara
ops.summary: Kuwahara filter (1976): edge-preserving smoothing that outputs the mean of whichever of four overlapping windows has the smallest variance.

ops.name: laplace

ops.name: length_xld
ops.summary: The total length obtained by summing the segment lengths (Euclidean distance between adjacent points) of all contours. When there are multiple contours, they are all added together. Equivalent to HALCON's ``length_xld``

ops.name: lines_gauss

ops.name: local_bimodality
ops.summary: **Local bimodality** (bimodality coefficient). Without choosing even 1 threshold, returns only "does this place split into 2 values?" as a 0-to-1 map.

ops.name: local_max

ops.name: local_thickness
ops.summary: Returns each foreground pixel filled with "the **diameter of the largest circle** that can cover it" (local thickness).

ops.name: log
ops.summary: Laplacian of Gaussian (LoG) filter. Equivalent to HALCON's ``laplace_of_gauss`` (LoG-Operator (Laplace of Gaussian).).

ops.name: log_image

ops.name: lowpass
ops.summary: Low-pass filter via FFT (blurring). No corresponding single HALCON op has been specified.

ops.name: m1_measure_pairs
ops.summary: Counts rising-to-falling edge pairs (the two ends of a bright object) along a caliper line through the centre (equivalent to HALCON ``measure_pairs``: extracts pairs of straight edges perpendicular to a rectangle/arc).

ops.name: m1_measure_pos
ops.summary: Extracts sub-pixel edge positions along a caliper line through the centre (equivalent to HALCON ``measure_pos``: detects straight edges perpendicular to a rectangle/arc).

ops.name: matrix_to_img
ops.summary: Turns a matrix into **gray levels for viewing** and back into an image — this is not a cast.

ops.name: max_filter

ops.name: max_image
ops.summary: Pixel-wise maximum of 2 images. Corresponds to HALCON's ``max_image``. ``a``, ``b`` are unused. It keeps the brighter one, so it is used for combining multiple exposures or filling holes from missing data.

ops.name: mean_box
ops.summary: Simple averaging (box) filter over a rectangular window. Equivalent to HALCON's ``mean_image`` (Smooth by averaging.).

ops.name: mean_box_wh
ops.summary: Averaging (box) filter with independently chosen width and height. Equivalent to HALCON's ``mean_image`` (Smooth by averaging.).

ops.name: min_image

ops.name: sk_find_boundaries
ops.summary: Region boundary extraction. In a label image (here, a boolean region), returns a boundary mask that is True only at pixels where two different labels (foreground/background) meet.

ops.name: sk_frangi

ops.summary: Gabor filter response magnitude. A classic feature extractor that convolves a sinusoidally modulated Gaussian kernel and responds strongly to texture with a specific spatial frequency and orientation.

ops.name: sk_lbp
ops.summary: LBP (Local Binary Pattern). A texture descriptor robust to illumination changes, built by comparing each pixel to its neighbors on a surrounding circle to form a binary code.

ops.name: sk_li

ops.name: sk_local_maxima

ops.name: sk_medial
ops.summary: Medial axis transform. A different algorithm from sk_skeleton that finds the skeleton by extracting the ridge lines of the distance transform, tending to produce a skeleton that retains distance-from-contour information.

ops.name: sk_median_disk
ops.summary: Median filter with a disk-shaped footprint. Unlike a regular square kernel, this gives isotropic smoothing that is closer to circular.

ops.name: sk_otsu
ops.summary: Global thresholding by Otsu's method (discriminant analysis). Automatically selects the threshold that maximizes between-class variance, splitting the whole image into foreground/background.

ops.name: sk_remove_holes
ops.summary: Small hole filling. Fills only the background holes inside the foreground region whose area is below a threshold -- larger holes (intentional openings) are left as is.

ops.name: sk_scharr
ops.summary: Scharr gradient magnitude. Directly calls skimage's ``filters.scharr``, returning the gradient magnitude obtained by combining the responses of the horizontal and vertical Scharr kernels (3x3).

ops.name: sk_shape_index

ops.summary: Region skeletonization. Thins the foreground region down to lines one pixel wide while preserving its topology (connectivity and number of holes).

ops.name: sk_swirl
ops.summary: Swirl warp. A nonlinear geometric transform that rotates more strongly the closer a point is to the image center -- a distortion effect based on polar coordinate transformation.

ops.name: sk_thin
ops.summary: Morphological thinning. Similar to sk_skeleton in reducing to one-pixel width, but uses a different algorithm based on the hit-or-miss transform, and tends to produce fewer skeleton branches (spurs).

ops.name: sk_tv
ops.summary: Total variation denoising (TV denoising, Chambolle's method). Smooths noise in flat regions while preserving edges - unlike median/Gaussian blur, it is characterized by not easily degrading the sharpness of contours.

ops.name: sk_tv_bregman
ops.summary: Total variation denoising (TV denoising, Split-Bregman method). Uses the same TV-regularization idea as sk_tv but with a different optimization algorithm (Bregman splitting), said to converge faster.

ops.name: sk_wavelet
ops.summary: Denoising via wavelet transform. Decomposes the image into the wavelet domain, discards small coefficients (regarded as noise) using BayesShrink-criterion thresholding, and then applies the inverse transform.

ops.name: sk_yen

ops.name: sp_local_min_sub_pix
ops.summary: Detects local minima of the gray-value surface with sub-pixel accuracy (equivalent to HALCON ``local_min_sub_pix``).

ops.name: sp_lowlands_center
ops.summary: Returns the centroid of minimum 'basins' (flat regions lower than their surroundings) (equivalent to HALCON ``lowlands_center``).

ops.summary: Returns the centroid of connected flat regions (plateaus) of equal (quantised) gray value as a sub-pixel position (equivalent to HALCON ``plateaus``).

ops.name: sp_saddle_points_sub_pix
ops.summary: Detects saddle points of the gray-value surface with sub-pixel accuracy (equivalent to HALCON ``saddle_points_sub_pix``).

ops.name: tan_image
ops.summary: A pointwise transform that takes the tangent of pixel values. Corresponds to HALCON's ``tan_image`` (computes the tangent of an image), but is an approximation with a different normalization convention.

ops.name: tb_abs_funct_1d
ops.summary: Absolute value of the y-values (HALCON ``abs_funct_1d``).

ops.summary: Amplitude envelope via the analytic (Hilbert) signal — the shape of a knock / impact / acoustic-emission burst.

ops.summary: The y-value at (fractional) position *x* (HALCON ``get_y_value_funct_1d``).

ops.summary: Insert points where the local spacing exceeds *spacing*, on the local PCA plane (``points``).

ops.name: tb_pc_poisson_disk
ops.summary: Blue-noise thinning: keep points greedily so that no two are closer than *radius* (``points``).

ops.name: tb_plane_sdf
ops.summary: Exact signed distance field of a half-space. ``fast`` is an optional path with measured relative difference 1.5e-10 at 1e6; the default is ``exact``.

ops.name: tb_plane_segmentation
ops.summary: Iteratively extracts up to `max_planes` planes via repeated RANSAC (remaining residual points are -1).

ops.name: tb_points_render
ops.summary: Render an (N, 3) point cloud to an RGB image (H, W, 3): anti-aliased splats, depth-sorted, deterministic.

ops.name: tb_points_to_voxel
ops.summary: Point cloud (N,3) → density voxel (size³). Splatted via scatter_add, with optional Gaussian smoothing.

ops.name: tb_points_zyx_to_keypoints_uv
ops.summary: Point cloud ``(N,3) = (z, y, x)`` -> image coordinates ``(N,2) = (u, v)``.

ops.name: tb_project
ops.summary: Projects 3D points (n,3) onto 2D (n,2) via a camera (rvec,t,K) (perspective division).

ops.name: tb_project_cylindrical
ops.summary: Project onto a cylindrical range image (`z_bins`, `h_res`). Azimuth (columns) x z (rows), pixel value = horizontal radius ρ = hypot(x, y).

ops.name: tb_project_points
ops.summary: 3D point cloud (N,3) → image coordinates (u,v) and depth. Pinhole model (the forward direction of depth_to_points).

ops.name: tb_project_spherical
ops.summary: Project onto a spherical range image for rotating LiDAR (`v_res`, `h_res`). Empty cells = 0, nearest point wins (minimum range).

ops.name: tb_qft2
ops.summary: Quaternion (hypercomplex) 2-D Fourier transform. → (H, W, 4) centred spectrum.

ops.name: tb_quantize
ops.summary: Scalar quantiser with the error model stated, plus optional dither.

ops.name: tb_quat_color_filter
ops.summary: Keep or remove one colour direction, exactly. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: tb_quat_color_rotate
ops.summary: Rotate every pixel's colour about an RGB axis: ``q x conj(q)``. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: tb_quat_conjugate_image
ops.summary: Per-pixel quaternion conjugate ``(w, -x, -y, -z)``. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: tb_quat_norm
ops.summary: Per-pixel quaternion modulus ``|q| = sqrt(w^2+x^2+y^2+z^2)``. → (H, W).

ops.name: tb_quat_normalize_image
ops.summary: Per-pixel normalisation to unit modulus. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: tb_quaternion_to_rgb
ops.summary: Vector part of a quaternion image, as linear RGB. → (H, W, 3).

ops.name: tb_radius_outlier_removal
ops.summary: Removes points whose number of neighbors within radius `radius` is below `min_neighbors` (removal of isolated points).

ops.name: tb_random_dropout
ops.summary: Randomly removes a ``ratio`` fraction of the points and returns ``(kept, kept_idx)`` (mimicking missing data).

ops.name: tb_random_rotation
ops.summary: Applies a random rotation and returns ``(rotated, R)`` (mimicking viewpoint change).

ops.name: tb_random_scale
ops.summary: Applies a uniform scale ``s ~ U(lo, hi)`` about the origin and returns ``(scaled, s)``.

ops.name: tb_range_doppler_map
ops.summary: The 2-D FFT of a beat cube -> a ``(n_doppler, n_range)`` magnitude map.

ops.name: tb_reflect_points
ops.summary: Mirror a point cloud across a plane (point `plane_point`, normal `plane_normal`). -> (N,3).

ops.name: tb_reflection_symmetry_score
ops.summary: Reflection symmetry score = chamfer(mirrored, original) / median nearest-neighbor spacing (smaller = more symmetric, scale-invariant). -> float.

ops.name: tb_region_growing
ops.summary: Grows regions by normal similarity, assigning the same label to connected smooth regions (a variant without a curvature gate).

ops.name: tb_render_point_depth
ops.summary: Point cloud → depth image (z-buffer; each pixel gets the depth of its nearest point). A sample for observation synthesis / appearance inspection.

ops.name: tb_resample
ops.summary: Resample a signal to *new_rate* (Fourier method).

ops.name: tb_resample_uniform
ops.summary: Resamples to n points at equal intervals of arc length (linear interpolation). → (n,3).

ops.name: tb_rgb_to_quaternion
ops.summary: Embed a colour image as pure quaternions ``0 + R i + G j + B k``. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: tb_rms
ops.summary: RMS level. Scalar for the whole signal, or a framewise array when *frame* is given (a vibration/energy envelope over time).

ops.name: tb_running_gaussian_background
ops.summary: Adaptive single-Gaussian background (the running mean) per frame → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: tb_running_gaussian_foreground
ops.summary: Adaptive single-Gaussian foreground masks per frame → 0/1 ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: tb_sample_funct_1d
ops.summary: Every *step*-th sample (HALCON ``sample_funct_1d``).

ops.name: tb_scale_y_funct_1d
ops.summary: Linear map of the y-values, ``mult * y + add`` (HALCON ``scale_y_funct_1d``).

ops.name: tb_sensor_capture
ops.summary: Radiance → real-sensor output (shot noise, read noise, saturation, quantisation).

ops.name: tb_shape_perturb
ops.summary: Applies 1 **known** deformation to a shape. → ``(N, 3)``.

ops.name: tb_smooth_funct_1d_gauss
ops.summary: Gaussian smoothing of a 1-D function (HALCON ``smooth_funct_1d_gauss``).

ops.name: tb_smooth_funct_1d_mean
ops.summary: Iterated moving-average smoothing (HALCON ``smooth_funct_1d_mean``).

ops.name: tb_spad_deadtime_apply
ops.summary: Distort a true photon rate by the detector's dead time (counts lost).

ops.name: tb_spad_deadtime_correct
ops.summary: Recover the true photon rate from a dead-time-distorted measured rate.

ops.name: tb_spectrogram
ops.summary: STFT magnitude spectrogram -> ``(freqs, times, S)`` with ``S`` shape ``(n_freqs, n_frames)``. Hann-windowed; *hop* defaults to ``win//2``.

ops.name: tb_specular_coefficient_map
ops.summary: The scalar interface (specular) coefficient of the dichromatic model. → (H, W).

ops.name: tb_specular_diffuse_split
ops.summary: Split a linear-RGB image into its diffuse (body) and specular (interface) parts. → (diffuse, specular), both (H, W, 3).

ops.name: tb_specular_free_transform
ops.summary: Project out the illuminant direction: the part of the image a highlight cannot touch. → (H, W, 3).

ops.name: tb_sphere_sdf
ops.summary: Signed distance field of a sphere: ``|p - center| - R`` (negative inside, positive outside).

ops.name: tb_stat_correlation
ops.summary: Pearson correlation matrix of ``(N, D)`` observations → ``(D, D)``.

ops.name: tb_stat_covariance
ops.summary: Sample covariance matrix of ``(N, D)`` observations → ``(D, D)``.

ops.name: tb_stat_zscore
ops.summary: Standardise a 1-D sample: ``(x - mean) / std`` (population ``ddof=0``).

ops.name: tb_statistical_outlier_removal
ops.summary: Removes points whose k-nearest-neighbor mean distance is a global outlier (statistical outlier removal).

ops.name: tb_superquadric_residual
ops.summary: Gross-Boult volume-corrected residual: mean( (sqrt(a1 a2 a3)(F^eps1 - 1))^2 ).

ops.name: tb_synthesize_silhouette
ops.summary: Projects a 3-D point cloud onto a (K,R,t) camera and returns a silhouette (H,W bool) where occupied pixels are True.

ops.name: tb_tcspc_background_subtract
ops.summary: Remove the ambient-light / dark-count floor from an arrival-time histogram.

ops.name: tb_tcspc_coates_correct
ops.summary: Undo TCSPC pile-up exactly (Coates's estimator) — the early-photon bias.

ops.name: tb_tcspc_irf_convolve
ops.summary: Blur an arrival-time histogram by the instrument response (timing jitter).

ops.name: tb_temporal_band_power
ops.summary: Per-pixel mean-square power inside a temporal band -> ``(H, W)`` map.

ops.name: tb_temporal_bandpass
ops.summary: Ideal temporal band-pass of every pixel's time series -> ``(T, H, W)``.

ops.name: tb_temporal_bilateral
ops.summary: Causal temporal bilateral denoise per frame → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: tb_temporal_median_window
ops.summary: Causal per-pixel median over the last *window* frames → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: tb_three_frame_difference
ops.summary: Collins three-frame-difference motion mask per frame → 0/1 ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: tb_torus_sdf
ops.summary: **Exact** signed distance field of a torus (doughnut) (negative inside, positive outside).

ops.name: tb_viewport_from_equirect
ops.summary: Extract a rectilinear viewer viewport from an equirectangular image.

ops.name: tb_voxel_grid_downsample
ops.summary: Thins the point cloud with a grid of cell size `voxel_size`, aggregating each cell into a single centroid point (deterministic).

ops.name: tb_weighting_response
ops.summary: The A / C / Z frequency-weighting curve, in dB, at the given frequencies.

ops.name: tb_wetness
ops.summary: Base colour of a wet surface. **Diffuse darkens** (and specular increases).

ops.name: tb_zero_crossing_rate
ops.summary: Fraction of adjacent samples that change sign — a cheap pitch/noisiness cue.

ops.name: tb_zero_crossings_funct_1d
ops.summary: Indices where the function changes sign (HALCON ``zero_crossings_funct_1d``).

ops.name: texture_laws

ops.name: tf_census_transform
ops.summary: census_transform: the 3x3 non-parametric census bit-signature image.

ops.name: tf_gradient_domain_reintegrate
ops.summary: gradient_domain_reintegrate: threshold the gradient, then Poisson-reintegrate.

ops.name: tf_log_polar
ops.summary: log_polar: resample the image on a log-polar grid about its centre.

ops.name: tf_phase_congruency
ops.summary: phase_congruency: a simplified monogenic phase-congruency feature map.

ops.name: tf_radon_sinogram
ops.summary: radon_sinogram: the Radon transform rendered as an HxW sinogram image.

ops.name: tf_rank_transform
ops.summary: rank_transform: the local rank of each pixel among its neighbours.

ops.name: tf_steerable_filter
ops.summary: steerable_filter: oriented first-derivative-of-Gaussian response.

ops.name: thinning

ops.name: thinning_golay
ops.summary: Thins a region. The implementation uses skimage's ``thin`` (Guo-Hall-type iterative thinning), repeated until the region is completely 1 pixel wide; a and b are unused.

ops.name: thinning_seq
ops.summary: Thins a region. The implementation is identical to thinning_golay (skimage's ``thin``, Guo-Hall-type thinning iterated to convergence); a and b are unused.

ops.name: threshold
ops.summary: Global thresholding. Equivalent to HALCON's ``threshold`` (Segment an image using global threshold.).

ops.name: threshold_sub_pix
ops.summary: Level-crossing (contour-line) extraction using the marching squares method (``skimage.measure.find_contours``). Returns, as a contour with sub-pixel accuracy, the positions crossing a specified gray level (``0.2+0.5*a``)

ops.name: tm_backproject_unfiltered

ops.name: tm_radon_forward

ops.name: tm_sart_reconstruct

ops.name: tm_sinogram_denoise
ops.summary: Smooth the input sinogram along the ANGLE direction (rows). Neighbouring projection angles view almost the same object, so angle-direction smoothing is a genuine consistency prior that suppresses per-angle detector noise

ops.name: tophat
ops.summary: White top-hat (original image minus opening). Equivalent to HALCON's ``gray_tophat`` (Perform a gray value top hat transformation on an image.).

ops.name: total_length
ops.summary: A feature that returns the total arc length of all XLD contours. Equivalent to HALCON's ``length_xld`` (Length of contours or polygons.).

ops.name: trans_from_rgb
ops.summary: Converts an RGB image to another color space (HSV / Lab / YUV / XYZ). Corresponds to HALCON's ``trans_from_rgb`` (conversion from RGB color space to an arbitrary color space).

ops.name: trans_to_rgb
ops.summary: The inverse transform from a color space back to RGB. Claimed to correspond to HALCON's ``trans_to_rgb`` (conversion from an arbitrary color space to RGB color space), but **the implementation only supports the single di

ops.name: transpose_region
ops.summary: Transposes a region (binary mask) (``x.T``, a reflection about the diagonal = swapping rows and columns). The category is geometry, but the in/out type is ``region``. Implemented as a kind of geometric transform via ``_s

ops.name: trimmed_mean
ops.summary: Approximates a trimmed mean by returning the average of the 20th- and 80th-percentile filter results. This yields a value close to an average with outlier influence (from the low and high extremes) removed, but note that

ops.name: union2
ops.summary: Union of 2 regions (pixels in either). Corresponds to HALCON's ``union2``. Inputs are binarized with ``> 0.5``. ``a``, ``b`` are unused.

ops.name: unsharp
ops.summary: Unsharp mask. ★It clips to [0,1] on the way out (2026-09-02).

ops.name: var_threshold
ops.summary: Sauvola's local adaptive binarization (``skimage.filters.threshold_sauvola``, window size ``2*int(a*6)+3``). Since the threshold is determined using both the local mean and local standard deviation, it is more robust to

ops.name: vol_count
ops.summary: A feature that returns the number of connected components (blobs) in a 3D volume. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_dilate
ops.summary: Grayscale dilation of a 3D volume. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_dilation_ball
ops.summary: 3D binary dilation using a spherical structuring element. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_erode
ops.summary: Grayscale erosion of a 3D volume. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_erosion_ball
ops.summary: 3D binary erosion using a spherical structuring element. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_gaussian
ops.summary: Isotropic Gaussian smoothing of a 3D volume. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_median
ops.summary: Median filter for a 3D volume. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_mip
ops.summary: Collapses a 3D volume into a 2D image via Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP). No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_opening_ball
ops.summary: 3D binary opening using a spherical structuring element (erosion followed by dilation with the same sphere). No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_reg_dilate
ops.summary: Dilation of a 3D binary region (dilation of a region volume). No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_reg_erode
ops.summary: Erosion of a 3D binary region (erosion of a region volume). No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_slice
ops.summary: Extracts a single 2D slice from a 3D volume. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: vol_threshold
ops.summary: Global thresholding of a 3D volume (the 3D counterpart of the 2-D ``_threshold``). No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

ops.name: watersheds

ops.name: xcv2_fast_count
ops.summary: Number of keypoints detected by the FAST corner detector (``cv2.FastFeatureDetector``).

ops.name: xcv2_hitmiss
ops.summary: Detects the cross pattern 'center is background, up/down/left/right are foreground' using the hit-or-miss transform (``cv2.MORPH_HITMISS``).

ops.name: xcv2_lap_var
ops.summary: Focus (blur) metric based on Laplacian variance (variance of ``cv2.Laplacian``).

ops.name: xcv2_meanshift
ops.summary: Smooths color/brightness region by region using mean-shift filtering (``cv2.pyrMeanShiftFiltering``).

ops.name: xcv2_warp_logpolar
ops.summary: Maps the image onto a (radius, angle) plane using the log-polar transform.

ops.name: xcv3_agast_count
ops.summary: AGAST keypoint count (OpenCV AGAST detector, an adaptive tree-structure version of FAST). Returns the number of detected keypoints as a feature.

ops.name: xcv3_brisk_count
ops.summary: BRISK keypoint count (OpenCV BRISK detector). Returns as a feature the number of keypoints detected by this fast, binary-descriptor-based keypoint detector.

ops.name: xcv3_denoise_tvl1

ops.name: xcv3_inpaint_ns
ops.summary: Inpainting by the Navier-Stokes method (OpenCV ``cv2.inpaint``, ``INPAINT_NS``). A restoration algorithm that fills in missing regions by propagating information from surrounding pixels using fluid-dynamics principles.

ops.name: xcv3_lsd_count

ops.name: xcv3_sift_count

ops.name: xcv_detail_enhance
ops.summary: OpenCV's detailEnhance (detail enhancement).

ops.name: xcv_edge_preserving
ops.summary: OpenCV's edgePreservingFilter (edge-preserving smoothing; ``flags=1`` = RECURS_FILTER = recursive filter method).

ops.name: xcv_grabcut
ops.summary: Automatic foreground/background separation via GrabCut (iterative graph cut).

ops.name: xcv_inpaint
ops.summary: Inpainting that estimates and fills in missing regions.

ops.name: xcv_orb_count
ops.summary: Number of keypoints detected by OpenCV's ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF).

ops.name: xcv_pencil_sketch
ops.summary: OpenCV's pencilSketch (pencil-drawing-style rendering).

ops.name: xcv_stylization
ops.summary: OpenCV's stylization (painterly/cartoon-like non-photorealistic rendering).

ops.name: xcv_watershed_markers
ops.summary: Boundary extraction via marker-controlled watershed.

ops.name: xdog
ops.summary: XDoG (extended difference of Gaussians; Winnemoller, Kyprianidis and Olsen 2012): line-art / ink-drawing stylisation.

ops.name: xg_area_center
ops.summary: Polygon area of the contour(s) via the shoelace formula (summed abs).

ops.name: xg_clip_contours
ops.summary: Drop contours whose polyline length is below a * max-length (a in [0,1]).

ops.name: xg_crop_contours
ops.summary: Keep only contour points inside the central a-fraction window of the shape.

ops.name: xg_eccentricity
ops.summary: Eccentricity sqrt(1 - lambda_min/lambda_max) from the point covariance.

ops.name: xg_elliptic_axis
ops.summary: Major/minor axis ratio sqrt(lambda_max/lambda_min) of the point set.

ops.name: xg_gen_polygons
ops.summary: Douglas-Peucker polyline simplification; eps = a * contour bbox diagonal.

ops.name: xg_height_width_ratio
ops.summary: Axis-aligned bounding-box height/width ratio of the point set.

ops.name: xg_moments
ops.summary: Normalized 2nd central moment of the point set: mu20 + mu02.

ops.name: xg_orientation
ops.summary: Principal-axis orientation in degrees, folded to [0,180) and /180 scaled.

ops.name: xg_regress_contours
ops.summary: Total-least-squares line residual RMS = sqrt(minor covariance eigenvalue).

ops.name: xkor_bilateral
ops.summary: Bilateral filter (edge-preserving smoothing). Calls ``kornia.filters.bilateral_blur`` with a 5x5 kernel.

ops.name: xkor_canny
ops.summary: Edge (binary region) detection by the Canny method. Calls ``kornia.filters.canny`` and adopts the binary edge map (``edges``) among its return values (the gradient-magnitude side is discarded).

ops.name: xkor_clahe
ops.summary: CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization). Calls ``kornia.enhance.equalize_clahe``.

ops.name: xkor_dog

ops.name: xkor_gaussian
ops.summary: Gaussian blur (kornia's GPU-native implementation). Applies ``kornia.filters.gaussian_blur2d`` on a torch tensor with a window sized to sigma.

ops.name: xkor_gftt
ops.summary: GFTT (Good Features To Track, Shi-Tomasi) corner response. Calls ``kornia.feature.gftt_response`` with default parameters, takes the absolute value, and normalizes by the maximum absolute value.

ops.name: xkor_laplacian
ops.summary: Edge/blob response via the Laplacian (2nd derivative). Calls ``kornia.filters.laplacian``, takes the absolute value, then normalizes by the maximum absolute value.

ops.name: xkor_median
ops.summary: Median filter. Calls ``kornia.filters.median_blur``.

ops.name: xkor_motion_blur
ops.summary: Motion blur. Calls ``kornia.filters.motion_blur``.

ops.name: xkor_unsharp
ops.summary: Unsharp mask (sharpening). Calls ``kornia.filters.unsharp_mask`` with a window sized to sigma (``v + (v - G_σ * v)``, strength fixed at 1).

ops.name: xmh_bernsen
ops.summary: Bernsen local thresholding (``mahotas.thresholding.bernsen``). Uses the midpoint between the local maximum and minimum brightness as the local threshold, falling back to a global threshold only in low-contrast regions.

ops.name: xmh_bwperim
ops.summary: Region contour extraction (``mahotas.bwperim``). From a binary region, produces a 1-pixel-wide contour keeping only the boundary pixels that touch the background.

ops.name: xmh_daubechies

ops.name: xmh_regmin
ops.summary: Regional minima extraction (``mahotas.regmin``). On a Gaussian-smoothed image, marks the locally darkest valleys as regions. A typical preprocessing step for generating markers for watershed segmentation.

ops.name: xmh_zernike

ops.name: xpil_autocontrast
ops.summary: Auto-contrast (clips both ends of the histogram and stretches it to the full range). Calls ``PIL.ImageOps.autocontrast``.

ops.name: xpil_contour

ops.name: xpil_contrast
ops.summary: Contrast adjustment (linear stretch centered on the image's mean brightness). Calls ``PIL.ImageEnhance.Contrast``.

ops.name: xpil_detail
ops.summary: Pillow's detail enhancement filter. Raises contrast of fine detail using the fixed kernel of ``PIL.ImageFilter.DETAIL`` (close to sharpening, but with coefficients that emphasize texture over edges).

ops.name: xpil_edge_enhance
ops.summary: Pillow's edge enhancement filter (strong version). Raises contrast near edges using the fixed kernel of ``PIL.ImageFilter.EDGE_ENHANCE_MORE`` (a stronger version than ``EDGE_ENHANCE``).

ops.name: xpil_emboss
ops.summary: Pillow's emboss filter. Applies the fixed 3x3 kernel of ``PIL.ImageFilter.EMBOSS`` (a classic NPR filter that detects diagonal gradients and drops flat areas to mid-gray).

ops.name: xpil_find_edges
ops.summary: Pillow's edge detection filter. Enhances edges using the fixed kernel (Laplacian-type) of ``PIL.ImageFilter.FIND_EDGES``.

ops.name: xpil_mode_filter
ops.summary: Mode filter. Uses ``PIL.ImageFilter.ModeFilter`` to replace each pixel with the most frequent value within the window (differs from a median filter in taking the mode rather than the median).

ops.summary: Posterization (reducing the number of tonal levels). Calls ``PIL.ImageOps.posterize`` to reduce the number of colors by cutting the effective bit depth of each channel.

ops.name: xpil_smooth_more
ops.summary: Pillow's smoothing filter (strong version). Blurs more strongly than ``SMOOTH`` using the fixed kernel of ``PIL.ImageFilter.SMOOTH_MORE``.

ops.name: xpil_solarize
ops.summary: Solarization (the mid-tone inversion effect from film development). Calls ``PIL.ImageOps.solarize`` to invert pixel values that exceed a threshold.

ops.name: xpil_unsharp_mask
ops.summary: Pillow's unsharp mask. Calls ``PIL.ImageFilter.UnsharpMask`` (a CPU implementation corresponding to the kornia version ``xkor_unsharp``).

ops.summary: h-maxima transform (removes local maxima with a height less than h). Calls ``skimage.morphology.h_maxima``.

ops.summary: Wiener deconvolution (deblurring using a known point spread function). Calls ``skimage.restoration.wiener``.

ops.name: xsk_blob_dog

ops.name: xsk_blob_doh
ops.summary: Number of detected blobs (speckle-like structures) (detected using one of LoG/DoG/DoH).

ops.summary: Number of detected blobs (speckle-like structures) (detected using one of LoG/DoG/DoH).

ops.name: xsk_flood
ops.summary: Region extraction by flood fill.

ops.name: xsk_hessian_eig
ops.summary: Blob/ridge strength based on the largest eigenvalue (absolute value) of the Hessian matrix.

ops.name: xsk_inpaint
ops.summary: Restoration (inpainting) that estimates and fills missing regions.

ops.name: xsk_orb_count
ops.summary: Number of ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF) keypoints detected.

ops.name: xsk_random_walker
ops.summary: Graph-based region segmentation using the random walker method.

ops.name: xsp_chamfer_dist

ops.name: xsp_cspline_smooth
ops.summary: Cubic spline smoothing filter (``scipy.signal.cspline2d``).

ops.name: xsp_dct
ops.summary: Displays the power spectrum of the 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT-II, ortho normalization) with logarithmic compression.

ops.name: xsp_dct_denoise
ops.summary: Noise removal via hard-thresholding of DCT coefficients (a DCT-based version of wavelet shrinkage).

ops.name: xsp_dct_lowpass
ops.summary: A low-pass filter that keeps only a low-frequency square block of DCT coefficients before applying the inverse transform.

ops.name: xsp_detrend_flatten
ops.summary: A flattening filter that removes the linear trend (slope) of the whole image separately along the vertical and horizontal directions, then normalizes.

ops.name: xsp_gauss_grad_mag
ops.summary: Edge detection via the Gaussian gradient magnitude (``scipy.ndimage.gaussian_gradient_magnitude``).

ops.name: xsp_hilbert_env
ops.summary: Extracts the amplitude envelope of the analytic signal (Hilbert transform) along the row direction.

ops.name: xsp_morph_laplace
ops.summary: Edge enhancement via the morphological Laplacian (``scipy.ndimage.morphological_laplace``).

ops.name: xsp_savgol
ops.summary: Smooths the image with a Savitzky-Golay filter (applied one-dimensionally, column direction first then row direction).

ops.name: xsp_wiener
ops.summary: Suppresses noise using the Wiener adaptive filter (``scipy.signal.wiener``).

ops.name: a3_distribution
ops.summary: The distribution of the angle three random points (A, B, C) subtend at vertex B (Osada 2002's A3).

ops.name: aabb
ops.summary: Axis-aligned bounding box. Returns ``(min (3,), max (3,))``.

ops.name: absolute_phase
ops.summary: Turn a wrapped phase into an absolute one by fixing its fringe order from a coarse but absolute phase estimate.

ops.name: alpha_shape_boundary
ops.summary: The **indices of the boundary points** by alpha shapes (point set → boundary points).

ops.summary: The **triangulated surface mesh** by alpha shapes (point set → (vertices, faces)).

ops.summary: Render the mesh into an AO map image ``(H, W)`` in [0,1].

ops.name: angle_3points
ops.summary: The angle at three points (vertex b, in degrees). ∠ABC.

ops.name: angle_between_planes
ops.summary: The dihedral angle between two planes (normals n1, n2; in degrees).

ops.name: angle_line_plane
ops.summary: The angle between a line (direction d) and a plane (normal n), in degrees.

ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): the three axes of the object coordinates (the input side of ``pose``) as a gnomon, projected from ``origin``.

ops.name: annotate3d_bbox
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): the 12 edges of the axis-aligned 3-D box ``((xmin,ymin,zmin),(xmax,ymax,zmax))``, projected.

ops.name: annotate3d_label
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): text with a leader line attached to a 3-D anchor.

ops.name: annotate3d_measure
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): the distance between two 3-D points (in mesh units), shown as a projected line and a value.

ops.name: annotate3d_project
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): pixel coordinates, forward distance and in-frame/occluded verdicts for 3-D points (:func:`project_anchors`).

ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): a bar of ``length`` in mesh units, laid on the surface and projected.

ops.name: decimate_qem
ops.summary: Quadric-error-metric edge-collapse decimation toward *target_faces*.

ops.summary: Decode a phase-shift image series in one go: wrapped → unwrap → (subtract the reference to get) height.
