ops.summary: Shortest distance between **finite line segments** and the pair of their closest points. → ``(distance, cp, cq)``.

ops.name: dlt_pose
ops.summary: Recover the camera pose from 3-D–2-D correspondences by DLT (K known). → (R (3,3), t (3,)). At least six points are needed.

ops.name: edge_alias_energy
ops.summary: The aliasing (jaggy) energy of edges = the RMS of the Laplacian (smaller is smoother).

ops.name: edge_points
ops.summary: Turn an edge mask into an (M,3) coordinate point set (for downstream chamfer / Hough).

ops.name: edt_jfa
ops.summary: 3-D Euclidean distance transform via the Jump Flooding Algorithm (GPU). Each voxel → the distance to its nearest seed.

ops.name: edt_jfa_vector
ops.summary: Displacement from each voxel to the nearest seed ``(3, D, H, W)`` (``flow_dense``, dz, dy, dx [voxel]), computed with **GPU JFA**.

ops.name: elastic_deform
ops.summary: Elastic deformation by a smooth random displacement field (correlation length ``sigma``, RMS amplitude ``alpha``).

ops.name: esdf
ops.summary: Occupancy grid → Euclidean signed distance field (ESDF): outside = + to the nearest occupied, inside = − to the nearest free.

ops.name: essential_8point
ops.summary: The essential matrix E directly from correspondences and K. → E (3,3).

ops.name: estimate_alpha
ops.summary: Return a recommended alpha from the point set's scale (based on the median nearest-neighbour distance).

ops.name: estimate_covariances
ops.summary: Plane-to-plane covariances (N,3,3): each point's local covariance with its eigenvalues replaced by (ε,1,1).

ops.name: estimate_flow
ops.summary: The 3-D displacement vector field (N, 3) from each point of pts0 to its nearest neighbour in pts1 (nearest-neighbour flow).

ops.name: estimate_normals
ops.summary: Point-cloud normals made consistently outward (pointing away from the neighbourhood centroid). → (N,3).

ops.name: estimate_oriented_normals
ops.summary: PCA normal estimation combined with Hoppe's global orientation. → oriented unit normals (N,3).

ops.name: estimate_point_normals
ops.summary: Point set (N,3) → unit normals (the smallest eigenvector of the local k-neighbourhood covariance = PCA).

ops.name: euclidean_cluster
ops.summary: Distance clustering by the connected components of the proximity graph at radius tol (−1 = noise).

ops.name: eval_bspline_curve
ops.summary: Evaluate the curve tck at n evenly spaced points over the parameter u∈[0,1] (splev).

ops.name: eval_bspline_surface
ops.summary: Evaluate a fitted surface tck (bisplev). Two modes: scattered points (the default) or a grid.

ops.name: eval_poly_surface
ops.summary: Evaluate the model at (x,y) → z (returned in the shape of x).

ops.name: extent_signature
ops.summary: The ratios of the extent along the PCA principal axes (the eigenvectors of the covariance).

ops.name: extract_surface_points
ops.summary: Extract surface points (M,3) from the TSDF zero crossing (no marching cubes needed; linear interpolation).

ops.name: face_areas
ops.summary: **Area of each face** of a triangle mesh → ``(M,)``.

ops.name: face_normals
ops.summary: The **face normals** of a triangle mesh (the unit normal of each triangle). → (M,3).

ops.name: farthest_point_sampling
ops.summary: Farthest-point sampling by geodesic distance (uniform thinning). → the selected index sequence (n,) int.

ops.name: fill_holes
ops.summary: Interpolate invalid pixels (holes) from their valid neighbours by harmonic (Laplace) relaxation. → float64 (H,W).

ops.name: filter_by_volume
ops.summary: Return a bool mask with the connected components below min_voxels removed.

ops.name: find_surface_pose
ops.summary: Find where a known object (model point cloud) lies in a scene point cloud by point-pair-feature (PPF) voting and ICP (``pose``).

ops.name: fit_box3
ops.summary: Oriented box fit by PCA (fast, noise-tolerant; the same construction as ``pcseg.obb``).

ops.name: fit_bspline_curve
ops.summary: Fit a B-spline curve to an ordered point sequence (M,D) (splprep, parametric).

ops.name: fit_bspline_surface
ops.summary: Least-squares fit a bicubic (default) B-spline surface to scattered (x, y, z) (bisplrep).

ops.name: fit_circle3
ops.summary: 3-D circle fit to ``(depth, row, col)`` points: fit the supporting plane, then a circle.

ops.name: fit_circle_3d
ops.summary: Point set → a 3-D circle (fit the plane, then fit a 2-D circle within it). Returns (center, radius, normal).

ops.name: fit_cone
ops.summary: Fit an infinite cone to a point set and return ``{apex, axis, half_angle, residual}``.

ops.name: fit_ellipsoid
ops.summary: Algebraically fit a triaxial ellipsoid of arbitrary pose to a point set and return ``{center, axes, radii, residual}``.

ops.name: fit_line3
ops.summary: Total-least-squares 3-D line fit to ``(depth, row, col)`` points.

ops.name: fit_line_3d
ops.summary: Point set → a least-squares line (through the centroid, direction = the largest principal axis). Returns (point, direction).

ops.name: fit_plane3
ops.summary: Least-squares 3-D plane fit to ``(depth, row, col)`` points.

ops.name: fit_plane_3d
ops.summary: Point set → a least-squares plane (through the centroid, normal = the smallest principal axis, plus the RMS residual). Returns (point, normal, resid).

ops.name: fit_poly_surface
ops.summary: Scattered (x,y,z) → a polynomial least-squares z=f(x,y). Returns model (coef/powers/degree/rms/pv).

ops.name: fit_rigid
ops.summary: Estimate the rigid transform (R, t) from correspondences by the closed-form Kabsch algorithm (pts_from[i] -> pts_to[i]).

ops.name: fit_sphere3
ops.summary: Algebraic (Kåsa) least-squares sphere fit to ``(depth, row, col)`` points:

ops.name: fit_sphere_3d
ops.summary: Point set → a least-squares sphere (algebraic fit). Returns (center, radius). For pipe and ball metrology.

ops.name: fit_spline_curve
ops.summary: Smooth and resample an ordered 3-D point sequence with a B-spline. → (M,3). For smoothing noisy trajectories and edges.

ops.name: fit_superquadric
ops.summary: Fit a superquadric to a point set with least_squares and return dict{a, eps, R, t, residual}.

ops.name: fit_surface_principal_axes
ops.summary: Rotate a slanted warped surface to PCA axes, then fit polynomial z'=f(x',y').

ops.name: fit_torus
ops.summary: Fit a torus to a point set and return ``{center, axis, R, r, residual}``.

ops.name: fit_zernike
ops.summary: A disc image → Zernike coefficients (the **polar-coordinate surface fit** of optics and wavefront metrology). Returns {(n,m): coef}.

ops.name: frenet_frame
ops.summary: The Frenet frame (tangent T, principal normal N, binormal B) at each point. → (T, N, B), each (Npts,3) unit vectors.

ops.name: fresnel_reflectance
ops.summary: Fresnel reflectance (unpolarised = the s/p average). The share that splits into reflection and transmission at a transparent interface.

ops.name: fringe_ftp_phase
ops.summary: Recover height/phase from one fringe image using Takeda Fourier-transform profilometry.

ops.name: fscore
ops.summary: F-score @ tau = the harmonic mean of precision and recall. → (f, precision, recall). The standard reconstruction metric.

ops.name: fundamental_8point
ops.summary: Estimate the fundamental matrix F by the normalised eight-point algorithm (rank 2 enforced). → F (3,3). At least eight points are needed.

ops.name: fuse
ops.summary: Fuse a depth series into one TSDF volume with new_volume + integrate. Returns (tsdf, weight).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('fuse', <depth>, Ks=<number>, Rs=<number>, ts=<number>, bounds=<number>, res=<number>, trunc=<number>)

ops.name: fuse_to_voxel
ops.summary: Fuse several structures into one common density voxel volume (TRIZ integration). items=[(data, kind, params_dict), ...].

ops.name: gaussian_curvature
ops.summary: Gaussian curvature K = k1·k2 (invariant to flipping the normal). → (N,).

ops.name: gaussians_to_voxel
ops.summary: 3DGS (anisotropic Gaussians) → a density voxel volume. Each Gaussian is placed at its mean with its opacity, then smoothed by the mean scale.

ops.name: geodesic_distances
ops.summary: Geodesic distances from a source to every point (Dijkstra on the kNN graph). → (N,) float (inf where unreachable).

ops.name: geodesic_dome
ops.summary: Geodesic sphere from a subdivided icosahedron — Euler decides the shape.

ops.name: geodesic_mesh
ops.summary: Geodesic distance from a source to each vertex by Dijkstra on the triangle mesh's edge graph. → (V,) float.

ops.name: gicp
ops.summary: Estimate the rigid transform (R,t) by Generalized-ICP (covariance-weighted Mahalanobis ICP).

ops.name: gradient3d
ops.summary: Smooths a volume with a Gaussian, then takes the 3-D gradient (magnitude and vector) by central differences.

ops.name: graycode_decode
ops.summary: A series of Gray-code bit images → an integer fringe-order map (the absolute order).

ops.name: grid_coords
ops.summary: Build the grid of voxel-centre coordinates for CSG evaluation (the same lattice convention as occupancy).

ops.name: gyroid_isosurface
ops.summary: The gyroid — a triply periodic surface from its nodal approximation.

ops.name: gyroid_solid_mask
ops.summary: The gyroid as a printable **solid**: the shell within ±*thickness* of the level set.

ops.name: harris3d_keypoints
ops.summary: 3-D Harris keypoint detection (the 3-D version of the 2-D Harris corner detector).

ops.name: hausdorff_distance
ops.summary: The symmetric Hausdorff distance = max(max_a min_b, max_b min_a). → scalar. The worst-case discrepancy.

ops.name: hessian3d
ops.summary: The six independent components of the 3-D Hessian (fzz, fyy, fxx, fzy, fzx, fyx). Separable conv3d (second/first order × smoothing).

ops.name: hough_plane_3d
ops.summary: Plane detection (the 3-D lift of the 2-D Hough line). Uses the gradient as the normal and votes into (normal n, distance d) space.

ops.name: hough_sphere_3d
ops.summary: Sphere detection (the 3-D lift of the 2-D Hough circle). Votes the centre = p + sgn·r·n for each radius r.

ops.name: icp_point2plane
ops.summary: Refine the rigid transform to high accuracy with point-to-plane ICP (Gauss-Newton, small-angle approximation).

ops.name: icp_point2point_3d
ops.summary: Refine point sets by point-to-point ICP (Kabsch/SVD).

ops.name: inertia_tensor
ops.summary: The inertia tensor (3,3) of a point set (from the central second moments; uniform mass, total mass 1).

ops.name: inflate
ops.summary: A bool occupancy grid with the obstacles inflated by ``radius`` (in world units) — i.e. ESDF <= radius counts as occupied.

ops.name: inlier_ratio
ops.summary: The inlier ratio of a correspondence set = the fraction with ‖T·source[i] − target[i]‖ < thresh. → [0,1].

ops.name: inner_box3
ops.summary: The largest axis-aligned box fully inscribed in a binary voxel region (the 3-D counterpart of the 2-D ``inner_rectangle1``).

ops.name: inside_outside
ops.summary: The inside-outside function F of a superquadric (surface = 1, inside < 1, outside > 1).

ops.name: integrate
ops.summary: Integrate one depth frame into the volume by projective TSDF (in place, a weighted running average).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('integrate', <sdf>, <depth>, depth=<number>, K=<number>, R=<number>, t=<number>, trunc=<number>)

ops.name: integrate_normals
ops.summary: Normal field → height field z by Frankot-Chellappa integration. → z, HxW (a constant offset is free; referenced to zero mean).

ops.name: intersect_line_plane
ops.summary: Line ∩ plane → a point (None when they are parallel).

ops.name: intersect_planes
ops.summary: Plane ∩ plane → a line (a point on it and a direction). None when they are parallel.

ops.name: iss_keypoints
ops.summary: ISS (Intrinsic Shape Signatures, the 3-D Harris equivalent) keypoint detection.

ops.name: jitter
ops.summary: Add isotropic Gaussian noise ``N(0, sigma)`` to each point (mimicking sensor position noise).

ops.name: joint_bilateral
ops.summary: Joint / cross bilateral: the depth is what gets smoothed, while the range weights come from the differences in the guide. → float64 (H,W).

ops.name: knn_graph
ops.summary: Each point's k nearest-neighbour indices and Euclidean distances (excluding itself). → (idx (N,k) int, dist (N,k) float).

ops.name: label_components
ops.summary: Label a 3-D binary volume into connected components.

ops.name: laplacian_smooth
ops.summary: Triangle-mesh smoothing by the umbrella Laplacian. → (verts, faces).

ops.name: largest_component
ops.summary: Return the bool mask of the largest (most voxels) connected component.

ops.name: line_from_2points
ops.summary: Two points → a line (a point on it and a unit direction). Two coordinates fix the line (2-D and 3-D alike).

ops.name: link_edges
ops.summary: Label an edge mask into connected components with 26-neighbour connectivity.

ops.name: log_zero_crossings
ops.summary: Zero-crossing edges of the Laplacian of Gaussian.

ops.name: m3c2_distance
ops.summary: Measures the difference between point clouds from 2 epochs **along the normal direction** (M3C2). → the 2 values ``(distance, lod)``.

ops.name: matcap_shade
ops.summary: MatCap: map view-space normals onto a lit-sphere texture to transfer a material's look. → ``(H, W[, C])``.

ops.name: match_chamfer_3d
ops.summary: Chamfer / distance-field matching (robust to partial views and occlusion). The voxel × chamfer column.

ops.name: match_curvature_3d
ops.summary: Curvature (shape-index) matching. The voxel × curvature column — the heart of the line-to-surface lift.

ops.name: match_hough_3d
ops.summary: Generalized Hough 3-D (Ballard R-table voting). The voxel × Hough column.

ops.name: match_logpolar_z
ops.summary: Recover **rotation about z and isotropic scale** by log-polar × phase correlation (Fourier-Mellin).

ops.name: match_mip_2d
ops.summary: MIP projection → 2-D NCC (structure = voxel → 2-D, method = NCC, transform = orthogonal MIP).

ops.name: match_pca
ops.summary: PCA pose matching (structure = point cloud × method = principal-axis alignment).

ops.name: match_phase_3d
ops.summary: 3-D phase correlation (FFT). Returns the integer shift (dz, dy, dx) that aligns b to a.

ops.name: match_points_ncc
ops.summary: Point-set to point-set matching (structure = point cloud × method = NCC, transform = splat). Locates the model within the scene.

ops.name: match_sh_descriptor
ops.summary: The cosine similarity between two SH descriptors (rotation-invariant shape matching). Closer to 1 means a more similar shape. The voxel × SH column.

ops.name: match_shape_3d
ops.summary: 3-D shape-based (gradient-orientation) matching = the voxel version of the 2-D shapematch_gpu ("contour matching").

ops.name: mean_curvature
ops.summary: Mean curvature H = (k1+k2)/2. → (N,). A quantity that depends on the orientation.

ops.name: mean_edge_error
ops.summary: The RMS of the edge residuals (how consistent the pose graph is). → scalar.

ops.name: mean_reprojection_error
ops.summary: Returns the RMS reprojection error (pixels) over all observations of a bundle adjustment.

ops.name: medial_axis_points
ops.summary: Turn the medial voxels into a point set with their local radius (= that point's EDT value). Returns (points, radius).

ops.name: medial_match
ops.summary: A coarse matching score between two voxel shapes based on their medial (topology + radius distribution). Returns [0,1].

ops.name: mesh_area
ops.summary: The **surface area** of a triangle mesh (the sum of all triangle areas). → float.

ops.name: mesh_decimate_preserving
ops.summary: Decimation that keeps the detailed regions and reports what it lost (``table``).

ops.name: mesh_detail_map
ops.summary: Per-vertex coarseness and detail of a mesh (``table``).

ops.name: mesh_displace_fbm
ops.summary: Roughen a mesh by displacing vertices along their normals with seeded fBm noise → ``(V, F)``.

ops.name: mesh_displace_spectrum
ops.summary: Displace vertices along their normals with a **stated amplitude spectrum**, band-limited.

ops.name: mesh_edge_lengths
ops.summary: Local edge length of a triangle mesh, per vertex, per face or per unique edge.

ops.name: mesh_edge_stats
ops.summary: Edge-length and face-area percentiles with non-uniformity ratios (``table``).

ops.name: mesh_isotropic_remesh
ops.summary: Incremental isotropic remeshing to a uniform *target_edge* (``mesh``).

ops.name: mesh_lod_chain
ops.summary: Decimation levels with the measured geometric error of each (``table``).

ops.name: mesh_reduction_report
ops.summary: What a reduction (decimation, remesh, voxelisation) lost, in numbers (``table``).

ops.name: mesh_sample_points
ops.summary: Surface samples at a stated spacing — area-weighted random or Poisson-disk (``points``).

ops.name: mesh_scatter_boulders
ops.summary: Scatter partly-buried boulders on a mesh (power-law sizes, seeded) → ``(V, F)``

ops.name: mesh_select_lod
ops.summary: The coarsest LOD level whose geometric error projects below *pixel_tolerance* (``table``).

ops.name: mesh_split_long_edges
ops.summary: Bisect edges longer than *max_edge* until none remains — adaptive refinement (``mesh``).

ops.name: mesh_subdivide
ops.summary: Refine a triangle mesh → ``(V, F)`` by midpoint subdivision or adaptive tessellation.

ops.name: mesh_to_points
ops.summary: Mesh (vertices + faces) → a surface point set (area-weighted uniform sampling). The mesh → point-cloud conversion.

ops.name: mesh_to_voxel
ops.summary: Mesh (vertices + faces) → a density voxel volume. Uniform sampling on the faces → splat (it connects the mesh row to every method).

ops.name: mesh_volume
ops.summary: **Signed volume** enclosed by a closed triangle mesh → float.

ops.name: min_enclosing_sphere
ops.summary: Point set (N,3) → the (approximate) minimum enclosing sphere containing every point, {center(3), radius}.

ops.name: minimal_surface
ops.summary: A classical minimal surface, from its exact parametrisation.

ops.name: minimal_surface_bend
ops.summary: The catenoid-helicoid bend — every member of the family is still minimal.

ops.name: mls_smooth
ops.summary: Drop noise by projecting each point onto a local polynomial surface (Moving Least Squares smoothing).

ops.name: moment_axes
ops.summary: The **centroid and principal axes** (the eigenvectors of the inertia tensor) of a point set or weighted points. The basis of pose estimation.

ops.name: moment_invariants
ops.summary: A shape feature vector invariant to translation, rotation and scale (Sadjadi–Hall style, plus higher-order radial distributions).

ops.name: morph_blackhat3d
ops.summary: 3-D black-hat = closing − vol. Extracts the **dark structures and holes** smaller than the structuring element.

ops.name: morph_close3d
ops.summary: 3-D closing = dilation → erosion. Fills the **dark structures (gaps and cavities)** smaller than the structuring element.

ops.name: morph_dilate3d
ops.summary: 3-D greyscale dilation (the local max over a structuring element of radius r). Expands the bright regions.

ops.name: morph_erode3d
ops.summary: 3-D greyscale erosion (the local min over the structuring element). Shrinks the bright regions. se is the same as for dilate.

ops.name: morph_gradient3d
ops.summary: 3-D morphological gradient = dilation − erosion. Extracts **boundaries and surfaces** (an edge source in place of Sobel).

ops.name: morph_open3d
ops.summary: 3-D opening = erosion → dilation. Removes the **bright structures (spikes and grains)** smaller than the structuring element.

ops.name: morph_tophat3d
ops.summary: 3-D white top-hat = vol − opening. Extracts the **bright structures** smaller than the structuring element (keypoint pre-processing).

ops.name: nearest_neighbor_flow
ops.summary: The 3-D displacement vector field (N, 3) from each point of pts0 to its nearest neighbour in pts1.

ops.name: normal_consistency
ops.summary: Normal agreement over nearest-neighbour correspondences = mean|cos(na, nb)| (orientation ignored). → [0,1]. 1 = perfect agreement.

ops.name: normal_from_reflection
ops.summary: Recover a mirror surface's normal from the incident and reflected rays (deflectometry). n ∝ (r − d), pointing against the incident ray.

ops.name: normals_from_depth
ops.summary: Organized depth → oriented unit normals (H,W,3). The cross product of the 3-D points of neighbouring pixels (using the grid structure, O(HW)).

ops.name: obb
ops.summary: Oriented bounding box by PCA.

ops.name: occlusion_edges
ops.summary: Detect depth discontinuities (the foreground/background boundary = occlusion edges). → bool HxW.

ops.name: occupancy_grid
ops.summary: Point cloud (N,3) → a 3-D occupancy voxel grid, bool (a voxel a point falls into counts as occupied).

ops.name: optimize_pose_graph
ops.summary: Optimise the global poses from relative-pose constraints and loop closures. → dict{poses, rmse, cost}.

ops.name: orient_normals
ops.summary: Orient the normals **globally consistently** by Hoppe's method (MST propagation). → (N,3).

ops.name: pc_density
ops.summary: Local spacing per point and the cloud's non-uniformity (``table``).

ops.name: pc_density_equalize
ops.summary: Fill the sparse regions, then thin the dense ones: uniform spacing (``points``).

ops.name: pc_fill_sparse
ops.summary: Insert points where the local spacing exceeds *spacing*, on the local PCA plane (``points``).

ops.name: pc_lod_chain
ops.summary: Poisson-disk levels at doubling spacings (``table``).

ops.name: pc_poisson_disk
ops.summary: Blue-noise thinning: keep points greedily so that no two are closer than *radius* (``points``).

ops.name: pc_thinning_report
ops.summary: What a point-cloud thinning removed, and whether it touched the rare points (``table``).

ops.name: phong_shade
ops.summary: Shade a normal map with the Phong reflection model (ambient + diffuse + **specular**). → ``(H, W)``.

ops.name: photometric_stereo
ops.summary: Lambertian photometric stereo: recover normals and albedo from N images taken under known light directions. → (normals HxWx3, albedo HxW).

ops.name: plane_from_3points
ops.summary: Three points → a plane (a point on it and a unit normal). Three coordinates fix the plane (2-D and 3-D alike).

ops.name: plane_sdf
ops.summary: Exact signed distance field of a half-space. ``fast`` is an optional path with measured relative difference 1.5e-10 at 1e6; the default is ``exact``.

ops.name: plane_segmentation
ops.summary: Extract up to max_planes planes one after another by iterated RANSAC (leftover points get −1).

ops.name: plane_sweep_depth
ops.summary: Estimate a dense depth map by plane-sweep stereo. → (H,W) depth.

ops.name: pnp_ransac
ops.summary: Outlier-robust PnP (RANSAC plus a final DLT refit). → (R, t, inlier_mask, info).

ops.name: points_render
ops.summary: Render an (N, 3) point cloud to an RGB image (H, W, 3): anti-aliased splats, depth-sorted, deterministic.

ops.name: points_to_voxel
ops.summary: Point set (N,3) → a density voxel volume (size³). Splatted with scatter_add, optionally Gaussian-smoothed.

ops.name: poisson_lite
ops.summary: Point set (N,3) → a surface mesh (vertices(V,3), faces(F,3)) — a lightweight screened-Poisson approximation.

ops.name: polar_unwrap
ops.summary: Unwrap an image's annulus or disc into a (θ × r) rectangle (industrial: inspecting labels, rings and bodies of revolution).

ops.name: pose_error
ops.summary: Pose error = (rotation angle [deg], translation norm). For comparing a registration result against ground truth. → (rot_deg, trans_err).

ops.name: principal_curvatures
ops.summary: The principal curvatures at each point (k1 >= k2). → (k1 (N,), k2 (N,)).

ops.name: principal_moments
ops.summary: The eigenvalues of the inertia tensor (the principal moments, sorted descending, rotation invariant).

ops.name: project
ops.summary: Project 3-D points (n,3) to 2-D (n,2) with a camera (rvec, t, K) (perspective division).

ops.name: project_cylindrical
ops.summary: Project into a cylindrical range image (z_bins, h_res). Azimuth (columns) × z (rows); the pixel is the horizontal radius ρ = hypot(x,y).

ops.name: project_points
ops.summary: 3-D point set (N,3) → image coordinates (u,v) and depth. Pinhole (the forward direction of depth_to_points).

ops.name: project_spherical
ops.summary: Project into the spherical range image of a spinning LiDAR (v_res, h_res). Empty cells are 0; nearer points win (minimum range).

ops.name: query_distance
ops.summary: The ESDF values (M,) at arbitrary world coordinates (M,3) (``mode`` = 'trilinear' interpolation or 'nearest').

ops.name: radius_outlier_removal
ops.summary: Remove the points with fewer than min_neighbors neighbours within radius (isolated-point removal).

ops.name: random_dropout
ops.summary: Randomly remove a ``ratio`` fraction of the points and return ``(kept, kept_idx)`` (mimicking dropout).

ops.name: random_rotation
ops.summary: Apply a random rotation and return ``(rotated, R)`` (mimicking a change of viewpoint).

ops.name: random_scale
ops.summary: Apply a uniform scale ``s ~ U(lo, hi)`` about the origin and return ``(scaled, s)``.

ops.name: ransac_cylinder
ops.summary: Outlier-robust RANSAC cylinder fitting (point normals are required).

ops.name: ransac_line
ops.summary: Outlier-robust RANSAC line fitting.

ops.name: ransac_plane
ops.summary: Outlier-robust RANSAC plane fitting.

ops.name: ransac_sphere
ops.summary: Fits a sphere (centre and radius) to a point cloud with outlier-robust RANSAC.

ops.name: recover_pose
ops.summary: Recover the relative pose (R,t) and the 3-D structure from correspondences and K (disambiguated by cheirality). → (R, t_unit, points3d).

ops.name: refine_lm
ops.summary: Sub-voxel refinement of the translation (plus isotropic scale / intensity gain) by Levenberg-Marquardt.

ops.name: refine_peak_newton
ops.summary: Refine the integer peak of a score/correlation volume to sub-voxel accuracy by 3-D Newton (iterative optimisation).

ops.name: refine_rotation_z
ops.summary: **Gauss-Newton refinement** of the rotation angle about z (Lucas-Kanade on SSD, one parameter).

ops.name: refine_translation_lk
ops.summary: Sub-voxel refinement of the 3-D translation by inverse-compositional Lucas-Kanade with Gauss-Newton.

ops.name: reflect
ops.summary: Specularly reflect the incident direction d at a surface with normal n. r = d − 2(d·n)n.

ops.name: reflect_points
ops.summary: Mirror a point set in a plane (point plane_point, normal plane_normal). → (N,3).

ops.name: reflection_symmetry_score
ops.summary: Reflection-symmetry score = chamfer(mirrored, original) / the median nearest-neighbour spacing (smaller is more symmetric; scale invariant). → float.

ops.name: refract
ops.summary: Snell refraction (vector form). d = the incident ray (toward the surface), n = the outward normal on the incident side, indices eta1 → eta2.

ops.name: region_growing
ops.summary: Grow regions by normal similarity and give the connected smooth regions the same label (the variant without a curvature gate).

ops.name: region_props
ops.summary: Return the list of region properties of each connected component.

ops.name: register_cpd_rigid
ops.summary: EM-estimate rotation and translation with the rigid version of Coherent Point Drift (CPD).

ops.name: register_cross
ops.summary: Rigid registration between structures of different kinds. Convert both to point clouds → a registrar (fpfh = large rotations / icp = needs a coarse init).

ops.name: register_fpfh
ops.summary: Estimate the rigid alignment (R,t) **without an initial guess** using FPFH descriptors and RANSAC.

ops.name: register_nonrigid
ops.summary: Bring ``src`` toward ``dst`` with non-rigid ICP.

ops.name: register_shot
ops.summary: Sparse feature matching with SHOT descriptors plus RANSAC rigid pose estimation (the whole pipeline).

ops.name: register_spin
ops.summary: Sparse-feature rigid alignment without an initial guess, using Spin Image descriptors and RANSAC.

ops.name: registration_recall
ops.summary: 3DMatch-style per-pair registration success = 1.0 (success) / 0.0 (failure).

ops.name: relative_pose
ops.summary: T_i⁻¹ ∘ T_j = the relative pose i←j. pose_* = [rvec|t] (6,). → (rvec_ij (3,), t_ij (3,)).

ops.name: render_beauty
ops.summary: Render a mesh into one "showcase still 3-D" image with every quality layer combined → RGB ``(size, size, 3)`` float [0,1].

ops.name: render_lambertian
ops.summary: Normals + albedo + light direction → a Lambertian image (inspection-sample generation / GT verification / the forward model of inverse rendering). → HxW.

ops.name: render_point_depth
ops.summary: Point set → a depth image (z-buffer; each pixel takes the depth of its nearest point). For synthesising observations and inspection samples.

ops.name: render_regolith
ops.summary: Render an asteroid's regolith physically based (Hapke + ray-cast shadows at the Sun's angular diameter + zero ambient) → RGB ``(size,size,3)``.

ops.name: render_shaded
ops.summary: Normal map (H,W,3) + light direction → a Lambertian shaded image (appearance-sample generation, the bridge to optics).

ops.name: render_volume_projection
ops.summary: Project a voxel volume to 2-D from an arbitrary viewpoint (mode = xray = attenuation integral / mip = maximum). For DRR (X-ray) and world-model observations.

ops.name: reprojection_error
ops.summary: Reprojection error (RMS pixels). For judging how well a pose fits. → scalar.

ops.name: resample_uniform
ops.summary: Resample to n points evenly spaced along the arc length (linear interpolation). → (n,3).

ops.name: rigid_flow
ops.summary: Estimate the single rigid motion that explains pts0 -> pts1, via nearest-neighbour correspondences and Kabsch (ICP-like).

ops.name: rmse_correspondence
ops.summary: RMSE over known correspondences (same index) = sqrt(mean |a_i − b_i|²). → scalar. For judging the registration residual.

ops.name: rmse_inliers
ops.summary: The RMSE over the inlier correspondences (residual < thresh) and the inlier count. → (rmse, n_inliers).

ops.name: rotation_translation_error
ops.summary: The relative rotation error (geodesic angle [deg], RRE) and relative translation error (RTE) between two 4×4 transforms.

ops.name: sample_surface
ops.summary: Sample the surface points of a superquadric parametrically in (eta, omega).

ops.name: sampson_distance
ops.summary: The Sampson distance of the epipolar constraint (the first-order geometric error, per correspondence). → (N,).

ops.name: scene_flow_lk
ops.summary: Lucas-Kanade scene flow (the 3-D version of 2-D optical flow). A per-voxel motion field d = (dz, dy, dx).

ops.name: sdf_intersect
ops.summary: The intersection of two SDFs, A∩B = the element-wise max(a, b) (inside only where both are inside).

ops.name: sdf_offset
ops.summary: Move an SDF's zero level set by a distance ``r`` along the normal = ``sdf − r`` (r>0 inflates, r<0 shrinks).

ops.name: sdf_smooth_union
ops.summary: A smoothly rounded union (polynomial smooth-min). ``k>0`` rounds the seam with a radius of about k.

ops.name: sdf_subtract
ops.summary: The difference A\B = max(a, −b) (inside A and outside B = inside ``−b``).

ops.name: sdf_to_occupancy
ops.summary: SDF → an occupancy voxel volume (at or below iso = inside = 1). The way back from an SDF to voxels.

ops.name: sdf_union
ops.summary: The union of two SDFs, A∪B = the element-wise min(a, b) (inside if either is negative).

ops.name: segment_rigid_motions
ops.summary: Split two point sets into the rigid bodies whose motion agrees (multi-body segmentation by iterated RANSAC).

ops.name: sh_descriptor
ops.summary: The spherical-harmonic descriptor. Returns the SH band energy ‖f_l(r)‖ of concentric shells as (radius × frequency).

ops.name: shadow_raycast
ops.summary: Cast rays directly at the mesh and return the sunlight visibility (H,W) ∈ [0,1] (no shadow map).

ops.name: shape_distance
ops.summary: The distance between two descriptors. Smaller means a more similar shape.

ops.name: shape_index
ops.summary: Koenderink's shape index s∈[-1,1] (convex sphere +1, cylinder +0.5, saddle 0, concave sphere −1). → (N,).

ops.name: shot_descriptor
ops.summary: The SHOT descriptor (Tombari 2010). It builds a local reference frame at each keypoint and takes a spherical support.

ops.name: signed_distance_field
ops.summary: Occupancy/density voxels → a signed distance field SDF (inside < 0, outside > 0). edt_jfa applied to both sides.

ops.name: skeleton_branches3d
ops.summary: Cut a 3-D skeleton at its junctions into branches (segments). The 3-D version of the 2-D `r2_split_skeleton_lines`.

ops.name: skeleton_endpoints3d
ops.summary: Return the end points of a 3-D skeleton (at most one skeleton voxel in the 26-neighbourhood) as a voxel mask.

ops.name: skeleton_graph3d
ops.summary: Assembles a 3D skeleton into a **graph of nodes (junctions and endpoints) and branches (length and radius)**.

ops.name: skeleton_junctions3d
ops.summary: Return the junctions of a 3-D skeleton (three or more skeleton voxels in the 26-neighbourhood) as a voxel mask.

ops.name: skeleton_prune3d
ops.summary: Prune the whiskers (short branches) of a 3-D skeleton. Endpoint removal repeated length times = branches of length <= length are removed.

ops.name: skeletonize_vol
ops.summary: Thin a 3-D binary voxel volume into a one-voxel-wide skeleton. A wrapper around skimage's Lee (1994) method.

ops.name: smallest_box3
ops.summary: Near-minimum-volume oriented bounding box (the 3-D ``smallest_rectangle2``).

ops.name: smallest_box3_axis
ops.summary: Axis-aligned bounding box (the 3-D ``smallest_rectangle1``).

ops.name: smallest_sphere3
ops.summary: Minimum enclosing sphere of ``(depth, row, col)`` points (Welzl's exact algorithm).

ops.name: smooth_flow
ops.summary: Return a regularised flow (N, 3): the nearest-neighbour flow locally smoothed by neighbourhood averaging.

ops.name: snell_angle
ops.summary: Angle of incidence (deg) → angle of refraction (deg). n1 sinθi = n2 sinθt. Beyond the critical angle it is NaN (total internal reflection).

ops.name: sobel3d
ops.summary: The 3-D gradient (gz, gy, gx). Separable conv3d of the derivative [-1,0,1] × the smoother [1,2,1].

ops.name: sphere_sdf
ops.summary: The signed distance field of a sphere: ``|p − center| − R`` (negative inside, positive outside).

ops.name: statistical_outlier_removal
ops.summary: Remove the points whose mean distance to their k neighbours is a global outlier (statistical outlier removal).

ops.name: superquadric_residual
ops.summary: The Gross-Boult volume-corrected residual mean((sqrt(a1 a2 a3)(F^eps1 − 1))²).

ops.name: supersample_mesh
ops.summary: Render a mesh anti-aliased by SSAA -> a float image ``(H, W)`` (or ``(H, W, C)``).

ops.name: surface_form_error
ops.summary: Height-field grid → the residual from an ideal (polynomial) surface = the form error (flatness deg 1 / sphericity deg 2). → (residual, rms, pv).

ops.name: surface_normals
ops.summary: Height field z (HxW) → unit normals (H,W,3). n ∝ (−dz/dx, −dz/dy, 1). The forward depth → normal conversion.

ops.name: surface_residual
ops.summary: Return the residual statistics between scattered data and a surface tck (the form error = the deviation from the fit).

ops.name: synthesize_fringes
ops.summary: Synthesise an N-step phase-shifted fringe image series from a known height map (for tests and sample generation).

ops.name: synthesize_silhouette
ops.summary: Project a 3-D point set into a (K,R,t) camera and return the silhouette (H,W bool) that is True where pixels are occupied.

ops.name: taubin_smooth
ops.summary: **Non-shrinking** smoothing by the Taubin λ|μ filter. → (verts, faces).

ops.name: terrain_region_mask
ops.summary: Per-face terrain weights (M,) in [0,1]: 0 = smooth regolith "sea", 1 = rough highland.

ops.name: to_points
ops.summary: Any 3-D structure → a point set (the common representation). It funnels all five structures into one entry point.

ops.name: tonemap_aces
ops.summary: Compress HDR into ``[0, 1]`` LDR with the ACES filmic approximation (Narkowicz 2015). → float64.

ops.name: tonemap_reinhard
ops.summary: Compress HDR into ``[0, 1]`` LDR with Reinhard tone mapping. → float64, the same shape as the input.

ops.name: topology_signature
ops.summary: Build a topology descriptor from the 26-neighbourhood degrees of a skeleton. Returns the counts of end points, junctions, ordinary points and isolated points.

ops.name: torus_sdf
ops.summary: **Exact** signed distance field of a torus (doughnut) (negative inside, positive outside).

ops.name: tps_fit
ops.summary: Fit a 3-D thin-plate spline from control-point correspondences.

ops.name: tps_warp
ops.summary: Applies the thin-plate-spline (TPS) deformation fitted by ``tps_fit`` to a point set.

ops.name: triangulate
ops.summary: DLT triangulation: correspondences from two views plus the projection matrices → 3-D points. → (N,3).

ops.name: triangulate_column
ops.summary: Triangulate the depth Z from the "projector column number" of each camera pixel (the final stage of structured light).

ops.name: tsdf_from_depth
ops.summary: Depth map (2.5-D) → a TSDF volume (the standard representation of RGB-D reconstruction). The depth → TSDF conversion.

ops.name: unproject_spherical
ops.summary: Spherical range image → 3-D points (M, 3). Only the cells with range > 0 are back-projected, at their bin-centre angles.

ops.name: unwrap_phase_2d
ops.summary: Unwrap a wrapped phase into a continuous one with skimage.restoration.unwrap_phase.

ops.name: vertex_curvature
ops.summary: The **mean curvature magnitude** at each vertex of a triangle mesh. → (N,).

ops.name: vertex_normals
ops.summary: The **vertex normals** of a triangle mesh (unit normals aggregated with area weights). → (N,3).

ops.name: visual_hull
ops.summary: Return the visual hull of multi-view silhouettes as voxel occupancy (an alias of :func:`carve`).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('visual_hull', <images>, Ks=<number>, Rs=<number>, ts=<number>, bounds=<number>, res=<number>)

ops.name: vol_affine
ops.summary: General affine resampling (``scipy.ndimage.affine_transform``).

ops.name: vol_boundary
ops.summary: Boundary shell of a binary volume (the 3-D ``region_boundary``).

ops.name: vol_boundary_points
ops.summary: Boundary shell as an ``(N, 3)`` point cloud in ``(z, y, x)`` order.

ops.name: vol_bounding_box
ops.summary: Tight axis-aligned bounding box of a mask's foreground, in voxel indices.

ops.name: vol_crop_domain
ops.summary: Crop a volume to the tight bounding box of a domain (HALCON ``crop_domain``).

ops.name: vol_distance_transform
ops.summary: Exact Euclidean distance transform of a binary volume.

ops.name: vol_edge_probe
ops.summary: Sub-sample edges along the probe ``p0 -> p1``.

ops.name: vol_equalize
ops.summary: Histogram equalisation of a volume (HALCON ``equ_histo_image``).

ops.name: vol_euler_number
ops.summary: Euler characteristic of a binary volume, split into its three Betti numbers.

ops.name: vol_fft_bandpass
ops.summary: Gaussian band-pass ``lowpass(high) - lowpass(low)``: keeps structure between two scales.

ops.name: vol_fft_highpass
ops.summary: Gaussian high-pass — the exact complement ``1 - lowpass`` (the two sum to the input).

ops.name: vol_fft_lowpass
ops.summary: Gaussian low-pass: keeps structure coarser than ``1/cutoff`` (voxels, or mm with *spacing*).

ops.name: vol_frangi
ops.summary: 3-D Frangi vesselness — multiscale tubular-structure enhancement.

ops.name: vol_gamma
ops.summary: Gamma (power-law) correction on the volume's own range (HALCON ``pow_image``).

ops.name: vol_gaussian_psf
ops.summary: A normalised (sums to 1) 3-D Gaussian PSF kernel; *sigma* is a scalar or per-axis.

ops.name: vol_gradient_magnitude
ops.summary: 3-D Sobel gradient magnitude ``sqrt(gz**2 + gy**2 + gx**2)``.

ops.name: vol_granulometry
ops.summary: Pore / particle **size distribution** of a binary volume (opening series).

ops.name: vol_hessian_blobness
ops.summary: Blob-like (spherical) response from the Hessian eigenvalues at one *scale*.

ops.name: vol_label
ops.summary: 3-D connected-component labelling with a selectable neighbourhood.

ops.name: vol_local_maxima
ops.summary: 3-D local-maxima (peak) detection.

ops.name: vol_local_std
ops.summary: Unbiased local standard deviation inside a cubic window.

ops.name: vol_local_thickness
ops.summary: Local thickness map: the diameter of the largest ball that covers each voxel.

ops.name: vol_nearest_label
ops.summary: Label volume ``(D, H, W)`` in which each zero voxel is given **the nearest non-zero label** (Voronoi partition of the labels, ``voxel``).

ops.name: vol_nearest_seed_vector
ops.summary: **Displacement vector from each voxel to the nearest seed voxel** ``(3, D, H, W)`` (``flow_dense``, components dz, dy, dx [voxel]).

ops.name: vol_orientation_coherence
ops.summary: How strongly the local structure points **one way** (3-D structure tensor).

ops.name: vol_profile_line
ops.summary: Gray-value profile along the straight probe ``p0 -> p1``.

ops.name: vol_reduce_domain
ops.summary: Restrict a volume to a *domain* mask (HALCON ``reduce_domain``, voxel-wise).

ops.name: vol_region_props
ops.summary: Per-component quantitative descriptors from a label volume.

ops.name: vol_resize
ops.summary: Resample a volume to a new grid (``scipy.ndimage.zoom``, cell semantics).

ops.name: vol_richardson_lucy
ops.summary: Richardson–Lucy deconvolution of a non-negative volume by a known PSF.

ops.name: vol_rle_bbox
ops.summary: Tight bounding box ``(z0, y0, x0, z1, y1, x1)`` (exclusive upper bounds), from the runs.

ops.name: vol_rle_centroid
ops.summary: Centroid ``(z, y, x)`` of the region, computed on the runs (no decode).

ops.name: vol_rle_components
ops.summary: Split a binary volume into per-component ``VolRLE`` regions.

ops.name: vol_rle_decode
ops.summary: Decode a ``VolRLE`` back to a dense ``(D, H, W)`` float64 ``{0, 1}`` volume.

ops.name: vol_rle_difference
ops.summary: Set difference ``a \ b`` on the runs (no decode).

ops.name: vol_rle_encode
ops.summary: Encode a binary volume as x-runs (the 3-D HALCON-region representation).

ops.name: vol_rle_intersect
ops.summary: Intersection of two RLE regions on the runs (no decode).

ops.name: vol_rle_union
ops.summary: Union of two RLE regions, computed on the runs (no decode).

ops.name: vol_rle_volume
ops.summary: Voxel count of the region, computed on the runs (no decode).

ops.name: vol_rotate
ops.summary: Rotate a volume in the plane of an axis pair (``scipy.ndimage.rotate``).

ops.name: vol_sato
ops.summary: 3-D Sato tubeness — the simpler two-eigenvalue line filter.

ops.name: vol_stretch
ops.summary: Percentile contrast stretch to ``[0, 1]`` (robust ``scale_image_max``).

ops.name: vol_tiled_map
ops.summary: Apply a shape-preserving volume operator in overlapping z-slabs to bound peak memory.

ops.name: vol_uncrop
ops.summary: Paste a cropped sub-volume back into the full frame (inverse of :func:`vol_crop_domain`).

ops.name: vol_wall_thickness
ops.summary: Wall thicknesses along the probe ``p0 -> p1`` — the industrial-CT measurement itself.

ops.name: vol_watershed
ops.summary: Marker-controlled 3-D watershed segmentation (**optional — scikit-image**).

ops.name: vol_window_level
ops.summary: CT window/level (HU windowing) — the radiologist's daily linear remap.

ops.name: volume_downsample
ops.summary: Block-pool a ``(D, H, W)`` volume by an integer *factor* per axis (data decimation).

ops.name: voxel_grid_downsample
ops.summary: Thin a point set on a lattice of edge voxel_size, collapsing each cell to one centroid point (deterministic).

ops.name: voxel_iou
ops.summary: The IoU (intersection over union) of voxel occupancy. → [0,1]. Volumetric agreement.

ops.name: voxel_to_mesh
ops.summary: Voxel → mesh (marching cubes, skimage). Returns (verts, faces, normals). The voxel → mesh conversion.

ops.name: voxel_to_mips
ops.summary: 3-D → maximum-intensity projections along the three orthogonal directions. The entry point for applying 2-D methods (e.g. accel's 2-D NCC).

ops.name: warp_by_plane
ops.summary: Inverse-warp img by the homography H. → out[y,x] = img(H·(x,y,1)) (bilinear).

ops.name: wrapped_phase
ops.summary: Compute the wrapped phase (−π, π] from an N-step phase-shifted fringe image series.

ops.name: acceptance_error_budget
ops.summary: Runs the virtual acceptance test with one error source at a time and returns which source decides the verdict (``table``).

ops.name: acceptance_layout
ops.summary: Builds the layout of the test artefacts in the measuring volume (1 probing sphere, ball bar in 7 positions, flat in 7 positions) (``table``).

ops.name: acceptance_scan
ops.summary: Scans one test artefact with a simulated sensor and returns its point cloud ``(N, 3)`` (``points``).

ops.name: acceptance_verdict
ops.summary: Compares the table of evaluation quantities with the MPE (maximum permissible error) and returns pass/fail (``table``).

ops.name: plane_flatness_error
ops.summary: Computes the flatness error F (range of signed distances from the least-squares plane) from the point cloud of a flat (``table``).

ops.name: sphere_probing_error
ops.summary: Computes the probing errors of form PF and size PS from the point cloud of a sphere (``table``).

ops.name: sphere_spacing_error
ops.summary: Computes the sphere-spacing error SD from the point clouds of a ball bar (two spheres) (``table``).

ops.name: virtual_acceptance_test
ops.summary: Scans every artefact position with a simulated sensor and returns PF, PS, SD, F and the verdict (``table``).

ops.name: acoustic_interface_coefficients
ops.summary: Pressure reflection/transmission at every interface of a stack, energy check R^2 + (Z1/Z2) T^2 = 1, and the phase-inversion flag Z2 < Z1 (``table``).

ops.name: acoustic_layer_stack
ops.summary: Layered stack for normal-incidence pulse-echo: couplant, layers (material, thickness in m) from the top, and a half-space substrate (``table``).

ops.name: acoustic_material_table
ops.summary: Built-in acoustic material table: density, longitudinal speed, impedance Z = rho*c, attenuation alpha0*f^n, with a source and a verified flag per entry (``table``).

ops.name: angular_resample
ops.summary: Resample a time record onto the shaft-angle axis (computed order tracking).

ops.name: apply_weighting
ops.summary: Apply an A / C / Z frequency weighting to a signal, zero-phase.

ops.name: bearing_defect_frequencies
ops.summary: The four characteristic rates of a rolling-element bearing, from geometry.

ops.name: cepstrum
ops.summary: The spectrum of the log spectrum — periodic structure *in frequency*.

ops.name: coherence
ops.summary: Ordinary coherence: how much of ``y`` is linearly explained by ``x``.

ops.name: echo_phase_polarity
ops.summary: Classify an interface echo by its phase relative to the front-surface echo: in phase (Z rises), inverted (Z drops) or quadrature (thin-layer, sign not meaningful) (``table``).

ops.name: envelope_spectrum
ops.summary: Band-pass, demodulate, transform — where a bearing defect actually shows.

ops.name: equivalent_level
ops.summary: The energy-equivalent level of a record, in dB relative to ``ref``.

ops.name: gcc_delay
ops.summary: Measures the **time difference of arrival** between 2 channels by generalized cross-correlation (GCC). → ``(delay, table)``.

ops.name: istft
ops.summary: Invert :func:`stft` by weighted overlap-add — exactly.

ops.name: octave_bands
ops.summary: Fractional-octave band centres and edges, from the defining construction.

ops.name: octave_spectrum
ops.summary: Band levels in dB, summed over fractional-octave bands by Parseval.

ops.name: order_spectrum
ops.summary: Amplitude against shaft order — the spectrum a run-up should be read in.

ops.name: percentile_level
ops.summary: Statistical levels: ``L_N`` is the level exceeded ``N`` % of the time.

ops.name: pulse_echo_ascan
ops.summary: RF A-scan of a layered stack for a broadband pulse at normal incidence: transfer-matrix stack response, water path and power-law attenuation (``table``).

ops.name: sam_cscan
ops.summary: Focused-transducer C-scan of a 2-D bond map: per-frequency Gaussian lateral PSF, time gate at an interface, amplitude, phase, in-phase (signed) and signed-peak images (``table``).

ops.name: sam_frequency_tradeoff
ops.summary: Optimal SAM frequency for a void of given size at a buried interface: lateral fill (1 - 2^-(a/w)^2, w = k_res*lambda_w*F#) against two-way attenuation; closed form when all losses go as f^2 (``table``).

ops.name: spectral_kurtosis
ops.summary: Which frequency band is impulsive — i.e. where to demodulate.

ops.name: stft
ops.summary: Short-time Fourier transform that keeps the phase and can be inverted.

ops.name: stft_cola_check
ops.summary: Does this (window, hop) pair satisfy COLA, and how exactly?

ops.name: synthesize_bearing_signal
ops.summary: A resonance amplitude-modulated at a known defect rate — the ground truth.

ops.name: synthesize_speed_ramp
ops.summary: A run-up: components locked to shaft *order*, optionally one fixed in Hz.

ops.name: transfer_function
ops.summary: Estimate ``H(f)`` with ``x`` in and ``y`` out, with its coherence.

ops.name: weighting_response
ops.summary: The A / C / Z frequency-weighting curve, in dB, at the given frequencies.

ops.name: annotate_angle
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): the angle at three points, shown as an arc and a value (with the two arms if wanted).

ops.name: annotate_angle_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): the arc and text position for the (smaller) angle at ``a, vertex, b``.

ops.name: annotate_colorbar
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): a scalar field colour-mapped through a LUT and overlaid, with a colour bar.

ops.name: annotate_dimension
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): a dimension line (arrowheads at both ends, extension lines, value and unit).

ops.name: annotate_dimension_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): the geometry of a dimension line (line, extension lines, text position) in closed form.

ops.name: annotate_figure_grid
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): images plus captions laid out as one figure (constant margins, panel letters).

ops.name: annotate_figure_grid_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): the typesetting of a multi-panel figure (cell, panel and caption-band rectangles) in closed form.

ops.name: annotate_inset
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): a magnified inset in a corner, with lines joining the matching corners.

ops.name: annotate_inset_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): where the magnified inset goes and at what factor, in closed form.

ops.name: annotate_invert
ops.summary: Fills / outlines a region in **inverted color**.

ops.name: annotate_invert_path
ops.summary: Draws a polyline (line) in **inverted color**. Anti-aliased.

ops.name: annotate_invert_visibility
ops.summary: Measures, before drawing, whether the inverted color is **actually visible on that background**.

ops.name: annotate_leader
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): an elbowed leader line plus text (collision-avoiding across several points).

ops.name: annotate_leader_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): the placement of leader lines (elbow, text position, plate rectangle) in closed form.

ops.name: annotate_legend
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): a legend of numbered round markers against their descriptions (the partner of :func:`annotate_markers`).

ops.name: annotate_markers
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): a round marker carrying a number (or a short string) at each point.

ops.name: annotate_orientation
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): an arrow plus text showing a bearing (north) or an orientation.

ops.name: annotate_outline
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): the outline of a mask as an (anti-aliased) closed polyline, with text at the centroid.

ops.name: annotate_outline_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): the boundary loops of a binary mask (closed polygons along pixel edges) and its centroid.

ops.name: annotate_panel_label
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): a panel letter ``(a)``/``(b)`` placed in a corner.

ops.name: annotate_scale_bar
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): a scale bar of a round length placed in a corner (with value and unit).

ops.name: annotate_scale_bar_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): a bar of a **round** length, at most ``target_fraction`` of the image width.

ops.name: annotate_table
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): draws a tab-separated string as a **table** (with a semi-transparent backing panel).

ops.name: annotate_table_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): the column and row positions at which a tab-separated string is placed as a **table**.

ops.name: annotate_text_path
ops.summary: Returns an image (image2d): text set along a polyline (each glyph rotated to the tangent angle).

ops.name: annotate_text_path_layout
ops.summary: Returns a table (dict): the position and slope of each glyph along a polyline (set by arc length).

ops.name: arc
ops.summary: A circular arc. Angles are in degrees, **clockwise from the screen x-axis** (because row points down).

ops.name: arrow
ops.summary: An arrow from ``p0`` to ``p1`` (the shaft via :func:`imagedraw.draw_line`, the head filled).

ops.name: axes_frame
ops.summary: The axis frame (all four sides with ``box=True``, only the left and bottom with False).

ops.name: axes_transform
ops.summary: Build the (**closed-form**) mapping from data coordinates to pixel coordinates.

ops.name: color_bar
ops.summary: The legend of a LUT (a colour bar), labelled with its minimum, maximum and unit.

ops.name: compare_frame
ops.summary: Put two images side by side, with a **divider** and **labels** at the boundary.

ops.name: crosshair
ops.summary: The crossing lines of a cut plane (used in MPR). A ``gap`` keeps the centre clear so it hides nothing.

ops.name: data_to_pixel
ops.summary: Map data points to pixel ``(x, y)`` through an :func:`axes_transform` mapping.

ops.name: ellipse
ops.summary: An ellipse (rotated by ``angle_deg``, filled with ``fill=True``).

ops.name: filled_polygon
ops.summary: A filled polygon (even-odd crossing rule — :mod:`imagedraw` only outlines).

ops.name: grid_lines
ops.summary: Grid lines. If no tick values are given, :func:`nice_ticks` chooses them.

ops.name: label_points
ops.summary: Number or annotate a set of points. **Placed so they do not overlap** (an exception if that is impossible).

ops.name: leader_line
ops.summary: A leader line — from the note's position (``anchor_xy``) to its target (``target_xy``).

ops.name: legend_box
ops.summary: A legend of colours against descriptions. **The box height follows in closed form from the number of entries.**

ops.name: measure_text
ops.summary: Measure text **before** drawing it. If it does not fit, wrap or shrink it; if that fails, raise.

ops.name: nice_ticks
ops.summary: "Round" tick values covering [lo, hi] (1/2/5 × 10^k, **closed form**).

ops.name: overlay_labels
ops.summary: Overlay a colour label map with alpha. **The same label number always gets the same colour.**

ops.name: overlay_mask
ops.summary: Overlay a binary mask with alpha. **Exactly ``a*f + (1-a)*b``.**

ops.name: panel_grid
ops.summary: Lay panels out on a grid, with a label strip under each frame (montage / contact sheet).

ops.name: plot_series
ops.summary: Draw lines, scatter or bars. Takes **data coordinates** (the axes decide the pixels).

ops.name: rounded_rect
ops.summary: A rounded rectangle (filled with ``fill=True``). For backing plates and enclosing boxes.

ops.name: scale_bar
ops.summary: A scale bar in physical length. **The pixel↔physical conversion is taken as an argument** (never assumed).

ops.name: text_box
ops.summary: Text on a backing plate (a translucent panel). **Overflow raises instead of being silently clipped.**

ops.name: ticks
ops.summary: Tick marks and their values. **The positions are closed form** (:func:`data_to_pixel` itself).

ops.name: zoom_inset
ops.summary: A magnified inset — adds a **frame** and a **leader line** to the original figure.

ops.name: center_from_symmetric_edges
ops.summary: Robustly pools the midpoints of symmetric outer-edge pairs and returns a 2-D centre.

ops.name: flat_field_correct
ops.summary: Undoes uneven illumination and sensor-sensitivity variation by a dark-subtracted division. → corrected image.

ops.name: reflection_axis
ops.summary: Estimates the angle and offset of the reflection axis of a line-symmetric 2-D image.

ops.name: register_image
ops.summary: Returns the translation that aligns an inspection image to a reference image, together with quantities that reveal when it does not fit. → dict.

ops.name: rotational_symmetry
ops.summary: Returns the 180-degree point-symmetry centre and the rotational order from polar autocorrelation.

ops.name: symmetry_difference_map
ops.summary: Returns a self-referenced difference map against an estimated reflection axis or rotation centre.

ops.name: symmetry_score
ops.summary: Returns distance from symmetry by normalising the self-referenced difference by image dynamic range.

ops.name: tiled_map
ops.summary: Splits an image into tiles and turns a per-tile quantity into a small map. → dict.

ops.name: align_frames
ops.summary: Register a series of frames onto one reference.

ops.name: aperture_photometry
ops.summary: Photometry with a circular aperture and an annular background (classical CCD photometry).

ops.name: cosmic_ray_reject
ops.summary: Cosmic-ray removal from a single frame (Laplacian sharpness).

ops.name: cosmic_ray_reject_stack
ops.summary: Cosmic-ray removal by comparing frames — **it never hits the same place twice**.

ops.name: drizzle_resample
ops.summary: Drizzle — build a finer grid from several sub-pixel-shifted frames (area-conserving).

ops.name: frame_align
ops.summary: Estimate the 2-D transform ``frame`` → ``reference`` from star correspondences.

ops.name: frame_quality
ops.summary: Score one frame — sharpness, FWHM, background, roundness, and a point for selection.

ops.name: lucky_select
ops.summary: Keep only the top ``keep_fraction`` by quality score — the lucky-imaging cut.

ops.name: noise_sigma
ops.summary: Robustly estimate the background noise sigma (one real number that the stars cannot spoil).

ops.name: psf_fit
ops.summary: Fit a PSF to a star image and get its centre and FWHM.

ops.name: sigma_clip_stack
ops.summary: Combine a series of frames (mean / median / κ-σ clipping), with the accept/reject mask.

ops.name: star_detect
ops.summary: Detect stars and return their ``(row, col)`` centroids.

ops.name: synth_frame_series
ops.summary: Re-shoot the same star field ``n_frames`` times, **each with its own noise and its own dither**.

ops.name: synth_starfield
ops.summary: Synthesise one known star field — **the source of ground truth for this family**.

ops.name: blob_boundaries
ops.summary: Object outlines (1 pixel wide, bool). **The borders between adjacent objects are kept as well**.

ops.name: blob_count_interval
ops.summary: Counts overlapping objects. **When the count cannot be determined, returns an interval instead of a number** (fail-closed).

ops.name: blob_distance
ops.summary: Distance from each foreground pixel **to the nearest background**. The unit is multiples of ``spacing``.

ops.name: blob_features
ops.summary: Returns the shape features of each object as **1 array per key**.

ops.name: blob_label
ops.summary: Splits a binary region into connected components and returns an ``int32`` label image (background 0, objects 1..n).

ops.name: blob_overlay
ops.summary: Overlays the objects in different colors on the original image and returns a float RGB of shape ``(H, W, 3)``.

ops.name: blob_region
ops.summary: Extracts 1 object as a binary region (bool). ``index`` is **1-based**.

ops.name: blob_seeds
ops.summary: h-maxima seeds. **``h`` is an absolute value in the same units as ``distance``**.

ops.name: blob_select
ops.summary: Keeps only the objects whose feature value lies in ``[vmin, vmax]`` (**the numbers are reassigned starting from 1**).

ops.name: blob_select_largest
ops.summary: Keeps only ``count`` objects in order of decreasing area (**the numbers are reassigned in descending order of area**).

ops.name: blob_split
ops.summary: Grows regions from the seeds **in order from the highest points** and splits merged clumps (watershed).

ops.name: cad_defect_to_cad
ops.summary: 2-D defect label image → a **table on the CAD surface** (face ID / area on the face / 3-D centroid).

ops.name: cad_pixel_to_surface
ops.summary: Pixels (N,2) → ``(face_id, barycentric coordinates, 3-D point)`` on the CAD surface (closed form).

ops.name: cad_surface_to_pixel
ops.summary: 3-D points (N,3) → pixels plus **visibility** (occluded, back-facing and out-of-frame are told apart).

ops.name: cad_visible_faces
ops.summary: IDs of the faces **actually visible** from this camera (ascending, ``indices`` sort).

ops.name: calibration_error_map
ops.summary: Compares the true K and distortion with the estimate and returns a map of where in the image the reprojection error (px) and 3-D error (mm) are large (``table``).

ops.name: calibration_next_pose
ops.summary: Recommends, among candidate board poses, the one view that would reduce the calibration uncertainty (mean over the image) the most (``table``).

ops.name: calibration_uncertainty_map
ops.summary: Maps the covariance of the calibration estimate onto the image and returns the predicted uncertainty of every pixel (px, or mm at depth Z) (``table``).

ops.name: caltab_points
ops.summary: Returns the ideal mark coordinates of a calibration plate (world, mm; origin = first mark) as (y, x) (caltab_points).

ops.name: camera_calibration
ops.summary: [Partial] Estimates only the intrinsic matrix K from several views of a planar target by Zhang's method (camera_calibration).

ops.name: camera_calibration_lm
ops.summary: Jointly refines intrinsics, distortion and all poses by LM from Zhang's initial estimate and returns them with their covariance (``table``).

ops.name: checkerboard_points
ops.summary: Returns the board coordinates (x, y) of the inner corners of a checkerboard in row-major order (``keypoints``).

ops.name: contour_to_world_plane_xld
ops.summary: Maps an XLD contour (dict {cs:[Nx2]}) to the world plane (contour_to_world_plane_xld).

ops.name: create_caltab
ops.summary: Creates a calibration-plate description (ideal points, origin at the plate centre) (create_caltab).

ops.name: disp_caltab
ops.summary: Returns the calibration-plate image (for display) (disp_caltab).

ops.name: find_caltab
ops.summary: Detects the centres of the circular marks of a calibration plate in an image (centroids of connected components) (find_caltab).

ops.name: find_checkerboard_corners
ops.summary: Detects the inner corners of a checkerboard image to sub-pixel accuracy and returns them in the board's row-major order (``keypoints``).

ops.name: find_marks_and_pose
ops.summary: Mark detection + pose estimation of the calibration plate (plane homography → pose) (find_marks_and_pose).

ops.name: gen_caltab
ops.summary: Generates an image of a calibration plate with a grid of circular marks (gen_caltab).

ops.name: gen_image_to_world_plane_map
ops.summary: Builds the image → world plane (z=0) mapping table (gen_image_to_world_plane_map).

ops.name: gen_radial_distortion_map
ops.summary: Builds the inverse map (row_map, col_map) of a radial distortion (gen_radial_distortion_map).

ops.name: hand_eye_calibration
ops.summary: Solves AX=XB from a series of motion pairs and estimates X (4x4) (hand_eye_calibration).

ops.name: hom_vector_to_proj_hom_mat2d
ops.summary: Finds a 3x3 projective transform (homography, DLT) from 4 or more correspondences (hom_vector_to_proj_hom_mat2d).

ops.name: image_points_to_world_plane
ops.summary: Back-projects pixels onto the world plane z=0 from the camera intrinsics and extrinsics (image_points_to_world_plane).

ops.name: image_to_world_plane
ops.summary: Maps image points to the world plane (z=0) with a plane homography (image_to_world_plane).

ops.name: project_3d_point
ops.summary: Perspective-projects 3-D points into the camera and returns pixels (row, col) (project_3d_point).

ops.name: project_hom_point_hom_mat3d
ops.summary: Projects homogeneous 3-D points (4,) with a 3x4/4x4 projection matrix and returns pixels (row, col) (project_hom_point_hom_mat3d).

ops.name: project_point_hom_mat3d
ops.summary: Projects 3-D points with a 4x4 or 3x4 projection matrix P=K[R|t] and returns pixels (row, col) (project_point_hom_mat3d).

ops.name: sim_caltab
ops.summary: Simulates the image of a calibration plate projected with a given camera pose (sim_caltab).

ops.name: sim_checkerboard
ops.summary: Synthesizes a checkerboard image with known K, distortion and pose and returns it with the true pixel of every corner (``table``).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('sim_checkerboard', pattern_size=<number>, square_size=<number>, K=<number>, dist=<number>, pose=<number>, image_shape=<number>)

ops.name: stereo_calibration_lm
ops.summary: Jointly refines both cameras' intrinsics and distortion, the board poses and the right camera's relative pose (R, T) by LM (``table``).

ops.name: vector_angle_to_rigid
ops.summary: Finds a 2-D rigid transform from one pair of (point, angle) (vector_angle_to_rigid).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('vector_angle_to_rigid', row1=<number>, col1=<number>, angle1=<number>, row2=<number>, col2=<number>, angle2=<number>)

ops.name: vector_to_rigid
ops.summary: Finds a 2-D rigid transform (rotation + translation, Kabsch) from point correspondences (vector_to_rigid).

ops.name: vector_to_similarity
ops.summary: Finds a 2-D similarity transform (rotation + scale + translation, Umeyama) from point correspondences (vector_to_similarity).

ops.name: increment_sign
ops.summary: Sign of the increment to the neighbouring pixel, ``b = [I(next) >= I(this)]`` (uint8 1 / 0).

ops.name: isc_match
ops.summary: Increment sign correlation (ISC): returns the position where the largest fraction of increment signs agree.

ops.name: ocm_match
ops.summary: Orientation code matching (OCM): returns the position with the smallest mean cyclic code difference.

ops.name: orientation_code
ops.summary: Orientation-code image: gradient direction quantised into ``n_codes`` steps (the OCM coding).

ops.name: radial_reach_filter
ops.summary: Radial Reach Filter (RRF): compares a background and the current image by the signs of the reaches in 8 directions.

ops.name: scc_match
ops.summary: Selective correlation coefficient (SCC): normalised correlation over only the pixels whose increment signs agree.

ops.name: apply_transport
ops.summary: Pull ``target_values`` back onto the source points through a transport plan (the barycentric map).

ops.name: color_transfer
ops.summary: Move the colour cast of ``src`` toward ``ref``.

ops.name: gaussian_transport_map
ops.summary: The linear part ``A`` and means ``m1, m2`` of the Monge map when two point sets are taken to be normal distributions.

ops.name: histogram_match
ops.summary: Match the value distribution of ``src`` to ``ref`` (exact 1-D optimal transport).

ops.name: poisson_blend
ops.summary: Seamless compositing that carries the gradient field (Pérez, Gangnet & Blake, SIGGRAPH 2003).

ops.name: sinkhorn
ops.summary: The entropically regularised optimal-transport plan (Cuturi, NIPS 2013).

ops.name: sinkhorn_distance
ops.summary: The regularised transport cost ``<plan, cost>``. **Not a true distance.**

ops.name: sinkhorn_divergence
ops.summary: The **debiased** Sinkhorn distance (Genevay, Peyré & Cuturi, AISTATS 2018).

ops.name: transport_cost
ops.summary: Total cost of a transport plan, ``<plan, cost>``. The op that **consumes** a plan.

ops.name: transport_plan_1d
ops.summary: The exact 1-D transport plan (north-west corner rule). Returns an ``(n, m)`` mass matrix.

ops.name: wasserstein_1d
ops.summary: The 1-D p-Wasserstein distance. **Exact.**

ops.name: graph_activation_latency
ops.summary: Sequence (n,) of the step (0-based) at which each node first "lit up", as integers. Nodes that never lit up get −1.

ops.name: graph_activity_spread
ops.summary: Time-series table of how far the activity spread: columns step / mean_distance / active_fraction / source_fraction.

ops.name: graph_adjacency_image
ops.summary: Turns the adjacency matrix into an image (n, n) in [0, 1]. order = none / degree (descending total degree) / component (component order).

ops.name: graph_betweenness
ops.summary: Betweenness centrality (Brandes 2001, binary directed, unnormalised). An array of length n, one value per node.

ops.name: graph_binarize
ops.summary: A conn_graph in which edges with |W| > thresh become 1.0 and all others 0.0 (the diagonal follows the same rule).

ops.name: graph_block_shuffle
ops.summary: A control ``conn_graph`` in which **the senders are shuffled** within each block of layers (labels): it keeps the multiset of weights each receiver gets and the total amount of wiring between layers, and destroys only th

ops.name: graph_clustering_coefficient
ops.summary: Mean local clustering coefficient (binary graph with directions collapsed, Watts–Strogatz). Nodes with degree < 2 count as 0.

ops.name: graph_components
ops.summary: Labels of the weakly connected components (0-based, numbered by first appearance in node order). An int64 of length n.

ops.name: graph_conductance_states
ops.summary: Time series of membrane potentials ``(T, n)`` obtained by **running the wiring ``W`` directly as a circuit** (``matrix``, no learning).

ops.name: graph_degree_preserving_shuffle
ops.summary: Degree-preserving shuffle (null model): rewires edges while keeping each node's in-degree, out-degree and the multiset of weights.

ops.name: graph_degree_table
ops.summary: Per-node table of in_degree / out_degree (binary) and in_strength / out_strength (sum of weights).

ops.name: graph_edges_as_lines
ops.summary: Turns the edges into a table of line segments (the exit for overlaying them on a point cloud in Studio): columns pre / post / x0 y0 z0 / x1 y1 z1 / weight.

ops.name: graph_from_synapses
ops.summary: Turns a synapse table (m, 3) = (pre_id, post_id, count) into an n×n weighted directed adjacency matrix.

ops.name: graph_laplacian_spectrum
ops.summary: Eigenvalues of the Laplacian L = D − A of the binary graph with directions collapsed (ascending, length n).

ops.name: graph_layer_propagate
ops.summary: Passes the layer-0 state ``U`` (N, n_0) **forward, one stage at a time**, through the blocks ``W[layer a → layer a+1]``, giving the states of all layers ``(N, n)`` (``matrix``; columns in node order, and the layer-0 colu

ops.name: graph_layout_spectral
ops.summary: Spectral layout: a point cloud (n, 3) whose coordinates are the Fiedler vectors (eigenvectors 2..dim+1) of the Laplacian with directions collapsed, each axis in [0, 1].

ops.name: graph_modularity
ops.summary: Directed, weighted modularity Q (Leicht–Newman 2008).

ops.name: graph_motif_count
ops.summary: Counts of 3-node motifs (binary directed, diagonal excluded): reciprocal / ffl / cycle3.

ops.name: graph_rich_club
ops.summary: Rich-club coefficient φ(k): the directed density of the subgraph spanned by nodes with total degree (in+out, binary) > k.

ops.name: graph_spectral_radius
ops.summary: Largest absolute eigenvalue of the weighted adjacency matrix W (spectral radius).

ops.name: points_activity_video
ops.summary: A color video (F, H, W, 3) that puts the activity onto the point cloud and rotates it, values in [0, 1]. F = T × substeps, H = size, W = size × aspect.

ops.name: reservoir_encode
ops.summary: Batch reservoir encoding of static inputs (for classification): the final state (N, n) after running each row of X for steps iterations from the zero state.

ops.name: reservoir_from_graph
ops.summary: A conn_graph with W scaled by a constant so that its spectral radius becomes rho (preprocessing for an echo state network). A radius of 0 is rejected.

ops.name: reservoir_states
ops.summary: Reservoir state sequence: x_{t+1} = (1−leak) x_t + leak · f(Wᵀ x_t + W_in u_t). Returns (T − washout, n).

ops.name: ridge_predict
ops.summary: Prediction with the readout weights (T, k) = [X, 1] · Wout. Wout is the (d+1, k) from ridge_readout.

ops.name: ridge_readout
ops.summary: Ridge-regression readout weights (d+1, k) = (X̃ᵀX̃ + αI)⁻¹ X̃ᵀY, with X̃ = [X, 1] (a bias column is appended).

ops.name: states_layer_dimension
ops.summary: Table of the effective dimension per layer: columns layer / n / participation_ratio / ratio (= PR / n).

ops.name: states_participation_ratio
ops.summary: **Effective dimension** of the state sequence ``X`` (N, n) = participation ratio ``PR = (Σλ)² / Σλ²`` (λ are the eigenvalues of the covariance, Gao et al. 2017). It is n if all columns are independent with equal variance

ops.name: conv_gci
ops.summary: Grid convergence index of the finest solution: Celik et al. 2008 procedure, eqs. (1)-(7).

ops.name: conv_observed_order
ops.summary: Apparent order of convergence p from three systematically refined solutions (Celik et al. 2008, eq. 3).

ops.name: iterate_fixed_point
ops.summary: Solve x = g(x) by fixed-point iteration (plain / Aitken / Anderson) and refuse if it does not converge.

ops.name: iv_richardson_lucy_until
ops.summary: Richardson-Lucy deconvolution stopped by the discrepancy principle (Poisson: Bertero 2010, tau = 1; Gaussian: Morozov); refuses data outside the model's range.

ops.name: mc_photon_slab
ops.summary: Diffuse reflectance, total transmittance and absorption of a layered turbid slab by MCML-type Monte Carlo, with confidence intervals.

ops.name: mc_sequential_mean
ops.summary: Sequential Monte Carlo mean: add samples until the confidence interval is narrower than the tolerance.

ops.name: dem_aspect
ops.summary: Slope aspect [degrees]. **North is 0 degrees, increasing towards east**. Flat cells get :data:`ASPECT_FLAT`.

ops.name: dem_cell_size_webmercator
ops.summary: Ground resolution of a Web Mercator tile [m/px]. **It varies with latitude**.

ops.name: dem_curvature
ops.summary: Curvature [1/m]. ``kind`` is ``"profile"`` (profile) / ``"planform"`` (plan) / ``"total"``.

ops.name: dem_datum_shift_3param
ops.summary: Switching the geodetic datum — a geocentric 3-parameter translation (``points``).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('dem_datum_shift_3param', lat_deg=<number>, lon_deg=<number>, h_m=<number>, dx_m=<number>, dy_m=<number>, dz_m=<number>, a_from_m=<number>, f_from=<number>, a_to_m=<number>, f_to=<number>)

ops.name: dem_earth_curvature_drop
ops.summary: **Earth-curvature drop** [m] for line-of-sight computations. ``(1 - k) d^2 / (2 R)``.

ops.name: dem_ecef_to_geodetic
ops.summary: ECEF → geodetic coordinates. Returns ``(..., 3)`` holding ``(latitude[deg], longitude[deg], height[m])``.

ops.name: dem_enu_from_geodetic
ops.summary: Geodetic coordinates → **local ENU** (east, north, up) around a reference point [m] (``points``).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('dem_enu_from_geodetic', lat_deg=<number>, lon_deg=<number>, h_m=<number>, lat0_deg=<number>, lon0_deg=<number>, h0_m=<number>)

ops.name: dem_fill_sinks
ops.summary: DEM with its depressions filled. The priority-flood of Barnes, Lehman & Mulla (2014).

ops.name: dem_flow_accumulation
ops.summary: Number of contributing cells: the count of upstream cells flowing into each cell (the cell itself counts as 1).

ops.name: dem_flow_direction
ops.summary: D8 flow direction. O'Callaghan & Mark (1984).

ops.name: dem_geocentric_grid
ops.summary: Converts each DEM cell into **coordinates as seen from the Earth's center**.

ops.name: dem_geodetic_from_enu
ops.summary: Local ENU → geodetic coordinates (the inverse of :func:`dem_enu_from_geodetic`). ``points``.

ops.name: dem_geodetic_slope
ops.summary: Slope of a DEM on a **latitude-longitude grid** (equal angular spacing). The cell dimensions vary with latitude.

ops.name: dem_geodetic_to_ecef
ops.summary: Geodetic coordinates (latitude, longitude, ellipsoidal height) → **Earth-centered Cartesian coordinates ECEF** [m].

ops.name: dem_geoid_height
ops.summary: **Bilinearly interpolates** a geoid-height grid at a latitude/longitude and returns ``N`` [m] (``signal``).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('dem_geoid_height', <depth>, lat_deg=<number>, lon_deg=<number>, lat0_deg=<number>, lon0_deg=<number>, d_lat_deg=<number>, d_lon_deg=<number>)

ops.name: dem_height_frame_convert
ops.summary: Moves the height **reference**: ellipsoidal height ``h`` ↔ orthometric height ``H`` (``H = h - N``). ``signal``.

ops.name: dem_height_frame_residual
ops.summary: Residual ``h - H - N`` — a detector that **does not let a mix-up of heights stay silent** (``table``).

ops.name: dem_hillshade
ops.summary: Hillshade [0,1]. ``azimuth_deg`` is the azimuth of the light source (north 0 degrees, increasing towards east).

ops.name: dem_horizon_angle
ops.summary: Horizon elevation angle in a given azimuth [degrees]. 0 is horizontal; 90 means the sky straight above is blocked.

ops.name: dem_roughness
ops.summary: Terrain ruggedness index TRI — the root mean square of the elevation differences to the 8 neighbors [m].

ops.name: dem_sky_view_factor
ops.summary: Sky view factor [0,1]: how much of the sky is visible.

ops.name: dem_slope
ops.summary: Slope angle. ``units`` is ``"degrees"`` / ``"radians"`` / ``"percent"``.

ops.name: dem_stream_network
ops.summary: Binary mask that treats cells whose flow accumulation exceeds a threshold as stream channels.

ops.name: dem_tpi
ops.summary: Topographic position index TPI — the difference between the cell itself and the mean of its 8 neighbors [m]. Positive means ridge, negative means valley.

ops.name: dem_viewshed
ops.summary: Visible area from 1 point (1 = visible). Decides whether the line of sight is blocked by the terrain.

ops.name: ackermann_steer_angles
ops.summary: Ackermann inner and outer wheel steering angles (turning radius R at the center of the rear axle, wheelbase L, track width t).

ops.name: add_ball
ops.summary: Adds a ball to the world at pose (p, R). The per-face labels (ball 23 / marker 24) are kept as is. Return value = index into objects.

ops.name: add_ken
ops.summary: Adds a ken to the world at pose (p = center of the cross-piece, R) (face labels 27/28/30/31 are kept as is). Returns the index into objects.

ops.name: add_mesh_object
ops.summary: Places a procedural mesh (tree_mesh / pedestrian_mesh …, origin = bottom center) at a pose and adds it to the world.

ops.name: add_sign
ops.summary: Erects a roadside sign: post (cylinder, gray, label 6) + plate (lower edge = ``mount_height``, default 1.8 m, label 4).

ops.name: add_signal_jp
ops.summary: Erects a Japanese-style traffic signal: post + horizontal arm + signal head (horizontal, 3 lamps; the display face points toward vehicles approaching in the yaw direction).

ops.name: add_string
ops.summary: Adds the string (label 29, dark gray) to the world. Returns the index into objects.

ops.name: adg_build
ops.summary: Action dependency graph (Hönig, Kiesel, Tinka, Durham, Ayanian 2019).

ops.name: adg_execute
ops.summary: Executes according to the ADG. At each time step, each vehicle stops with probability ``delay_prob`` (slipping, people, delays in loading).

ops.name: ae_band_power
ops.summary: Computes the AE band power in 2 ways (one with the definition from the published analysis code, the other from the density spectrum of ``acoustics.stft``).

ops.summary: 1 step of the linear 2-wheel equivalent (bicycle) model (classic 4th-order Runge–Kutta; δ and u are constant within the step).

ops.name: bounce
ops.summary: Update of velocity and angular velocity at the instant a rigid sphere hits a plane (Coulomb friction, the 2 regimes of Cross 2002 / Garwin 1969).

ops.summary: Extracts contact candidates from a height sequence z(t): local minima where the downward velocity turns upward (minimum over ``min_gap`` samples before and after). Return value ``{"index" (M,), "t" (M,), "z" (M,)}``.
