ops.summary: Whether a lane change is permitted (judgment by the statute). Scenarios S067, S072, S073.

ops.summary: Ebbinghaus illusion. **The 2 central circles have exactly the same radius**.

ops.name: illusion_fraser_spiral
ops.summary: Fraser illusion. **It looks like a spiral, but is actually concentric circles**.

ops.name: illusion_ground_truth
ops.summary: Returns, as a table, the **exact invariants** that the illusions preserve (empty ``name`` gives all of them).

ops.name: illusion_hermann_grid
ops.summary: Hermann grid. **The intersections are exactly the same white as everywhere else** (the dark spots are made by the eye).

ops.name: illusion_kanizsa
ops.summary: Kanizsa triangle. A triangle is seen although **not even 1 contour line is drawn**.

ops.name: illusion_muller_lyer
ops.summary: Müller-Lyer illusion. **The 2 shafts are exactly equal in length**.

ops.name: illusion_poggendorff
ops.summary: Poggendorff illusion. **The oblique line is exactly 1 straight line** (it is merely hidden by the band).

ops.name: illusion_ponzo
ops.summary: Ponzo illusion. **The 2 horizontal bars are exactly equal in length** (perspective cues change the length).

ops.name: illusion_scintillating_grid
ops.summary: Scintillating grid. A Hermann grid with white discs placed at the intersections.

ops.name: illusion_simultaneous_contrast
ops.summary: Simultaneous contrast. **The 2 gray patches have exactly the same value** (only their surroundings differ).

ops.name: illusion_zollner
ops.summary: Zöllner illusion. Although **the long lines are exactly parallel**, they appear to converge.

ops.name: perpetual_apollonian
ops.summary: Apollonian circle packing — keeps inserting circles tangent to the gaps (it never ends).

ops.name: perpetual_chaos_game
ops.summary: Chaos game — just rolling a die and moving halfway each time produces the Sierpiński triangle.

ops.name: perpetual_elementary_ca
ops.summary: Elementary cellular automaton (Wolfram's 256 rules), extended endlessly from top to bottom.

ops.name: perpetual_flow_field
ops.summary: Flow field — keeps advecting particles along the field (it does not end unless stopped).

ops.name: perpetual_harmonograph
ops.summary: Harmonograph — 2 damped pendulums keep drawing a curve that never closes.

ops.name: perpetual_identities
ops.summary: Returns the **exact claims** each system must satisfy, together with measured values (``table``).

ops.name: perpetual_ifs_attractor
ops.summary: Attractor of an iterated function system (Barnsley fern) — just iterating 4 formulas endlessly.

ops.name: perpetual_langtons_ant
ops.summary: Langton's ant — with just 2 rules, after 10,000 steps it keeps building a "highway".

ops.name: perpetual_loop
ops.summary: Creates a **seamless looping video** → ``rgbvideo`` (T,H,W,3).

ops.name: perpetual_loop_seam
ops.summary: Quantifies the **seam** of a looping video as numbers (``table``).

ops.name: perpetual_plasma
ops.summary: Diamond-square algorithm (the "plasma" of the 1980s) — keep subdividing and it gets infinitely fine.

ops.name: perpetual_reaction_diffusion
ops.summary: Gray–Scott reaction-diffusion — patterns emerge, split and keep multiplying.

ops.name: perpetual_render
ops.summary: Renders the state as a picture (``rgb``). It may be drawn at any step.

ops.name: perpetual_state
ops.summary: Creates a **state** that can be run forever (``table``). When to stop is up to the caller.

ops.name: perpetual_step
ops.summary: Advances the state by ``steps`` (returns the same dict — large arrays are not copied).

ops.name: perpetual_ten_print
ops.summary: ``10 PRINT CHR$(205.5+RND(1)); : GOTO 10`` — a maze that grows forever.

ops.name: perpetual_truchet
ops.summary: Truchet tiles — just randomizing the orientation of 2 quarter-circle arcs yields an unbroken network of curves.

ops.name: pl_diffusion_psf
ops.summary: Return the carrier-diffusion PSF (the 2-D Green function K0(r/L)/2πL², summing to 1) as an image.

ops.name: pl_groove_visibility
ops.summary: Closed-form contrast and CNR of a shadow groove and a sink groove from groove width, diffusion length and noise (table).

ops.name: pl_image_simulate
ops.summary: Build a PL image from an excitation map and a recombination map (exact steady-state diffusion solve + optical PSF + noise).

ops.name: sem_cd_measure
ops.summary: Measure a line width from a line profile (``pairs``: x and signal) with the two CD-SEM methods.

ops.name: sem_charging_series
ops.summary: Advance insulator charging frame by frame of the scan and return the image over time (``video``, (T, H, W)).

ops.name: sem_electron_mc
ops.summary: Monte Carlo of electrons fired into a flat specimen: backscatter coefficient η, secondary-electron yield δ and interaction volume.

ops.name: sem_image
ops.summary: SEM image from a height field and a material map, firing electrons into every pixel (direct Monte Carlo).

ops.name: sem_line_profile
ops.summary: Monte Carlo line profile of a beam scanned across one line with a trapezoidal cross-section (CD-SEM).

ops.name: sem_render
ops.summary: Render a SEM image from a height field: secondary-electron edge effect (sec θ) + Gaussian beam PSF + Poisson shot noise.

ops.name: sem_se_escape_fraction
ops.summary: Fraction F(V) of secondary electrons that can leave a positively charged surface (potential V > 0).

ops.name: sem_se_universal_curve
ops.summary: Universal secondary-electron yield curve δ/δmax = 1.28 (E/Emax)^−0.67 [1 − exp(−1.614 (E/Emax)^1.67)].

ops.name: sem_yield_curve
ops.summary: Sweep the accelerating voltage, compute η(E) and δ(E) by Monte Carlo, and compare the shape of δ with the universal curve.

ops.name: camera_orientation_from_skyline
ops.summary: Determines (yaw, pitch, roll) from the skyline of a photo (row per column) and the skyline of the DEM → table.

ops.name: camera_orientation_from_sun
ops.summary: Time-stamped pixel positions of the sun, ≥ 2 points → camera (yaw, pitch, roll) (SVD solution of Wahba's problem = Kabsch).

ops.name: camera_orientation_from_sun_candidates
ops.summary: From several candidate "bright blobs" per frame (a mix of the sun, white cars, signs and text), selects with RANSAC **the 1 track that moves as the time predicts**, and determines (yaw, pitch, roll) and the focal length

ops.name: dem_skyline
ops.summary: **Omnidirectional skyline** seen from 1 point of the DEM (horizon elevation per azimuth) → table.

ops.name: render_skyline_view
ops.summary: From a skyline table and an orientation, draws the **sky mask** (H, W) seen by a camera pointing that way → image2d (0/1).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('render_skyline_view', <table>, K=<number>, shape=<number>, yaw_deg=<number>, pitch_deg=<number>, roll_deg=<number>)

ops.name: skyline_extract
ops.summary: Extracts from a photo, by dynamic programming, 1 line giving **the row of the sky–terrain boundary for each column** → signal (W,).

ops.name: sun_bloom_fit
ops.summary: The sun in real footage = a **bloom** that saturates the sensor (larger than the disk, its size changes with exposure, and it gets cut off by the image edge or by text bands). Fits a circle to the **edge** of the largest

ops.name: sun_pixel_position
ops.summary: Centroid of the sun in the image (a disk that **saturates** the sensor) → keypoints (1, 2) = (u, v).

ops.name: sun_position
ops.summary: Latitude, longitude, time (UNIX seconds, UTC) → azimuth and elevation of the sun [degrees] (NOAA solar position algorithm, the low-accuracy formula of Meeus 1998).

ops.name: alpha_composite
ops.summary: Porter–Duff **over** on straight-alpha ``rgba`` (Porter & Duff 1984).

ops.name: alpha_composite_premul
ops.summary: Porter–Duff **over** on premultiplied colour: ``src + dst*(1 - src.a)``.

ops.name: awb_gains
ops.summary: Estimate white-balance gains ``(g_R, g_G, g_B)`` with ``g_G = 1``.

ops.name: blend_mode
ops.summary: Blend two opaque ``rgb`` images with a named mode (W3C Level 1).

ops.name: bloom
ops.summary: Bleed the bright parts of an image into their neighbourhood.

ops.name: brightness_contrast
ops.summary: ``out = (rgb - 0.5) * contrast + 0.5 + brightness``, clipped to ``[0, 1]``.

ops.name: chromatic_aberration
ops.summary: Scale the red and blue channels about the image centre, green fixed.

ops.name: color_correction_matrix
ops.summary: Apply a 3x3 colour-correction matrix: ``out = rgb @ ccm.T`` per pixel, clipped to ``[0, 1]``.

ops.name: color_grade
ops.summary: Apply a 3-D colour LUT to an ``rgb`` image by trilinear interpolation.

ops.name: color_lut
ops.summary: Build a 3-D colour LUT, ``(n, n, n, 3)`` indexed ``[r, g, b]``.

ops.name: dither
ops.summary: Quantise to ``levels`` values per channel while preserving the local mean.

ops.name: film_grain
ops.summary: Add zero-mean Gaussian grain, deterministically from ``seed``.

ops.name: hue_saturation
ops.summary: Rotate the hue by *hue_deg* and scale the saturation by *saturation*, in BT.601 YCbCr: luma is kept, the chroma vector ``(Cb, Cr)`` is rotated and scaled. Output clipped to ``[0, 1]``.

ops.name: layer_stack
ops.summary: Composite a z-ordered list of ``rgba`` layers, bottom first.

ops.name: lens_shading_correct
ops.summary: Multiply a frame by a lens-shading gain map and clip to ``[0, 1]``. *raw* and *gain* must have the same shape; the gain must be finite and > 0.

ops.name: lens_shading_gain
ops.summary: The gain map that flattens a **flat-field** frame: ``gain = mean / flat`` per colour channel (or for the whole frame when *pattern* is ``None``).

ops.name: light_mask
ops.summary: Modulate an ``rgb`` image by an ``rgb`` light map: ``base * (ambient + light)``.

ops.name: linear_to_srgb
ops.summary: Linear light back to sRGB encoding. Exact inverse of :func:`srgb_to_linear`.

ops.name: nine_slice
ops.summary: Stretch a frame to a new size without deforming its corners.
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('nine_slice', <rgba>, left=<number>, right=<number>, top=<number>, bottom=<number>, out_height=<number>, out_width=<number>)

ops.name: normal_map_decode
ops.summary: Tangent-space normal map ``rgb`` in ``[0, 1]`` to unit vectors ``(H, W, 3)``.

ops.name: normal_map_shade
ops.summary: Shade a 2-D normal map with one directional light (Lambert + Blinn 1977).

ops.name: palette_quantize
ops.summary: Map every pixel to its nearest palette colour in Euclidean RGB.

ops.name: parallax_layers
ops.summary: Scroll a set of ``rgba`` layers at different rates and composite them.

ops.name: particle_emit
ops.summary: Emit ``count`` particles from ``origin``, deterministically from ``seed``.

ops.name: particle_render
ops.summary: Splat a particle state into an ``rgba`` image.

ops.name: particle_step
ops.summary: Advance a particle state by ``dt`` seconds. Returns a **new** dict.

ops.name: premultiply
ops.summary: Straight-alpha ``rgba`` to **premultiplied** ``rgba``: ``(C*A, A)``.

ops.name: radial_light
ops.summary: A radial light map, ``rgb`` ``(H, W, 3)``, centred on ``(x, y)``.
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('radial_light', height=<number>, width=<number>, x=<number>, y=<number>, radius=<number>)

ops.name: raw_apply_gains
ops.summary: Multiply a Bayer frame by per-channel gains (3 values ``R, G, B`` or 4 values ``R, G1, G2, B``) and clip to ``[0, 1]`` — white balance applied **before** demosaicing, which is where a real ISP does it (interpolating unba

ops.name: raw_black_level
ops.summary: Black-level compensation on a Bayer frame: ``(raw - offset) / (white - offset)`` per colour channel, clipped to ``[0, 1]``.

ops.name: raw_dead_pixel_correct
ops.summary: Replace every dead pixel (:func:`raw_dead_pixel_mask`) by the **median of its 8 same-colour neighbours**; every other pixel is returned bit-for-bit.

ops.name: raw_dead_pixel_mask
ops.summary: Where the dead (stuck / hot) pixels are: ``1.0`` at a pixel that differs from **every one** of its 8 same-colour neighbours by more than *threshold* in the same direction, ``0.0`` elsewhere. ``(H, W)`` float64.

ops.name: raw_demosaic_bilinear
ops.summary: Bayer mosaic → ``(H, W, 3)`` RGB by bilinear interpolation, in NumPy.

ops.name: rgb_apply_gains
ops.summary: Multiply the R, G, B channels by ``gains`` (3 values) and clip to ``[0, 1]``.

ops.name: shadow_cast_2d
ops.summary: Visibility of every pixel from a point light at ``(x, y)``, as ``image2d``.

ops.name: sprite_blit
ops.summary: Composite ``sprite`` onto a copy of ``dst`` at integer ``(x, y)``.

ops.name: sprite_sheet_slice
ops.summary: Cut a sprite atlas into a list of equal ``rgba`` frames, row-major.

ops.name: sprite_synthesize
ops.summary: A deterministic anti-aliased test sprite, ``rgba`` ``(size, size, 4)``.

ops.name: sprite_transform
ops.summary: Rotate and/or scale an ``rgba`` sprite about its centre.

ops.name: srgb_to_linear
ops.summary: sRGB-encoded values to linear light (IEC 61966-2-1).

ops.name: tilemap_render
ops.summary: Paint a grid of tile indices into one ``rgba`` image.

ops.name: unpremultiply
ops.summary: **Premultiplied** ``rgba`` back to straight alpha: ``(C/A, A)``.

ops.name: viewport
ops.summary: Crop the rectangle at ``(x, y, width, height)`` and resample it by ``scale``.

ops.name: vignette
ops.summary: Darken towards the corners: ``out = rgb * (1 - strength * t**power)``.

ops.name: car_dubins_path
ops.summary: Shortest forward-only path of a car between two poses (Dubins 1957) by the six closed-form words.

ops.name: car_hybrid_astar
ops.summary: Hybrid A* (Dolgov, Thrun, Montemerlo and Diebel 2010): a car's path through an occupancy grid.

ops.name: car_reeds_shepp_path
ops.summary: Shortest path of a car that may reverse, between two poses (Reeds and Shepp 1990), by closed form.

ops.name: graph_core_persistence
ops.summary: Which nodes sit in the innermost core of every individual — K wirings on one node order.

ops.name: graph_cycle3
ops.summary: Number of directed 3-cycles ``i -> j -> k -> i`` as ``tr(B^3) / 3``.

ops.name: graph_degree_preserving_null
ops.summary: Compare 3-cycles and reciprocity against a degree-preserving null model.

ops.name: graph_degree_summary
ops.summary: Degrees, density and reciprocity of a directed wiring matrix.

ops.name: graph_edge_consensus
ops.summary: How many individuals share each connection — K wiring matrices on one node order.

ops.name: graph_kcore
ops.summary: k-core (or weighted s-core) decomposition of a wiring matrix — every node's core index.

ops.name: graph_physarum_path
ops.summary: Shortest path by the slime mould's tube dynamics (Tero et al. 2010) on a weighted graph.

ops.name: graph_physarum_transport
ops.summary: L1 optimal transport (the Beckmann problem) on a weighted graph by the slime mould's tube dynamics.

ops.name: graph_rich_club_curve
ops.summary: Rich-club coefficient φ(k) for every k, against the degree-preserving null.

ops.name: graph_strength_growth
ops.summary: Where the new synapses went — one wiring matrix ``a`` (earlier) against ``b`` (later).

ops.name: graph_swap_symmetry
ops.summary: How much of the wiring survives exchanging node pairs (a left/right test).

ops.name: physarum_route
ops.summary: Minimum-cost route through a cost image found by the slime mould's tube dynamics.

ops.name: physarum_transport_image
ops.summary: Earth mover's distance between two mass images by the slime mould's tube dynamics.

ops.name: tree_from_swc
ops.summary: Parse an SWC text (or a path to a ``.swc`` file) into a checked tree table.

ops.name: tree_morphometry
ops.summary: Counts and lengths of a tree table (from :func:`tree_from_swc`).

ops.name: tree_run_length
ops.summary: Expected run length (ERL) of a skeleton under a candidate labelling of its nodes.

ops.name: tree_sholl
ops.summary: Sholl analysis: segments crossing spheres (3-D) or circles (a projection) around the root.

ops.name: copy_move_regions
ops.summary: Pairs of **copy-move** (self-duplicated) regions within one image. ``table``.

ops.name: error_level_map
ops.summary: ELA (error-level analysis). A map of the **difference after re-compressing** at a given quality. ``image2d``.

ops.name: evidence_quantile
ops.summary: Where the evidence statistic **sits within** the clean distribution. It does not return a verdict.

ops.name: fingerprint_correlate
ops.summary: Match one image against a fingerprint. **It returns no verdict** — an evidence statistic and its caveats.

ops.name: fingerprint_strength_map
ops.summary: A map of the fingerprint's **effective strength per block** (its standard deviation). ``image2d``.

ops.name: hash_distance
ops.summary: Hamming distance between two perceptual hashes (the number of differing bits).

ops.name: jpeg_ghost_map
ops.summary: JPEG ghosts (Farid 2009). A series of **re-compression residual maps** over a quality sweep. ``images``.

ops.name: jpeg_ghost_quality
ops.summary: A series of ghost maps → a map of **the quality at which each pixel's residual is smallest**. ``image2d``.

ops.name: jpeg_quality_estimate
ops.summary: **Blind estimation of the quantisation table and JPEG quality** from a decoded image. ``table``.

ops.name: noise_inconsistency_map
ops.summary: A map of the **noise standard deviation per block**. ``image2d``.

ops.name: null_distribution
ops.summary: Summarise the null distribution of the evidence statistic from samples known to be **untampered**.

ops.name: perceptual_hash
ops.summary: A perceptual hash. Returns a **1-D bool bit string**.

ops.name: sensor_fingerprint
ops.summary: Maximum-likelihood estimate of the **PRNU sensor fingerprint** K from several frames (Chen et al. 2008).

ops.name: watermark_capacity
ops.summary: Sweep the trade-off between embedding strength and **PSNR / BER**. ``table``.

ops.name: watermark_embed
ops.summary: DWT-DCT **watermark** embedding. Returns the watermarked image ``(H, W)``. ``image2d``.

ops.name: watermark_extract
ops.summary: **Blind extraction** of the watermark. Returns a 1-D bool (the ``phash`` vocabulary).

ops.name: compare_images
ops.summary: Measure several metrics at once and **return what was measured and how, alongside the numbers**.

ops.name: compressed_size
ops.summary: Size in bytes of the array after lossless compression. The raw material for ``ncd``.

ops.name: data_range_of
ops.summary: Decide the span the pixel values may take. **It does not guess.**

ops.name: delta_e_2000
ops.summary: CIEDE2000 colour difference (CIE 142-2001).

ops.name: delta_e_76
ops.summary: CIE76 colour difference — the Euclidean distance in Lab space.

ops.name: delta_e_map
ops.summary: Per-pixel colour-difference map between two **sRGB images**.

ops.name: fsim
ops.summary: FSIM (luminance only, 1 = identical, **higher is better**). It agrees with TID2013's FSIM.txt to 4 digits when given **a Y′ limited grayscale image** (``iqatid.tid2013_evaluate(root, fsim, luma="limited_u8")``, 3,000 pai

ops.name: fsim_pair
ops.summary: FSIM and FSIMc in one call (phase congruency is computed only 1 time per image — evaluators and PoCs call this one).

ops.name: fsimc
ops.summary: FSIMc (including chroma I / Q, 1 = identical, **higher is better**). It agrees with TID2013's FSIMc.txt to 4 digits when given a color image (RGB → YIQ full range) (``iqatid.tid2013_evaluate(root, fsimc, luma="rgb")``, 3

ops.name: gmsd
ops.summary: GMSD = standard deviation of the GMS map (N−1, the original implementation's ``std2``, Eq. 5 of the paper). 0 = identical, larger means more degraded (**lower is better** — the rank correlation with MOS is negative, and

ops.name: gmsd_map
ops.summary: GMS map (2 m_r m_d + c)/(m_r² + m_d² + c) ∈ (0, 1] (Eq. 3 of the paper). m = magnitude of the Prewitt ([1 0 −1]×3 /3) gradient; preprocessing is a 2×2 mean + decimation by 2 (:func:`_average_downsample`, the original imp

ops.name: image_entropy
ops.summary: Shannon entropy of one image [bit].

ops.name: joint_entropy
ops.summary: Joint entropy H(A, B) [bit].

ops.name: joint_histogram
ops.summary: Joint histogram of two images (the normalised joint probability).

ops.name: lab_to_rgb
ops.summary: CIE L\*a\*b\* → sRGB ``[0, 1]``. **Out-of-gamut colours are clipped**, so a round trip through ``rgb_to_lab`` only matches inside the gamut (pinned by a test).

ops.name: measure_with
ops.summary: Measure another pair **under exactly the same conditions as the previous measurement**.

ops.name: metrics_table
ops.summary: Turn a report into a ``(name, value)`` table — the rows describing the conditions are **always listed with it**.

ops.name: ms_ssim
ops.summary: Multi-scale SSIM (Wang, Simoncelli & Bovik, Asilomar Conf. 2003).

ops.name: mse
ops.summary: Mean squared error. A raw quantity that does not depend on ``data_range``.

ops.name: mutual_information
ops.summary: Mutual information I(A; B) [bit] = H(A) + H(B) - H(A, B).

ops.name: ncd
ops.summary: Normalised compression distance (Li, Chen, Li, Ma & Vitányi, IEEE TIT 50(12), 2004).

ops.name: normalized_mutual_information
ops.summary: Normalised mutual information 2*I(A;B) / (H(A) + H(B)). 1.0 for identical images.

ops.name: phase_congruency_pc
ops.summary: Phase congruency PC(x) = Σ_o E_o(x) / Σ_o Σ_s A_{s,o}(x) ∈ [0, 1] (Kovesi 1999; convention of Eq. 4 of the FSIM paper: log-Gabor with 4 scales × 4 orientations).

ops.name: psnr
ops.summary: Returns the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR, in dB) of two images.

ops.name: rank_data
ops.summary: Average ranks (starting at 1). Ties get the average of their ranks (same definition as 'average' in scipy.stats.rankdata).

ops.name: rank_kendall_b
ops.summary: Kendall's τ_b (with tie correction) = (C − D) / sqrt((n0 − n1)(n0 − n2)).

ops.name: rank_spearman
ops.summary: Spearman's rank correlation ρ = Pearson correlation between average ranks (the form that is correct even with ties; the classical formula 1 − 6Σd²/(n(n²−1)) agrees only when there are no ties). 1 for monotonically increa

ops.name: rgb_to_lab
ops.summary: sRGB → CIE L\*a\*b\* (D65). The step before measuring ΔE.

ops.name: rgb_to_xyz
ops.summary: sRGB (``(..., 3)``) → CIE XYZ. The transfer function is removed first, then the matrix is applied.

ops.name: rmse
ops.summary: Root mean squared error (in the same units as the pixel values).

ops.name: ssim
ops.summary: Structural similarity (Wang, Bovik, Sheikh & Simoncelli, IEEE TIP 13(4), 2004).

ops.name: ssim_map
ops.summary: The SSIM **map** (before averaging) — to see *where* the two differ, as a picture.

ops.name: tid2013_by_distortion
ops.summary: Rank correlation between the metric and the MOS for each distortion type (24).

ops.name: tid2013_compare
ops.summary: Compares your own values with the authors' values (same pairs, same order): per-row differences and rank correlations with the MOS.

ops.name: tid2013_evaluate
ops.summary: Applies your own metric ``fn(ref, dist) -> float`` to the TID2013 pairs and returns its rank correlation with the MOS.

ops.name: tid2013_index
ops.summary: Reads ``mos_with_names.txt`` and returns the ledger of pairs.

ops.name: tid2013_metric_values
ops.summary: Returns the authors' computed values ``metrics_values/<metric>.txt`` (case-insensitive, 3000 lines, no names) as a (3000,) float. The line order is the same as ``names`` of :func:`tid2013_index`. ``metric`` is a key of :

ops.name: tid2013_published
ops.summary: The published rank-correlation table {metric: (SROCC, KROCC)} (14 metrics).

ops.name: tid2013_root
ops.summary: Where the distribution is extracted. If ``root`` is absent, the environment variable ``FULLSEYE_TID2013_DATA``. If neither exists, or ``mos_with_names.txt`` is missing, ``None`` (the caller skips — the data is not in the

ops.name: vifp
ops.summary: Pixel-domain version of VIF (the scalar GSM of Sheikh & Bovik 2006 §V, following the convention of the public vifp_mscale). 1 = identical, **higher is better**.

ops.name: xyz_to_lab
ops.summary: CIE XYZ → CIE 1976 L\*a\*b\*. The default white point is D65 2°.

ops.name: chromatic_confocal_height
ops.summary: Surface height from one confocal return spectrum — the wavelength *is* the height.

ops.name: chromatic_confocal_simulate
ops.summary: Synthesise the confocal return spectrum of a surface at a known height.

ops.name: csi_contrast_map
ops.summary: Peak fringe modulation per pixel — the contrast (and validity) map.

ops.name: csi_design
ops.summary: The axial limits of a coherence-scanning setup, from the source spectrum.

ops.name: csi_envelope
ops.summary: Coherence envelope of a z-scan interferogram (analytic-signal magnitude).

ops.name: csi_height_map
ops.summary: Height map from a ``(Z, H, W)`` coherence-scanning stack — the CSI inversion.

ops.name: csi_peak_position
ops.summary: Surface height from one z-scan: the position of the coherence envelope peak.

ops.name: csi_signal_simulate
ops.summary: Synthesise the z-scan interferogram of one pixel over a known surface height.

ops.name: csi_stack_simulate
ops.summary: Synthesise the ``(Z, H, W)`` scan stack an interference microscope records.

ops.name: lf_all_in_focus
ops.summary: Composite one everywhere-sharp image by refocusing each pixel at its own slope.

ops.name: lf_aperture_mask
ops.summary: Angular weighting mask — the synthetic aperture you stop down or shape.

ops.name: lf_center_view
ops.summary: The centre viewpoint — the ordinary 2-D image a plenoptic camera also gives.

ops.name: lf_depth_from_focus
ops.summary: Per-pixel slope from the **sharpness peak** across the refocus sweep.

ops.name: lf_disparity_to_depth
ops.summary: Slope (px per angular step) -> metric depth, the camera-array model.

ops.name: lf_epi
ops.summary: Epipolar-plane image — the slice whose **line slope is the disparity**.

ops.name: lf_epi_slope
ops.summary: Per-pixel slope from the **EPI line orientation** (structure tensor, refined by shearing).

ops.name: lf_focal_stack
ops.summary: Refocus at every slope in *slopes* — a focal stack from one exposure.

ops.name: lf_from_mla
ops.summary: Decode a microlens-array raw frame into a ``(V, U, H, W)`` light field.

ops.name: lf_plenoptic_design
ops.summary: Size a plenoptic camera: what angular/spatial resolution and depth range you buy.

ops.name: lf_refocus
ops.summary: Shift-and-add refocus: the synthetic-aperture image focused at *slope*.

ops.name: lf_stats
ops.summary: Describe a light field: shape, angular centre, and the slope range it can carry.

ops.name: lf_subaperture
ops.summary: One sub-aperture view — the image seen through one point of the pupil.

ops.name: lf_synthesize
ops.summary: Build a light field of textured layers at **known** slopes (the test bed).

ops.name: lf_synthetic_aperture
ops.summary: Refocus through a shaped aperture — and, with ``reduce="median"``, through occluders.

ops.name: lf_to_mla
ops.summary: Re-interleave a light field into a microlens-array raw frame (exact inverse).

ops.name: lf_views
ops.summary: The whole angular grid as a plain list of 2-D images (row-major over ``(v, u)``).

ops.name: focus_sweep_height_video
ops.summary: Builds a **height-field video** ``(T, Y, X)`` from a time series of focus sweeps (each frame a z focus stack) (``video``, unit = number of z slices).

ops.name: focus_sweep_surface_video
ops.summary: Builds a **shaded height-field video** ``(T, Y, X, 3)`` from a time series of focus sweeps (each frame a z focus stack) (``rgbvideo``).

ops.name: video_interpolate_flow
ops.summary: Interpolates a video ``(T, H, W)`` along the flow into ``(T + (T − 1)(factor − 1), H, W)`` (``video``, temporal super-resolution).

ops.name: vol_flow_3d
ops.summary: Dense displacement field ``(3, Z, Y, X)`` between two volumes (``flow_dense``, components dz, dy, dx [voxel]).

ops.name: volseq_cut_video
ops.summary: Video ``(T, H, W)`` of a volume time series cut by a single cross-section (``video``).

ops.name: volseq_interpolate_flow
ops.summary: Interpolates a volume time series ``(T, Z, Y, X)`` along the 3-D flow into ``(T + (T − 1)(factor − 1), Z, Y, X)`` (``volseq``).

ops.name: volseq_magnify_motion
ops.summary: Makes **the small in-band motions of a volume time series alpha times larger** (``volseq``, a 3-D version of Eulerian linear magnification).

ops.name: volseq_mip_video
ops.summary: Collapses a volume time series into a video ``(T, H, W)`` by maximum intensity projection along axis ``axis`` (1 = z, 2 = y, 3 = x) (``video``).

ops.name: volseq_pathline_orbit
ops.summary: Rotates and views the 3-D body of trajectories of ``volseq_pathline_render`` ``(n_frames, size, size, 3)`` (``rgbvideo``).

ops.name: volseq_pathline_render
ops.summary: A **3-D body of trajectories** drawn by letting particles ride the flow ``(size, size, 3)`` (``rgb``) — shows the motion in a single still image.

ops.name: volseq_render_orbit
ops.summary: Renders a volume time series **while advancing time and rotating the viewpoint** ``(n_frames, size, size, 3)`` (``rgbvideo``).

ops.name: volseq_speed
ops.summary: Returns the **speed** ``|d|`` [voxel/frame] between adjacent frames of a volume time series as ``(T − 1, Z, Y, X)`` (``volseq``).

ops.name: volseq_synth_beating
ops.summary: Volume time series ``(T, Z, Y, X)`` of a shell pulsating according to a known radius law (``volseq``, values in [0, 1] + noise).

ops.name: volseq_synth_dividing
ops.summary: Volume time series ``(T, Z, Y, X)`` of a blob splitting in two at a known speed (``volseq``).

ops.name: attention_apply
ops.summary: Mixes the values with the attention weights → tokens. **Since row sums are 1, the output is a convex combination of the inputs**.

ops.name: attention_grouped
ops.summary: Attention that groups heads (GQA) → tokens. **Exactly matches MHA when n_kv_heads == n_heads, and MQA when == 1**.

ops.name: attention_linear
ops.summary: Attention with the softmax removed → tokens. **(QKᵀ)V == Q(KᵀV) — the associative law itself**.

ops.name: attention_scores
ops.summary: Raw attention scores QKᵀ/√d → attnmap (T, S).

ops.name: attention_softmax
ops.summary: Attention in one batch (reference implementation) → tokens. **The reference against which this family is checked**.

ops.name: attention_tiled
ops.summary: Attention with tiles + online softmax (the core of FlashAttention) → tokens. **Not an approximation**.

ops.name: attention_weights
ops.summary: Row-wise softmax (with mask) → attnmap. **Row sums are 1 and mask positions are exactly 0**.

ops.name: kv_cache_decode
ops.summary: Inference that advances by only 1 token (KV Cache) → tokens (1, dv).

ops.name: rms_norm
ops.summary: RMS normalization → tokens. **With the defaults (eps=0, no weight) the RMS of the output is exactly 1**.

ops.name: rope_rotate
ops.summary: Rotary position encoding (RoPE) → tokens. **Being a rotation, it preserves the norm**.

ops.name: features_accuracy_table
ops.summary: On pairs synthesised with known transforms, returns keypoint repeatability, matching precision and homography error per condition as a table. → table.

ops.name: features_match
ops.summary: Matches two feature tables by nearest neighbour + ratio test (+ mutual nearest neighbour). → table (``kind="feature_matches"``).

ops.name: features_orb
ops.summary: ORB keypoints and 256-bit binary descriptors (Rublee et al. 2011). → table (``kind="features"``).

ops.name: features_sift
ops.summary: SIFT keypoints and 128-dimensional descriptors (DoG extrema, Lowe 2004). → table (``kind="features"``).

ops.name: ransac_fundamental
ops.summary: Robustly estimates the fundamental matrix F (``x2ᵀ F x1 = 0``) from matched pairs. → table (``kind="fundamental"``).

ops.name: ransac_homography
ops.summary: Robustly estimates a homography (pts1 → pts2, homogeneous (x, y)) from matched pairs. → table (``kind="homography"``).

ops.name: register_accuracy_map
ops.summary: On a pair synthesised with a known deformation field, returns the per-pixel error of the estimated field (an accuracy map). → table.

ops.name: register_capture_range
ops.summary: For each size of initial misalignment, returns the fraction of registrations started from the identity that return to the truth (the capture range). → table.

ops.name: register_ecc
ops.summary: Aligns moving to fixed with the parametric transform that maximises the enhanced correlation coefficient (ECC). → table (``kind="registration"``).

ops.name: register_ffd
ops.summary: Non-rigidly aligns moving to fixed with a cubic B-spline free-form deformation (FFD). → table (``kind="registration"``).

ops.name: register_mi
ops.summary: Aligns moving to fixed with the rigid / similarity / affine transform that maximises (normalised) mutual information. → table (``kind="registration"``).

ops.name: registration_to_flow2d
ops.summary: Extracts the deformation field ``flow2d`` ((2,H,W) ``(dy, dx)``) from a registration result table. → flow2d.

ops.name: abel_inverse
ops.summary: Recovers an axisymmetric distribution f(r) from the projection A(y) (inverse Abel transform = tomography of an axisymmetric object).

ops.name: abel_inverse_image
ops.summary: Turns an **image** of an axisymmetric object taken from the side (vertical = direction of the symmetry axis, horizontal = distance from the axis) into a cross-section image by applying the inverse Abel transform row by r

ops.name: abel_revolve
ops.summary: Revolves a cross-section f(z, r) ((H, R), r = 0, dr, …) around the symmetry axis into a 3-D volume (H, 2R−1, 2R−1).

ops.name: abel_transform
ops.summary: Maps an axisymmetric distribution f(r) (samples at r = 0, dr, 2dr, …) to its projection A(y) (forward Abel transform).

ops.name: angle_defect
ops.summary: Per-vertex angle defect (discrete Gaussian curvature) K_v = 2π − Σ(angles of the triangles at that vertex). For boundary vertices, π − Σ (geodesic curvature).

ops.name: assign_hungarian
ops.summary: Solves the assignment problem for a cost matrix (n, m) (Hungarian method of Kuhn 1955 / Munkres 1957, scipy implementation).

ops.name: bessel
ops.summary: Bessel functions. ``kind`` = ``"j"`` (J of the 1st kind) / ``"y"`` (Y of the 2nd kind) / ``"i"``, ``"k"`` (modified).

ops.name: chebyshev_coeffs_nd
ops.summary: Computes N-dimensional Chebyshev coefficients from values sampled on a tensor-product Chebyshev–Lobatto grid (DCT-I).

ops.name: chebyshev_eval_nd
ops.summary: Evaluates the coefficients from ``chebyshev_coeffs_nd`` at points (M, d) (per axis T_k(t) = cos(k·arccos t)).

ops.name: chebyshev_nodes
ops.summary: n Chebyshev points on the interval [a, b] (in ascending order).

ops.name: circle_packing_apollonian
ops.summary: Apollonian gasket from a Descartes quadruple — every circle a theorem.

ops.name: cplx_argument_principle
ops.summary: Argument principle: count zeros minus poles enclosed by a contour, from sampled values of ``f`` alone.

ops.name: cplx_cauchy_value
ops.summary: Cauchy's integral formula: recover ``f(w)`` **inside** a contour from its values **on** the contour.

ops.name: cplx_contour_circle
ops.summary: Sample a circle as a closed contour — the standard integration path.

ops.name: cplx_contour_integral
ops.summary: Closed contour integral ``∮ f(z) dz`` by the chordal trapezoidal rule.

ops.name: cplx_cr_residual
ops.summary: Cauchy-Riemann residual of a sampled complex field — "is this field holomorphic?" as a number.

ops.name: cplx_domain_colour
ops.summary: Domain colouring: turn a complex field into an RGB image you can read.

ops.name: cplx_escape_time
ops.summary: How many steps of ``z -> z**2 + c`` it takes to leave the escape disc.

ops.name: cplx_joukowski
ops.summary: Joukowski (Zhukovsky) conformal map ``w = z + c^2 / z``.

ops.name: cplx_laurent_coeffs
ops.summary: Laurent (and Taylor) coefficients on a **uniformly sampled circle** — residues included.

ops.name: cplx_mobius
ops.summary: Möbius (linear fractional) map ``w = (a z + b) / (c z + d)``.

ops.name: cplx_newton_basins
ops.summary: Which root of a polynomial does Newton's method fall into, from each point?

ops.name: cplx_plane_grid
ops.summary: Turns a rectangular window of the complex plane into a grid (laid out like an image: row 0 is the top, i.e. the larger imaginary part).

ops.name: cplx_poly_eval
ops.summary: Evaluate a polynomial on the complex plane (Horner, complex-capable).

ops.name: cplx_rational_field
ops.summary: Sample a rational function ``R(z) = gain * prod(z - zeros) / prod(z - poles)``.

ops.name: cplx_winding_number
ops.summary: Winding number of a closed contour around a point (turning number).

ops.name: crlb_gaussian
ops.summary: Cramér–Rao lower bound under white Gaussian noise (standard deviation sigma).

ops.name: curve_locality
ops.summary: Points ``k`` apart along the curve — how far apart are they on the plane?

ops.name: dct_transform
ops.summary: Orthonormal DCT-II (with ``inverse=True``, DCT-III = the inverse transform) in N dimensions.

ops.name: delaunay_triangulate
ops.summary: Triangulation of planar points (N, 2) or tetrahedralization of spatial points (N, 3) (Delaunay, scipy.spatial = Qhull).

ops.name: dwt_inverse
ops.summary: Restores the original array from the result of ``dwt_transform`` (being orthonormal, it is the transpose of the analysis).

ops.name: dwt_transform
ops.summary: Multi-level, N-dimensional discrete wavelet transform with Daubechies dbN (exactly orthonormal with periodic boundaries).

ops.name: dynsys_bifurcation_map
ops.summary: The orbit diagram of a 1-D map — period doubling, as points you can count.

ops.name: dynsys_correlation_dimension
ops.summary: Grassberger-Procaccia correlation dimension — the slope of ``log C(r)``.

ops.name: dynsys_lyapunov_spectrum
ops.summary: The Lyapunov spectrum by tangent flow + QR — and the sum you can check.

ops.name: dynsys_poincare_section
ops.summary: Where a trajectory crosses a plane — with the crossing point interpolated.

ops.name: erf
ops.summary: Error function erf(x) = (2/√π) ∫_0^x e^{−t²} dt.

ops.name: erfc
ops.summary: Complementary error function erfc(x) = 1 − erf(x). For large x, computing 1 − erf by subtraction loses digits, so it is kept separately (at x = 10, 1 − erf becomes 0 but erfc is 2.1e−45).

ops.name: esprit_doa
ops.summary: ESPRIT (Roy & Kailath 1989): solves for the directions without a grid, from the array's invariance under a "shift by 1 element".

ops.name: ford_circles
ops.summary: Ford circles for the Farey fractions — tangency *is* an integer identity.

ops.name: gauss_cubature
ops.summary: Nodes (n^dim, dim) and weights for quadrature over the box [a, b]^dim (a, b may also be per axis) by a tensor product of Gauss–Legendre rules.

ops.name: gauss_quadrature
ops.summary: Nodes and weights of n-point Gauss quadrature. ∫ f ≈ Σ w_k f(x_k).

ops.name: geodesic_heat
ops.summary: Geodesic distance on a surface by the heat method (Crane et al. 2013). ``source`` is a vertex index (or a sequence of indices; default vertex 0). The mesh may be given as ``(vertices, faces)`` or as 1 mesh tuple.

ops.name: geodesic_heat_grid
ops.summary: Computes obstacle-avoiding geodesic distance on the grid of a 2-D image or 3-D volume by the heat method (grid version of Crane et al. 2013).

ops.name: hankel_image
ops.summary: Computes an axisymmetric image's 2-D Fourier transform with a radial Hankel transform. ``memory_budget`` selects a low-memory path measured within 1e-10.

ops.name: hankel_transform
ops.summary: Hankel transform of order p, F(ν) = 2π ∫_0^∞ f(r) J_p(2πνr) r dr, by the quasi-discrete method.

ops.name: hilbert_analytic
ops.summary: The analytic signal z = x + i·H[x] (negative frequencies removed via FFT), and the amplitude, instantaneous phase and instantaneous frequency read from it.

ops.name: hist_distance
ops.summary: Distance and divergence between 2 histograms (non-negative, normalized by their sum).

ops.name: ifs_fractal
ops.summary: Chaos game on an iterated function system — the dimension is a closed form.

ops.name: ifs_similarity_dimension
ops.summary: Moran's equation ``sum(r_i**d) = 1`` solved for ``d`` — from the maps alone.

ops.name: integrate_hamiltonian
ops.summary: Integrates a named Hamiltonian system (mass 1) in time. Return value ``{"t","q","p","energy","energy_drift","method","system"}``.

ops.name: interp_barycentric
ops.summary: Evaluates at x the polynomial (degree len−1) through the points (xk, yk) with the barycentric formula (Berrut & Trefethen 2004).

ops.name: interp_cubic
ops.summary: Cubic-spline interpolation (``scipy.interpolate.CubicSpline``).

ops.name: interp_linear
ops.summary: Piecewise-linear interpolation of ``(x, y)`` samples at query *xq*.

ops.name: interp_scattered
ops.summary: Values at *query* from **scattered** samples — sensor nets, boreholes, weather.

ops.name: joukowski_circulation
ops.summary: The Kutta circulation ``Gamma = 4*pi*a*U*sin(alpha + beta)`` for that section.

ops.name: kalman_smooth
ops.in_sort: matrix × matrix × matrix × matrix × matrix × signal × matrix
ops.summary: Kalman filter (forward) and Rauch–Tung–Striebel smoother (backward) for the linear Gaussian state-space model x_{k+1} = F x_k + w (w ~ N(0,Q)), z_k = H x_k + v (v ~ N(0,R)).

ops.name: laplace_inverse_talbot
ops.summary: Numerical inverse Laplace transform of a rational function F(s) = num(s)/den(s) (fixed Talbot method).

ops.name: lomb_scargle
ops.summary: Lomb–Scargle periodogram of an unevenly sampled time series (t, y) (with the time offset τ of Scargle 1982, after subtracting the mean).

ops.name: low_discrepancy
ops.summary: Low-discrepancy point sequence (n, dim) in [0, 1)^dim.

ops.name: mandelbrot_interior
ops.summary: Closed-form interior test for the main cardioid and the period-2 bulb.

ops.name: mat_cholesky
ops.summary: Cholesky factorisation ``A = L @ Lᵀ`` of a symmetric positive-definite matrix.

ops.name: mat_cond
ops.summary: Spectral (2-norm) condition number ``s_max / s_min`` — the numerical canary of the whole linalg family.

ops.name: mat_eig
ops.summary: Eigen-decomposition of a **general** square matrix ``A V = V diag(w)`` (complex in general).

ops.name: mat_eigh
ops.summary: Eigen-decomposition of a **symmetric** matrix (LAPACK ``syevd``).

ops.name: mat_expm
ops.summary: Matrix exponential e^A (Padé approximation + scaling-and-squaring, scipy).

ops.name: mat_logm
ops.summary: Principal matrix logarithm log A (the X with e^X = A whose eigenvalues have imaginary parts in (−π, π], scipy).

ops.name: mat_lstsq
ops.summary: Least-squares solution of an over-determined system ``A x ≈ b`` (LAPACK ``gelsd``, SVD-based).

ops.name: mat_lu
ops.summary: LU factorisation ``P @ A = L @ U`` (``L`` unit lower, ``U`` upper).

ops.name: mat_pinv
ops.summary: Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse via SVD, with the cutoff **explicit**.

ops.name: mat_qr
ops.summary: QR factorisation ``A = Q @ R`` (``Q`` with orthonormal columns, ``R`` upper triangular).

ops.name: mat_solve
ops.summary: Solve the square linear system ``A x = b`` (LAPACK ``gesv``, LU with partial pivoting).

ops.name: mat_svd
ops.summary: Singular value decomposition ``A = U @ diag(s) @ Vt`` (LAPACK ``gesdd``).

ops.name: mesh_euler_characteristic
ops.summary: V − E + F of a triangle mesh and, for a closed orientable surface, the genus g = (2 − χ)/2.

ops.name: mesh_torus
ops.summary: Closed triangle mesh (vertices, faces) of a torus (doughnut). Major radius R, tube radius r (R > r > 0).

ops.name: music_doa
ops.summary: MUSIC (Schmidt 1986): searches for the directions orthogonal to the noise subspace of the covariance.

ops.name: n_sources_mdl
ops.summary: Estimates the number of sources from snapshots by the MDL criterion (Wax & Kailath 1985).

ops.name: neighbour_index_gaps
ops.summary: How far apart *in index* are a point's nearest neighbours — parastichy as a number.

ops.name: nurbs_circle
ops.summary: A degree-2 NURBS that represents a circle exactly (Piegl & Tiller Example 7.1: the 4 corners and the midpoints of the 4 sides of a square, corner weights 1/√2).

ops.name: nurbs_curve
ops.summary: Evaluates a NURBS curve (weighted; in general it does not pass through the control points).

ops.name: nurbs_revolve
ops.summary: Surface of revolution obtained by sweeping a planar NURBS curve (r, z) 1 full turn around the z axis (Piegl & Tiller §8.5).

ops.name: nurbs_surface
ops.summary: Evaluates a NURBS surface (tensor product).

ops.name: ode_flow_states
ops.summary: Integrate a named vector field — the trajectory, with the order you paid for.

ops.name: ode_vector_field_grid
ops.summary: Sample a named field on a grid — a ``flow2d`` the existing viewers take.

ops.name: phyllotaxis_pattern
ops.summary: Vogel's spiral — the angle that packs best, and the spirals it makes.

ops.name: poly_eval
ops.summary: Evaluate a polynomial (coefficients highest-power-first) at *x*.

ops.name: poly_fit
ops.summary: Least-squares polynomial fit with its conditioning **on the record**.

ops.name: poly_roots
ops.summary: All roots of a polynomial (coefficients highest-power-first) — complex included.

ops.name: potential_flow_joukowski
ops.summary: Inviscid flow past a Joukowski aerofoil, as a complex velocity field.

ops.name: se3_exp
ops.summary: Exponential map of SE(3): 6-dimensional twist ξ = (v, ω) (translational velocity v, rotation vector ω) → 4×4 rigid-body transform.

ops.name: se3_log
ops.summary: Logarithm map of SE(3): 4×4 rigid-body transform → 6-dimensional twist ξ = (v, ω) (rotation angle < π). Gate: se3_log(se3_exp(ξ)) = ξ.

ops.name: space_filling_curve
ops.summary: Hilbert / Moore / scan orders on a ``2**order`` square — a permutation, checked.

ops.name: stat_chi2_gof
ops.summary: χ² goodness-of-fit test: whether the counts ``observed`` match the expected counts (uniform by default). Degrees of freedom = number of bins − 1.

ops.name: stat_correlation
ops.summary: Pearson correlation matrix of ``(N, D)`` observations → ``(D, D)``.

ops.name: stat_covariance
ops.summary: Sample covariance matrix of ``(N, D)`` observations → ``(D, D)``.

ops.name: stat_describe
ops.summary: Five-number-plus summary of a 1-D sample, as a plain dict.

ops.name: stat_histogram
ops.summary: Histogram of a 1-D sample with the binning **explicit**.

ops.name: stat_ks_test
ops.summary: Kolmogorov–Smirnov test. Given ``y``, a 2-sample test (whether both come from the same distribution); without it, goodness of fit to the standard normal distribution.

ops.name: stat_ttest_paired
ops.summary: Paired t-test: whether the mean of the differences d = x − y from measuring the same subjects 2 times is 0.

ops.name: stat_ttest_welch
ops.summary: Welch's t-test: the difference in means of 2 groups without assuming equal variances (degrees of freedom by Welch–Satterthwaite).

ops.name: stat_zscore
ops.summary: Standardise a 1-D sample: ``(x - mean) / std`` (population ``ddof=0``).

ops.name: tf_bilinear
ops.summary: Maps a continuous-time system to a discrete-time system with the Tustin (bilinear) transform s = K (z − 1)/(z + 1).

ops.name: tf_freq_response
ops.summary: Frequency response H(jω) (the content of a Bode plot). ω is in rad/s. The phase is in degrees, unwrapped to be continuous.

ops.name: tf_impulse_response
ops.summary: Impulse response h(t) = L⁻¹[H(s)] (t) (the strictly proper part; the delta of the direct feedthrough term is not returned).

ops.name: tf_poles_zeros
ops.summary: Poles, zeros, DC gain and stability of H(s) = num/den.

ops.name: tf_step_response
ops.summary: Unit step response y(t) = L⁻¹[H(s)/s] (t).

ops.name: ula_snapshots
ops.summary: Generates the complex snapshots (M, K) received by a uniform linear array (an input whose direction-of-arrival answer is known in advance).

ops.name: wave_dominant_frequency
ops.summary: Return the frequency, period and orientation of the strongest periodicity of an image (the largest non-DC 2-D FFT peak) (``table``).

ops.name: wave_fringe_period
ops.summary: The period of a striped image, measured back out of it (pixels).

ops.name: wave_grating_orders
ops.summary: Where a grating sends each order: ``d (sin_out - sin_in) = m lambda`` solved for the angle.

ops.name: wave_membrane_mode
ops.summary: One eigenmode of a vibrating **membrane** — the shape the sand draws.

ops.name: wave_mode_frequencies
ops.summary: The eigenvalue ladder of a membrane — a closed form you can check against.

ops.name: wave_nodal_lines
ops.summary: Where a signed field changes sign — the nodal set, as a mask.

ops.name: wave_two_slit
ops.summary: Two-slit interference on a screen — built from the physics, not the fringe formula.

ops.name: wavelet_filters
ops.summary: Builds the filters of the Daubechies orthonormal wavelet dbN by the textbook construction (spectral factorization).

ops.name: add_metrology_object_circle_measure
ops.summary: Adds a circle metrology object (add_metrology_object_circle_measure).

ops.name: add_metrology_object_ellipse_measure
ops.summary: Adds an ellipse metrology object (add_metrology_object_ellipse_measure). ``phi`` = orientation of the ``ra`` axis (from the col axis, in radians).

ops.name: add_metrology_object_generic
ops.summary: Adds a generic metrology object (add_metrology_object_generic).

ops.name: add_metrology_object_line_measure
ops.summary: Adds a line metrology object (add_metrology_object_line_measure). Returns the index.

ops.name: add_metrology_object_rectangle2_measure
ops.summary: Adds a rectangle metrology object (add_metrology_object_rectangle2_measure). ``phi`` = orientation of the ``l1`` side (from the col axis, in radians), ``l1``/``l2`` = half side lengths.

ops.name: align_metrology_model
ops.summary: Aligns all objects of the metrology model by translating them (align_metrology_model).

ops.name: apply_metrology_model
ops.summary: Measures subpixel edges along the normals of each metrology object's reference shape, refits the shape and returns the result (apply_metrology_model).

ops.name: create_metrology_model
ops.summary: Creates an empty metrology model (create_metrology_model).

ops.name: fuzzy_measure_pairing
ops.summary: Selects the edge pair that best matches a fuzzy criterion (expected width pair_size) (fuzzy_measure_pairing).

ops.name: gen_measure_arc
ops.summary: Defines a measurement arc (the profile is sampled at ≈1 px spacing in the circumferential direction) (gen_measure_arc). Number of samples n = round(|angle_extent|*radius)+1, ``spacing`` = arc length/(n-1).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('gen_measure_arc', center_row=<number>, center_col=<number>, radius=<number>, angle_start=<number>, angle_extent=<number>, width=<number>, shape=<number>)

ops.name: gen_measure_rectangle2
ops.summary: Defines a rotated measurement rectangle (the profile is sampled at 1 px spacing along the major axis in direction ``phi``) (gen_measure_rectangle2). Number of samples n = max(2, round(2*length1)+1); the start point lies
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('gen_measure_rectangle2', row=<number>, col=<number>, phi=<number>, length1=<number>, length2=<number>, shape=<number>)

ops.name: measure_pairs
ops.summary: Extracts pairs of rising/falling edges (the width of a structure) (measure_pairs). ``first``/``second`` = ``pos`` of each edge, ``width`` = width [px], ``first_point``/``second_point`` = (row, col).

ops.name: measure_pos
ops.summary: Extracts edge positions (subpixel) and amplitudes along the measurement line (measure_pos).

ops.name: mm_per_px_from_reference
ops.summary: Derives the pixel pitch in mm/px from a target of known size (scale bar, reference hole, gauge) — the calibration step.

ops.name: pixel_to_world
ops.summary: Converts one length measured in pixels to real-world mm (``value_px * mm_per_px``).

ops.name: table_px_to_mm
ops.summary: Adds mm columns to a measurement table (the return of ``measure_pairs`` / ``apply_metrology_model``).

ops.name: translate_measure
ops.summary: Translates a measurement object (translate_measure).

ops.name: band_snr
ops.summary: Measure what a clip's temporal band contains, and what it costs -> ``dict``.

ops.name: complex_steerable_decompose
ops.summary: Complex oriented sub-band decomposition of one frame -> ``dict``.

ops.name: complex_steerable_reconstruct
ops.summary: Invert :func:`complex_steerable_decompose` -> ``(H, W)`` real image.

ops.name: displacement_series

ops.name: motion_magnify

ops.name: phase_displacement

ops.name: synthesize_translation
ops.summary: A clip whose displacement is known in closed form -> ``(T, H, W)`` video.

ops.name: temporal_band_power
ops.summary: Per-pixel mean-square power inside a temporal band -> ``(H, W)`` map.

ops.name: temporal_bandpass
ops.summary: Ideal temporal band-pass of every pixel's time series -> ``(T, H, W)``.

ops.name: doe_box_behnken
ops.summary: Box-Behnken design (Box & Behnken 1960) for 3, 4 or 5 factors -> ``design``.

ops.name: doe_central_composite
ops.summary: Central composite design (Box & Wilson 1951) -> ``design``.

ops.name: doe_decode
ops.summary: ``design`` -> natural-unit matrix (n, k); or decode any coded point(s) with its ranges.

ops.name: doe_encode
ops.summary: Natural-unit settings (n, k) -> ``design`` with coded values (−1..+1 = lo..hi).

ops.name: doe_fractional_factorial
ops.summary: Regular two-level fractional factorial 2^(k-p) from generators (Box & Hunter 1961) -> ``design``.

ops.name: doe_lhs
ops.summary: Latin hypercube design (McKay, Beckman & Conover 1979) -> ``design``.

ops.name: doe_main_effects
ops.summary: Level means per factor — the response table of a designed experiment — with dispersion and SN.

ops.name: doe_morris
ops.summary: Morris one-at-a-time screening plan: ``r`` trajectories of k+1 runs -> ``design``.

ops.name: doe_orthogonal_array
ops.summary: Orthogonal array L4 / L8 / L9 / L12 / L16 / L18 / L27 from a published table -> ``design``.

ops.name: doe_saltelli
ops.summary: Sample matrices for Sobol' indices (Saltelli et al. 2010) -> ``design`` of n (k + 2) runs.

ops.name: feat_image_vector
ops.summary: Images -> feature table ``{"matrix" (N, F), "names", "units", ...}``, one row per image.

ops.name: mv_confounding
ops.summary: Collinearity index gamma_K (Brun, Reichert & Künsch 2001): which parameters the data can fix.

ops.name: mv_pca
ops.summary: Principal components of a table (samples x variables) and how many of them the data support.

ops.name: mv_pls
ops.summary: Partial least squares regression of Y on X with cross-validated Q^2, the Q^2 rule and VIP.

ops.name: mv_residual_pca
ops.summary: Do the residuals of a fitted model still carry structure? PCA of a residual matrix vs. noise.

ops.name: rsm_fit
ops.summary: Fit a response surface on a ``design`` (coded units): ANOVA, lack of fit, stationary point.

ops.name: sens_morris
ops.summary: Morris elementary effects -> mu, mu*, sigma per factor (Morris 1991; mu* Campolongo et al. 2007).

ops.name: sens_sobol
ops.summary: First-order and total Sobol' indices with bootstrap confidence intervals.

ops.name: abs_funct_1d
ops.summary: Absolute value of the y-values (HALCON ``abs_funct_1d``).

ops.name: bandpass
ops.summary: Butterworth band-pass between *low* and *high* Hz. Both edges must be inside ``(0, rate/2)``; same length contract as :func:`lowpass`.

ops.name: chirp_mass_from_track
ops.summary: Chirp mass and coalescence time from a gravitational-wave frequency track (t, f) by least squares.

ops.name: chirp_newtonian
ops.summary: Newtonian (0PN) inspiral waveform h₊(t) as a signal, with coalescence at the end of the array.

ops.name: coincidence_delay
ops.summary: Time difference (b − a) between the peaks of two SNR time series, to sub-sample precision.

ops.name: companding_mu_law
ops.summary: mu-law companding — the G.711 curve, used here on any 1-D signal.

ops.name: compose_funct_1d
ops.summary: Composition ``y1(y2)``: the values of *y2* used as positions into *y1* (HALCON ``compose_funct_1d``).

ops.summary: A 1-D function from equidistant samples (HALCON ``create_funct_1d_array``).

ops.name: create_funct_1d_pairs
ops.summary: A 1-D function from arbitrary ``(x, y)`` pairs, resampled to an equidistant grid (HALCON ``create_funct_1d_pairs``).

ops.name: derivate_funct_1d
ops.summary: First derivative by central differences (HALCON ``derivate_funct_1d``).

ops.name: distance_funct_1d
ops.summary: Distance between two functions on the same grid (HALCON ``distance_funct_1d``).

ops.name: envelope
ops.summary: Amplitude envelope via the analytic (Hilbert) signal — the shape of a knock / impact / acoustic-emission burst.

ops.name: find_peaks
ops.summary: Peak indices (scipy.signal.find_peaks) — impacts / defect echoes.

ops.name: funct_1d_to_pairs
ops.summary: The function as explicit ``(x, y)`` pairs (HALCON ``funct_1d_to_pairs``).

ops.name: get_pair_funct_1d
ops.summary: The ``(x, y)`` pair at *index* (HALCON ``get_pair_funct_1d``).

ops.name: get_y_value_funct_1d
ops.summary: The y-value at (fractional) position *x* (HALCON ``get_y_value_funct_1d``).

ops.name: highpass
ops.summary: Butterworth high-pass. Same Nyquist / length contract as :func:`lowpass`.

ops.name: integrate_funct_1d
ops.summary: Cumulative integral by the trapezoidal rule (HALCON ``integrate_funct_1d``).

ops.name: invert_funct_1d
ops.summary: Swap the roles of x and y: ``x = f^-1(y)`` (HALCON ``invert_funct_1d``).

ops.name: local_min_max_funct_1d
ops.summary: Indices of strict local maxima / minima (HALCON ``local_min_max_funct_1d``).

ops.name: local_std
ops.summary: Rolling standard deviation with a stated error bound.

ops.name: lowpass
ops.summary: Butterworth low-pass (scipy, zero-phase filtfilt). *cutoff* must be inside ``(0, rate/2)``; an out-of-Nyquist cutoff raises instead of passing the signal through. A signal too short for zero-phase filtfilt also raises (t

ops.name: match_funct_1d_trans
ops.summary: Best integer translation between two functions by correlation (HALCON ``match_funct_1d_trans``, translation only).

ops.name: matched_filter_snr
ops.summary: Matched-filter SNR time series |ρ(t)|, maximised over phase, as a signal.

ops.name: negate_funct_1d
ops.summary: Sign-flipped y-values (HALCON ``negate_funct_1d``).

ops.name: num_points_funct_1d
ops.summary: Number of samples (HALCON ``num_points_funct_1d``).

ops.name: optimal_snr
ops.summary: Optimal SNR of a template, σ = √(4∫|h̃|²/S df) (measurement).

ops.name: peak_subbin
ops.summary: Peak position **between** samples — the vertex of a fit through 3 points.

ops.name: point_spectrum
ops.summary: Periodogram of **event positions** — defects, impacts, counts, arrivals.

ops.name: psd_welch
ops.summary: One-sided Welch PSD as pairs (frequency [Hz], S [1/Hz]).

ops.name: quantize
ops.summary: Scalar quantiser with the error model stated, plus optional dither.

ops.name: read_audio
ops.summary: Read any audio format -> ``(x, rate)``. Uses ``soundfile`` if available (mp3/flac/ogg/…), else falls back to the stdlib WAV reader.

ops.name: read_wav
ops.summary: Read a WAV file (stdlib) -> ``(x float64 [-1,1], rate)``. Multi-channel is averaged to mono. Handles 8/16/32-bit PCM.

ops.name: resample
ops.summary: Resample a signal to *new_rate* (Fourier method).

ops.name: rms
ops.summary: RMS level. Scalar for the whole signal, or a framewise array when *frame* is given (a vibration/energy envelope over time).

ops.name: sample_funct_1d
ops.summary: Every *step*-th sample (HALCON ``sample_funct_1d``).

ops.name: scale_y_funct_1d
ops.summary: Linear map of the y-values, ``mult * y + add`` (HALCON ``scale_y_funct_1d``).

ops.name: signal_features
ops.summary: A compact acoustic/vibration feature vector for anomaly detection: ``rms``, ``peak``, ``crest_factor``, ``zcr``, ``spectral_centroid`` (Hz), ``peak_freq`` (Hz), ``bandwidth`` (Hz). All finite — a NaN / Inf sample raises

ops.name: smooth_funct_1d_gauss
ops.summary: Gaussian smoothing of a 1-D function (HALCON ``smooth_funct_1d_gauss``).

ops.name: smooth_funct_1d_mean
ops.summary: Iterated moving-average smoothing (HALCON ``smooth_funct_1d_mean``).

ops.name: spectrogram

ops.name: spectrum
ops.summary: Raw one-sided magnitude spectrum -> ``(freqs, magnitude)`` (``np.fft.rfft``).

ops.name: transform_funct_1d
ops.summary: Independent affine transform of x and y (HALCON ``transform_funct_1d``).

ops.name: whiten_by_psd
ops.summary: Whiten by the noise PSD (x_w = irfft(rfft(x)·√(2Δt/S(f)))).

ops.name: write_wav
ops.summary: Write a float ``[-1,1]`` mono signal to a 16-bit PCM WAV (stdlib). Non-finite samples raise (they would become garbage PCM).

ops.name: x_range_funct_1d
ops.summary: The x-domain ``(0.0, n - 1.0)`` (HALCON ``x_range_funct_1d``).

ops.name: y_range_funct_1d
ops.summary: The value range ``(min(y), max(y))`` (HALCON ``y_range_funct_1d``).

ops.name: zero_crossing_rate
ops.summary: Fraction of adjacent samples that change sign — a cheap pitch/noisiness cue.

ops.name: zero_crossings_funct_1d
ops.summary: Indices where the function changes sign (HALCON ``zero_crossings_funct_1d``).

ops.name: abbe_number
ops.summary: Refractive indices at the Fraunhofer lines, Abbe numbers (d and e systems) and partial dispersion P_g,F.

ops.name: abcd_matrix
ops.summary: Compose a paraxial system into one 2x2 ray-transfer (ABCD) matrix.

ops.name: abcd_trace
ops.summary: Propagate one paraxial ray through an ABCD matrix.

ops.name: acoustic_impedance_mismatch
ops.summary: Return the acoustic-impedance mismatch at normal incidence between two materials.

ops.name: afocal_system
ops.summary: Build an afocal system (telescope, beam expander): flag a given system as afocal, or make an ideal two-lens telescope (``table``).

ops.name: airy_pattern
ops.summary: The diffraction-limited PSF of a circular pupil (Airy pattern).

ops.name: airy_radius_um
ops.summary: Radius to the first dark ring of the Airy disc [µm] = 1.22 · λ · N (closed form).

ops.name: anaglyph_crosstalk
ops.summary: Return previews and wrong-eye/right-eye energy ratios.

ops.name: anaglyph_from_ods
ops.summary: Extract an ODS viewport pair and compose a colour-filter view.

ops.name: angular_spectrum_propagate
ops.summary: Exact scalar free-space propagation of a complex field (angular spectrum).

ops.name: aolp_to_azimuth
ops.summary: Turn the angle of linear polarisation into the two candidate azimuths of the surface normal (the pi ambiguity), diffuse and specular differing by 90 degrees.

ops.name: bandpass_spectrum
ops.summary: Transmittance of a band-pass filter (super-Gaussian).

ops.name: beamsplitter_branches
ops.summary: The two branches of a plate beamsplitter in a converging beam (``table``).

ops.name: beer_lambert_transmittance
ops.summary: Beer–Lambert internal transmittance T = exp(−σ·L). The green cast of coloured and thick glass.

ops.name: bend_singlet
ops.summary: A thin singlet of given focal length at a Coddington shape factor (``table``).

ops.name: blackbody_spectrum
ops.summary: Spectral radiance of a blackbody L(λ, T), in W m⁻² sr⁻¹ nm⁻¹ (Planck's law, SI 2019 constants).

ops.name: blast_normals
ops.summary: Lay the **non-directional micro-roughness** of bead blasting / a matte finish onto the normals.

ops.name: bokeh_shape
ops.summary: The out-of-focus footprint of a point source - the intersection of the pupil images, the cat's eye -> dict.

ops.name: brazilian_disc_stress
ops.summary: Closed-form plane stress σx, σy, τxy of a diametrically compressed disc (Brazilian disc) → dict.

ops.name: brewster_angle_deg
ops.summary: Brewster angle [deg] = atan(n2/n1) — at this angle the p-polarised reflection is exactly zero.

ops.name: calibration_views
ops.summary: Synthetic camera-calibration views of a planar target through the designed lens (``table``).

ops.name: camera_rays
ops.summary: Camera dict → rays for every pixel: origins (H·W, 3), directions (H·W, 3).

ops.name: camera_response_debevec
ops.summary: Inverse camera response from an exposure series by Debevec & Malik's least squares (``table``).

ops.name: camera_response_linear
ops.summary: Inverse response of a linear sensor: ``X = (Z − offset) / gain`` (``table``).

ops.name: camera_response_robertson
ops.summary: Inverse camera response by Robertson, Borman & Stevenson's alternating estimate (``table``).

ops.name: carbon_black_absorption
ops.summary: Absorption coefficient α [1/mm] added by carbon black (the pigment of black plastics).

ops.name: caustic_floor_segmentation
ops.summary: Segment the caustic lines of a floor irradiance image -> dict (mask, threshold, line period).

ops.name: caustic_irradiance
ops.summary: The irradiance a collimated light leaves on a flat floor below a wavy water surface -> dict.

ops.name: cavity_strain_transfer
ops.summary: Magnitude |H(f)| of the arm-cavity transfer function from strain h(f) to output phase (pairs).

ops.name: chief_ray
ops.summary: Trace the chief ray (through the stop centre) at one field (``table``).

ops.name: chief_ray_angle
ops.summary: The real chief ray from the object point at *field_mm* through the stop centre: its object-side angle (the telecentricity) and where it lands on the image.

ops.name: chromatic_confocal_limits

ops.name: chromatic_confocal_peaks
ops.summary: Pick the peak wavelengths of a return spectrum (one, or the two faces of a transparent body) to sub-bin precision.

ops.summary: Build the wavelength → focus-position calibration table (the ticks of the rainbow ruler) from an objective lens prescription.

ops.summary: Map peak wavelengths back to heights (z) through the calibration table and, for two peaks, give the thickness of the transparent layer.

ops.name: chromatic_confocal_spectrum
ops.summary: Synthesise the chromatic confocal return spectrum from the surface position and the layer stack (forward model).

ops.name: chromatic_shift
ops.summary: Focal shift, image-height shift and spot size versus wavelength (``table``).

ops.name: cie_illuminant_a
ops.summary: Relative spectral power distribution of CIE standard illuminant A (the CIE 15:2004 defining formula, 100 at 560 nm).

ops.name: cie_xyz_from_wavelength
ops.summary: Wavelength [nm] → the CIE 1931 2° colour-matching functions (x̄, ȳ, z̄). Returns the input shape plus a trailing 3.

ops.name: clearcoat_shade
ops.summary: Put a transparent top coat over the surface (car paint, ceramic glaze, glossy plastic).

ops.name: coaxial_illumination
ops.summary: Coaxial (half-mirror) lighting: the round-trip T*R budget and the image a camera sees (``table``).

ops.name: coherent_image
ops.summary: Coherent image intensity of an amplitude/phase object through a pupil (``image2d``).

ops.name: confocal_axial_response
ops.summary: Axial response I(z) of a confocal microscope (detected intensity against the defocus z [µm]) as pairs.

ops.name: corrosion_mask
ops.summary: The **mottling** of rust, patina and grime (a 0–1 mask).

ops.name: covers_sensor
ops.summary: Whether the lens covers that sensor (image circle versus diagonal).

ops.name: critical_angle_deg
ops.summary: Critical angle of total internal reflection [deg] = asin(n2/n1). Raises ValueError unless n1 > n2 (it does not exist otherwise).

ops.name: cubemap_from_equirect
ops.summary: Resample an equirectangular image into six cubemap faces.

ops.name: cubic_photoelastic_birefringence
ops.summary: Stress birefringence Δn and slow axis of a cubic crystal on a {100} plane (e.g. a Si wafer) → dict.

ops.name: cylinder_lens_caustic
ops.summary: The paraxial focus and the real-ray caustic of a cylinder (a rod or a bottle) in a collimated beam -> dict.

ops.name: czerny_turner_design
ops.summary: First-order design of a Czerny–Turner spectrometer (plane grating + two concave mirrors): camera focal length, coma-free mirror angle and the wavelength mapping.

ops.name: darkfield_scatter_relation
ops.summary: Converts between the dark field D (a visibility ratio) and the width σ of the scattering-angle distribution (published formula for Gaussian scattering).

ops.name: dataset_throughput
ops.summary: The result of :func:`inspection_dataset` → a measured summary of generation throughput.

ops.name: defect_contrast
ops.summary: Contrast of topographic and pigment defects under a light (``table``).

ops.name: defect_dataset
ops.summary: Synthetic defect images through a designed lens, with aligned masks (``table``).

ops.name: defocus_blur
ops.summary: Apply **depth-of-field blur** from a ground-truth depth map (ideal pinhole image → the image of a real lens).

ops.name: defocus_from_shift
ops.summary: Defocus wavefront error (waves at the pupil edge) of an axial focus shift.

ops.name: defocus_spot_vs_depth
ops.summary: RMS blur radius on the fixed image plane as the object moves by ±Δz (µm; the ray bundle is traced exhaustively over a grid of slopes).

ops.name: depth_of_field
ops.summary: Photographic depth of field: near limit, far limit and hyperfocal distance.

ops.name: diffraction_blur
ops.summary: Apply the **diffraction blur** set by the aperture (the Airy disc approximated by a Gaussian).

ops.name: distortion_map
ops.summary: Real chief-ray height versus the paraxial one, and the remap grid (``table``).

ops.name: dolp_to_zenith
ops.summary: Invert DoLP to the set of zenith angles that produce it — one for the diffuse model, two (straddling Brewster) for the specular model.

ops.summary: Integrates the differential phase (fringe phase shift φ) along the grating's sensitive direction back to the wavefront phase Φ [rad].

ops.name: drawing_dxf
ops.summary: Writes a drawing as DXF R12 (AC1009) ASCII (``text``) — the smallest complete file a CAD program accepts, standard library only.

ops.name: drawing_raster
ops.summary: Renders a drawing to an RGB image (uint8, (H, W, 3)) (``rgbimage``) — with matplotlib (optional dependency), paper size × *dpi*.

ops.name: drawing_svg
ops.summary: Writes a drawing as SVG text (``text``) — standard library only, coordinates in real millimetres, paper size = drawing × scale.

ops.name: dxf_entities
ops.summary: Reads the ENTITIES of a DXF (R12 ASCII; ``LWPOLYLINE`` from R2000 on is accepted too) back into drawing entities (``table``).

ops.name: edge_spread
ops.summary: Builds an ESF finer than a pixel from the ROI of a slanted edge (ISO 12233).

ops.name: emva_bspline_regression
ops.summary: Least-squares cubic B-spline fit and its slope (General section 6.6, Eqs. 44-49).

ops.name: emva_dark_current
ops.summary: Dark current (Section 7.1): the slope of a straight-line fit of the mean (and variance) of dark images against exposure time.

ops.name: emva_defect_pixels
ops.summary: Characterization of defect pixels (Section 8.8): logarithmic histogram (Eqs. 73–75) and accumulated histogram (Eq. 77), and the number of pixels exceeding a threshold.

ops.name: emva_dynamic_range
ops.summary: Dynamic range DR = μ_p.sat / μ_p.min (Eq. 28) as a ratio, in dB (20 log10) and in bits (log2).

ops.summary: Exposure needed for a given SNR, μ_p(SNR) = SNR²/(2η) (1 + √(1 + 4(σ²_d + σ²_q/K²)/SNR²)) (Eq. 25, the inverse of Eq. 21).

ops.name: emva_filter_distortion
ops.summary: How much in-camera linear preprocessing moves the EMVA 1288 Linear numbers: closed forms (this family's derivation, not equations of the standard).

ops.name: emva_general_nonuniformity
ops.summary: DSNU and PRNU in input (photon) units (General section 8, Eqs. 55, 56, 58, 59).

ops.name: emva_general_relative_qe
ops.summary: Quantum efficiency relative to the reference wavelength, η(λ)/η(λ_ref) (General section 9.4, Eqs. 73, 74).

ops.name: emva_general_sensitivity
ops.summary: Characteristic curve, input SNR, absolute sensitivity threshold, DR and dark noise in photons (General sections 2.1-2.4, 6.6-6.8).

ops.name: emva_highpass
ops.summary: Highpass filter that removes uneven illumination (section 8.1; the older version is appendix C.5, Eqs. 84-87).

ops.name: emva_linearity_error
ops.summary: Linearity error LE (Eqs. 58–63). Fits y = μ_y − μ_y.dark against exposure H **weighted by the relative deviation, 1/y²** (Eqs. 59–61), and takes as LE the mean absolute value of the relative deviation δy[i] = 100 (y − (a

ops.name: emva_noise_whiteness
ops.summary: Is the temporal noise independent between pixels (assumption 3 of Linear section 1.2) and between consecutive images (assumption 3 of Linear and General)?

ops.name: emva_pair_statistics
ops.summary: From 2 images taken at the same exposure, computes the mean, temporal variance and spatial variance (Eqs. 16, 18, 32).

ops.name: emva_photon_exposure
ops.summary: Mean photons per pixel from the sensor-plane irradiance, μ_p = A E t_exp/(hc/λ) (Eq. 3), in the standard's handy units (Eq. 4).

ops.name: emva_photon_transfer
ops.summary: Derives the system gain K and the dark noise σ_d from the photon transfer curve (Eqs. 50, 53, 54).

ops.name: emva_ptc_linearity_check
ops.summary: Is the photon transfer curve straight (section 6.6, Eq. 51)? The check for whether the Linear K may be used.

ops.name: emva_quantum_efficiency
ops.summary: Derives the quantum efficiency η from the slope of the response (characteristic curve) (Eqs. 49, 52).

ops.name: emva_sensitivity_threshold
ops.summary: Absolute sensitivity threshold (the exposure at which SNR = 1, Eqs. 26, 27).

ops.name: emva_snr_curve
ops.summary: SNR of the linear model (Eq. 21) and SNR of the ideal sensor (Eq. 23).

ops.name: emva_spatial_nonuniformity
ops.summary: DSNU and PRNU (Eqs. 33-42, 65-67).

ops.name: emva_spectrogram
ops.summary: Horizontal and vertical spectrograms (section 8.6, Eqs. 70-72).

ops.name: emva_total_snr
ops.summary: Total SNR including the spatial nonuniformity (section 8.5, Eqs. 68, 69).

ops.summary: Recover a Mueller matrix from intensities measured through known generator / analyser states (polarimetric least squares).

ops.name: mueller_partial_polarizer
ops.summary: Mueller matrix of a linear polariser with a finite extinction ratio (a linear diattenuator). → (4, 4), or (*shape, 4, 4) for an angle field.

ops.name: multilayer_reflectance
ops.summary: Spectral reflectance (or transmittance / absorptance) of a multilayer film as pairs (λ nm, value): the exact characteristic-matrix (transfer-matrix) solution.

ops.name: nir_model_info
ops.summary: One material of NIR_BAND_MODELS as a table with source grades (bands, components, water, scattering, refractive index).

ops.name: noncoaxial_drawing
ops.summary: Section / setup drawing of a folded system (``table``, a drawing dict) — the surfaces, mirrors, beamsplitters, image plane and rays of a ``raytrace3d`` system, projected onto the meridional plane in global coordinates.

ops.name: noncoaxial_example
ops.summary: A named non-coaxial example system (``table``): folds, a periscope, a beamsplitter, a tilted plate, Scheimpflug.

ops.name: noncoaxial_layout
ops.summary: Global pose of every record (``table``): surface vertices, rotation matrices, the axis polyline.

ops.name: noncoaxial_spot
ops.summary: RMS / geometric spot radius (mm) and centroid on the (possibly tilted) image plane (``table``).

ops.name: noncoaxial_system
ops.summary: Build a validated non-coaxial sequential system (``table``) — surfaces, coordinate breaks, folds, plates.

ops.name: noncoaxial_trace
ops.summary: Trace pupil-filling real-ray bundles through the 3-D system (``table``).

ops.name: observe_surface
ops.summary: **Assemble an observation optic and shoot the finished surface of a named material** (a one-line entry point).

ops.name: ocean_height_field
ops.summary: A Tessendorf (2001) FFT sea surface at time ``t`` -> dict (height, slopes, normal map, displacement).

ops.name: ocean_spectrum
ops.summary: One-dimensional wave spectrum S(omega) of a wind sea, with its significant height and peak period -> dict.

ops.name: oct_ascan
ops.summary: k-linear spectral interferogram → **A-scan** (reflection amplitude along depth, ``table``).

ops.name: oct_bscan
ops.summary: Bundle of B-scan spectral interferograms → **cross-sectional image** (depth × lateral, ``table``; declared in the ledger as a 20 log10 image, image2d).

ops.name: oct_bscan_boundaries
ops.summary: Trace interfaces laterally across a B-scan **image** (``image2d`` → ``table``). Also works on an instrument's output figure.

ops.name: oct_bscan_flatten
ops.summary: **Flatten** a B-scan along a surface and return the **laterally averaged depth profile** (``table`` → ``table``).

ops.name: oct_bscan_simulate
ops.summary: A **bundle of spectral interferograms forming a B-scan**, scanned laterally across a cross-section (``sample2d``) (``table``).

ops.name: oct_design
ops.summary: OCT performance in closed form **before measuring** (``table``): axial resolution, depth range, sensitivity roll-off, SNR, lateral resolution and depth of focus.

ops.name: oct_dispersion_broadening
ops.summary: How much an A-scan peak broadens from a dispersion mismatch, a material (length L, round trip) present only in the sample arm (``table``, closed form).

ops.name: oct_dispersion_compensate
ops.summary: Numerical dispersion compensation (``table`` → ``table``): turn the DC-removed, k-linear spectrum into an analytic signal and multiply by exp(−i(a2Δk² + a3Δk³)).

ops.name: oct_dispersion_estimate
ops.summary: Estimate the dispersion-compensation coefficients a2 and a3 from a measured spectrum (``table`` → ``table``).

ops.name: oct_from_spectra
ops.summary: Turn raw spectra recorded by an instrument into the table this family's ops read (``matrix`` → ``table``), the entry point for real devices and public data.

ops.name: oct_interferogram
ops.summary: The **spectral interferogram** of one OCT measurement of a layer stack (``sample``) (``table``).

ops.name: oct_k_linearize
ops.summary: Resample a spectral interferogram onto a **uniform k grid** (``table`` → ``table``).

ops.name: oct_layer_thickness
ops.summary: Interface peaks of an A-scan → **optical and physical layer thicknesses** (``table``). Refuses when the interfaces cannot be separated or seen.

ops.name: ods_depth_to_disparity
ops.summary: Convert radial depth to ODS horizontal pixel disparity.

ops.name: ods_disparity_to_depth
ops.summary: Convert ODS horizontal pixel disparity to radial depth.

ops.name: ods_render
ops.summary: Render ODS rays using ``scene_fn(origins, directions)``.

ops.name: omni_anaglyph_compose
ops.summary: Compose a colour-filter stereo image; Dubois matrices follow the 2001 least-squares paper.

ops.name: opd_map
ops.summary: Optical path difference over the exit pupil, in waves (``image2d``).

ops.name: opd_samples
ops.summary: OPD (waves) at grid pupil samples: returns ``(px, py, opd, valid)``.

ops.name: optical_budget
ops.summary: Work out the **resolution budget** of an observation optic in closed form (see whether it holds up before you shoot).

ops.name: optical_camera
ops.summary: Build an ideal pinhole from real specifications (focal length, pixel pitch, resolution, working distance).

ops.name: optimize_lens
ops.summary: Damped-least-squares (Levenberg–Marquardt) optimisation of a prescription (``table``).

ops.name: optimize_lens_operands
ops.summary: Minimise the operand-table merit function by Levenberg-Marquardt; glass can be a variable too (``table``).

ops.name: optscene_defect_mask
ops.summary: The **ground-truth mask of defect pixels** (H, W). Use this as the label for training and evaluation.

ops.name: optscene_depth
ops.summary: The **ground-truth depth** (H, W) [mm]. It is **z along the optical axis**, not the slant range from the viewpoint.

ops.name: optscene_instances
ops.summary: Defects returned **one instance at a time** (class, pixel mask, bounding box, area).

ops.name: optscene_mask
ops.summary: A bool **ground-truth mask** (H, W) of the pixels where primitive number ``index`` is visible.

ops.name: oren_nayar
ops.summary: Shading of a rough diffuse surface (Oren–Nayar). How paper, plaster, concrete and the Moon look.

ops.name: paraxial_trace
ops.summary: First-order properties of the prescription: focal lengths, pupils, image.

ops.name: pdh_error_signal
ops.summary: Pound-Drever-Hall error signal ε(δ) as a function of the detuning δ [Hz] from resonance (pairs).

ops.name: phase_function_hg
ops.summary: The Henyey-Greenstein phase function, normalised over the sphere -> dict.

ops.name: photoelastic_phase_estimate
ops.summary: Closed-form inversion of polarisation images to retardation δ and principal axis θ → dict.

ops.name: photoelastic_polarization_images
