ops.summary: Images of a specimen under circularly polarised light taken by a polarisation camera (0/45/90/135 deg) or a six-intensity polarimeter → (K, H, W).

ops.name: photoelastic_retardation
ops.summary: Stress-optic law of an isotropic material δ = 2π t C (σ1−σ2)/λ → dict (rad, nm, fringe order and material fringe value).

ops.name: pixel_shift_capture
ops.summary: Capture with a shifted sensor: integrate the scene **exactly** over the pixel aperture (a square box) and return Bayer or monochrome raw frames.

ops.name: pixel_shift_merge
ops.summary: Merge pixel-shift frames by binning them onto the grid with the **nominal** shifts. No interpolation (only the mean of the samples at each grid point).

ops.name: pixel_shift_motion_mask
ops.summary: Map of moved pixels ``(H·scale, W·scale)`` (1.0 = moved, 0.0 = static or undecidable).

ops.name: pixel_shift_pattern
ops.summary: Nominal pixel-shift sequence ``(N, 2)`` (dr, dc) [sensor pixels] with the actuator error added.

ops.name: pixel_shift_resolution_budget
ops.summary: Closed-form budget of whether pixel shift raises resolution (lens-limited or pixel-limited).

ops.name: plate_focus_shift
ops.summary: Focus shift and spherical aberration of imaging through a plane-parallel plate (wafer, window, cover glass), in closed form.

ops.name: plenoptic_capture
ops.summary: Trace a raw plenoptic frame and its white calibration image.

ops.name: plenoptic_decode
ops.summary: Rectify a calibrated raw frame and return ``L[v,u,y,x]``.

ops.name: plenoptic_mla_calibrate
ops.summary: Fit a rotated rectangular lenslet lattice to peaks of a white frame.

ops.name: plenoptic_refocus_depth
ops.summary: Convert light-field refocus slope(s) to object distance in metres.

ops.name: plenoptic_system
ops.summary: Assemble a main lens, MLA and sensor and report F-number matching.

ops.name: polariscope_intensity
ops.summary: Closed-form intensity of plane and circular polariscopes in dark and bright field (isochromatics and isoclinics).

ops.name: polarization_demosaic
ops.summary: Split a polarisation-sensor mosaic into the four analyser images.

ops.name: polarization_demosaic_color
ops.summary: Split a **colour** polarisation-sensor mosaic (Sony IMX250MYR family, a 4x4 block = a 2x2 Bayer block whose every colour site is itself a 2x2 block of polarisers) into four RGB images: ``(4, H, W, 3)`` in :data:`POLARIZA

ops.name: predict_fringe_phase_error
ops.summary: Predict, per camera pixel, the fringe-phase bias and height error that interreflection causes in phase-shifting profilometry, from the light-transport matrix.

ops.name: principal_stress
ops.summary: Principal stresses σ1 ≥ σ2 of a plane stress state, their difference, and the direction of σ1 (isoclinic angle) → dict.

ops.name: prism_min_deviation_deg
ops.summary: A prism's angle of minimum deviation [deg]. It varies with wavelength through the **dispersion of real glass** — that is why you see a rainbow.

ops.name: psf_from_opd
ops.summary: Diffraction PSF of the real, aberrated pupil (``image2d``, sums to 1).

ops.name: psf_to_mtf
ops.summary: Radially-averaged MTF of a measured point-spread function.

ops.name: pupil_blur
ops.summary: Blur an image with the PSF of a pupil shape at one wavelength band.

ops.name: pupil_psf
ops.summary: Diffraction PSF of an **arbitrary pupil shape** with defocus (sums to 1).

ops.name: quantum_noise_budget
ops.summary: Quantum noise of a conventional (no signal recycling) Fabry-Perot Michelson — shot, radiation pressure and the standard quantum limit.

ops.name: radiosity_patches
ops.summary: Build a set of flat radiosity patches (``rad_patches`` table) from polygons or from an optscene scene.

ops.name: radiosity_progressive_3d
ops.summary: Progressive-refinement radiosity (Cohen et al. 1988, shooting, eqs. 7–8) on a 3-D patch set, with the evidence that it converged.

ops.name: random_defects
ops.summary: Create **random defects** on a part (scratches, cracks, pits, stains, dents, foreign matter).

ops.name: ray_aiming
ops.summary: How well the pupil rays reach the stop at one field: counts, residual and pupil extent (``table``).

ops.name: ray_bundle
ops.summary: Trace a pupil-filling bundle at one field; returns the raw trace plus ``image_xy`` (N,2), ``chief_xy`` (2,), ``pupil`` (N,2) normalised coordinates and ``opl0`` (start-of-ray optical path offsets).

ops.name: ray_fan
ops.summary: Transverse ray aberration along one pupil diameter (``pairs``).

ops.name: read_glass_catalog_agf
ops.summary: Read a glass catalogue (the .agf form of optical design software) into a list of material records (table).

ops.name: reflect_rays
ops.summary: Specular reflection d − 2(d·n)n. The partner of ``glassmirror.refract_rays`` (the reflecting side was missing).

ops.name: refract_rays
ops.summary: The vector form of Snell refraction. **Total internal reflection is decided per ray**; returns (direction, TIR mask).

ops.name: refracted_view
ops.summary: Where an underwater point appears to a camera above a flat or wavy surface (Fermat's principle) -> dict.

ops.name: register_light
ops.summary: Register a light you have into the catalogue (enter the data-sheet values as they are).

ops.name: relative_illumination
ops.summary: Natural vignetting: relative image-plane illuminance versus field angle.

ops.name: render_compare_prescriptions
ops.summary: Render the same scene through two or more prescriptions and tabulate how good each picture is -> dict.

ops.name: render_ghost_overlay
ops.summary: The two-reflection ghosts of a bright point, as electrons on the sensor -> dict.

ops.name: render_optscene
ops.summary: Shoot **for inspection**: place real luminaires in physical units and count the direct light (with ground truth).

ops.name: render_optscene_gi
ops.summary: Inspection render with interreflection: the photometry of ``render_optscene`` plus n bounces (or the converged sum) between Lambertian patches.

ops.name: render_scene_through_lens
ops.summary: Photograph a :func:`lens_scene` through the prescription *system*: sensor-side ray tracing -> dict.

ops.name: render_studio
ops.summary: Draw a **picture to show**: environment light, interreflection, refraction and dispersion (no photometric ground truth).

ops.name: render_through_lens
ops.summary: Render an ideal irradiance image as the sensor behind *system* would record it (``image2d``).

ops.name: render_transport
ops.summary: Render camera images of a concave Lambertian cross-section under projector patterns, through the light-transport matrix (direct + interreflection).

ops.name: retardation_convert
ops.summary: Unit conversion of a retardation (rad / deg / nm / waves = fringe order).

ops.name: retardation_from_birefringence
ops.summary: Retardation from a birefringence Δn → dict (returns rad, nm and fringe order side by side).

ops.name: retardation_unwrap_multiwavelength
ops.summary: Absolute retardation (nm) from wrapped retardations at several wavelengths (assuming no dispersion) → dict.

ops.name: rough_transmission
ops.summary: Split the transmission of ground glass into a "straight-through" and a "diffuse" component.

ops.name: s_psnr
ops.summary: Compute PSNR at deterministic near-uniform sphere samples.

ops.name: scattering_phase_petzold
ops.summary: The measured volume scattering function of natural waters (Petzold 1972) as a phase function -> dict.

ops.name: scene_box
ops.summary: An axis-aligned box part (AABB). ``half_size_mm`` is the half size along each axis [mm].

ops.name: scene_cylinder
ops.summary: A finite cylinder parallel to the z-axis (with end caps). **The shape a machining finish actually sits on.**

ops.name: scene_difference
ops.summary: Cut ``cavity`` out of ``solid`` (the CSG difference). **The only way to make a hollow part.**

ops.name: scene_material
ops.summary: Make one material. ``kind`` is one of three: lambert / conductor / dielectric.

ops.name: scene_plane
ops.summary: A horizontal plane at z = ``z_mm`` (a stage or conveyor). ``half_size_mm`` makes it a finite sheet.

ops.name: scene_radiance
ops.summary: Radiance along object-space rays hitting a :func:`lens_scene` -> dict.

ops.name: scene_sphere
ops.summary: A sphere part. ``center_mm`` is (x, y, z) [mm] and ``radius_mm`` > 0.

ops.name: scheimpflug_tilt
ops.summary: Scheimpflug condition for a tilted object plane (``table``; closed form, optionally real rays).

ops.name: seidel_coefficients
ops.summary: Third-order (Seidel) aberration sums in ``per_surface`` and ``total``.

ops.name: sellmeier
ops.summary: A dispersive medium from three-term Sellmeier constants (``table``).
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('sellmeier', B1=<number>, B2=<number>, B3=<number>, C1=<number>, C2=<number>, C3=<number>)

ops.name: sensor_capture
ops.summary: Radiance → the output of a real sensor (shot noise, read noise, saturation, quantisation).

ops.name: sensor_catalog
ops.summary: Data sheet of real sensors (with Basler's EMVA1288 measurements).

ops.name: sensor_diagonal_mm
ops.summary: The sensor diagonal [mm]. Compare it with the lens's image circle to see **whether it is covered**.

ops.name: sensor_spec
ops.summary: An image sensor's specification. It holds only the values on the side that decides **the number of electrons**.

ops.name: separate_direct_global
ops.summary: Separate direct and global (interreflection) components from images under shifted high-frequency patterns, from per-pixel L_max and L_min (Nayar et al. 2006).

ops.name: set_vignetting
ops.summary: Compute the vignetting factors that remove every aperture-clipped ray, as "set vignetting" does (``table``).

ops.name: sfp_disambiguate
ops.summary: Pick one normal per pixel from the candidate set of :func:`sfp_normals`, using a stated prior — convexity with Brewster-ridge segmentation, or a coarse depth / normal map.

ops.name: sfp_dolp_model
ops.summary: Degree of linear polarisation of reflected (specular) or emitted (diffuse) light versus zenith angle, from the Fresnel equations.

ops.name: sfp_estimate_index
ops.summary: Estimate the refractive index from DoLP observed at known zenith angles — a least-squares fit of the Fresnel curve, plus Brewster's ``n = tan(theta_B)`` at the DoLP maximum for the specular model.

ops.name: sfp_height
ops.summary: Integrate a normal map to a height map with Frankot-Chellappa on a mirror-extended domain, so the periodic boundary of the FFT does not bend the result.

ops.name: sfp_normals
ops.summary: From a polariser sweep to the explicit set of candidate surface normals per pixel — 2 for the diffuse model, 4 for the specular model (2 zeniths x 2 azimuths).

ops.name: sfp_render
ops.summary: Render the images a 4-direction polarisation camera records of a dielectric surface with the given normal map (the forward model of shape from polarisation).

ops.name: sfr_from_edge
ops.summary: Derives the SFR (MTF measured from an edge) from the ESF.

ops.name: sheen_shade
ops.summary: The **rim sheen** of cloth (velvet, satin). The more grazing to the view, the brighter.

ops.name: silicon_free_carrier_absorption
ops.summary: Free-carrier absorption α_fc(λ) [1/cm] of doped silicon as pairs (λ [nm], α).

ops.name: silicon_photodiode_qe
ops.summary: External quantum efficiency (electrons per photon) of a Si photodiode, from the n,k of Si.

ops.name: silicon_piezo_optic_coefficients
ops.summary: Piezo-optic coefficients π11−π12 and π44 [Pa⁻¹] of single-crystal silicon, returned with their source → dict.

ops.name: slab_transmittance
ops.summary: The transmittance of a parallel plate (window glass). Includes **multiple reflections at both faces** and internal absorption.

ops.name: snell_window
ops.summary: Snell's window seen from a point under the surface, and the apparent depth of a flat interface -> dict.

ops.name: solid_angle_boundaries
ops.summary: Closed-form slope thresholds of a smooth specular facet (``table``).

ops.name: solid_angle_brightness
ops.summary: Brightness of a smooth or rough specular facet versus its slope (``table``).

ops.name: solid_angle_light
ops.summary: A light defined by the cone of directions it delivers to every point (``table``).

ops.name: solid_angle_render
ops.summary: Image of a normal map under a cone light through a lens of NA *view_na* (``image2d``).

ops.name: solid_angle_sweep
ops.summary: Contrast of a facet against flat ground versus the illumination half-angle (``pairs``).

ops.name: speckle_field
ops.summary: Laser speckle intensity from a rough surface seen through a circular pupil (``image2d``).

ops.name: speckle_reduction
ops.summary: Predicted speckle contrast after reduction (``table``).

ops.name: speckle_statistics
ops.summary: First- and second-order statistics of a speckle intensity image (``table``).

ops.name: spectral_integral
ops.summary: Wavelength integral of a curve ∫ s(λ) dλ (trapezoid rule, λ in nm). Given an interval, only inside it (ends linearly interpolated).

ops.name: spectral_integral_table
ops.summary: Build a reusable cumulative trapezoid table for repeated band integrals.

ops.name: spectral_product
ops.summary: Product of two curves on the wavelengths of *a* (*b* linearly interpolated). Multiply source × transmittance × QE one at a time.

ops.name: spectral_reflectance_from_material
ops.summary: Diffuse reflectance spectrum of a grain or fragment from the material table's near-infrared absorption bands (the observed-object side).

ops.name: spectral_stats
ops.summary: Summary of a curve: peak wavelength and value, centroid wavelength, full width at half maximum (crossings by linear interpolation), integral.

ops.name: spectrometer_bandpass
ops.summary: Spectrometer bandpass (FWHM of the instrument line shape) per wavelength, from the slit, the pixels and diffraction.

ops.name: spectrometer_slit_image
ops.summary: Trace the image of a long slit in 3-D and report smile (spectral-line curvature) and keystone (wavelength-dependent spatial magnification).

ops.name: spectrometer_spectrum
ops.summary: Input spectrum → detector pixel readings, with higher-order images overlapping the first order.

ops.name: spectrum_to_srgb
ops.summary: Spectral reflectance → **linear sRGB** (before gamma). Normalised so a white surface (reflectance 1) becomes (1,1,1).

ops.name: spot_diagram
ops.summary: Transverse ray intersections on the image plane for one field point.

ops.name: spot_stats
ops.summary: RMS / geometric spot radius (mm) and centroid for one field point (``table``).

ops.name: stereo360_sbs
ops.summary: Pack a panorama pair side by side.

ops.name: stereo360_top_bottom
ops.summary: Pack a panorama pair top and bottom.

ops.name: stereo_pack
ops.summary: Pack two eye images in a named display layout.

ops.name: stereo_parallax_budget
ops.summary: Report physical parallax and the common one- and three-percent limits.
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('stereo_parallax_budget', disparity_px=<number>, width_px=<number>, viewing_distance_m=<number>, screen_width_m=<number>, ipd_m=<number>)

ops.name: stokes_analyze
ops.summary: Read a Stokes vector: degree of polarisation, azimuth, ellipticity.

ops.name: stokes_from_jones
ops.summary: Jones vector -> Stokes vector (the four measurable intensities).

ops.name: subsurface_approx
ops.summary: An approximation of translucent wrap-around light (leaves, skin, marble, milky plastic).

ops.name: surface_defect
ops.summary: **Paste a 2-D defect map onto a part's surface** (it eats the output of ``defectgen`` directly).

ops.name: surface_finish
ops.summary: Cut a **machining lay** into a part's surface (turning marks, hairline, knurl, matte blast, grinding marks).

ops.name: surface_reflectance
ops.summary: Residual reflectance of one surface from the material table and its coating (``table``).

ops.name: svg_entities
ops.summary: Reads an SVG (the shape ``drawing_svg`` writes: ``line`` / ``polyline`` / ``polygon`` / ``circle`` / ``path`` with M…A… and M…L… / ``text``) back into drawing entities (``table``), flipping y back to the drawing model's

ops.name: talbot_carpet
ops.summary: Talbot carpet: the intensity I(x, z) behind a binary grating (π phase, π/2 phase or absorption) in closed form as a sum over diffraction orders.

ops.name: talbot_grating_design
ops.summary: Grating-interferometer geometry: self-image distances of the first grating (fractional Talbot distances), fringe and analyser-grating periods, source-grating period (closed form).

ops.name: talbot_source_visibility
ops.summary: How much the fringe visibility drops for a given source size and source grating (Lau condition), in closed form as an incoherent sum.

ops.name: tangent_field
ops.summary: Build the **direction of the lay** as a tangent field of (H, W, 3).

ops.name: tdi_snr
ops.summary: SNR of a TDI sensor for each stage count N (``table``) — the EMVA 1288 linear model scaled by the number of stages.

ops.name: tdi_sync_mtf
ops.summary: MTF of the blur caused by a TDI synchronisation error and by yaw (a skewed web) (closed form, ``table``).

ops.name: telecentric_lens
ops.summary: Prescriptions of three imaging lenses made from the same singlet by moving only the stop (a `raytrace.lens_system` table).

ops.name: telecentricity_error
ops.summary: How differently the same dimension reads on the image when it sits on the upper and lower faces of a step of *step_height_mm*.

ops.name: tem_amorphous_film
ops.summary: Projected potential of an amorphous film in V Å (the standard specimen for Thon rings, ``image2d``).

ops.name: tem_ctf
ops.summary: 2-D contrast transfer function (DC at the centre, ``fftshift`` order, shape ``shape``).

ops.name: tem_ctf_correct
ops.summary: CTF correction (``image2d``). ``method="phase_flip"``: F⁻¹[ F(I − ⟨I⟩) · sign(CTF) ] (phase flipping, amplitudes unchanged) / ``"wiener"``: F⁻¹[ F(I − ⟨I⟩) · CTF / (CTF² + 1/snr) ].

ops.name: tem_ctf_estimate
ops.summary: Estimate defocus (and astigmatism) from the Thon rings in the power spectrum of a micrograph (table).

ops.name: tem_ctf_profile
ops.summary: 1-D radial CTF curve (with envelopes) and a table of its zeros.

ops.name: tem_image_weak_phase
ops.summary: TEM bright-field image (intensity with mean 1, ``image2d``) from a projected potential v_z in V Å.

ops.name: tem_multislice
ops.summary: Simple multislice (Cowley–Moodie, in Kirkland's form): returns the exit wave (table).

ops.name: tem_power_spectrum
ops.summary: Average of tiled periodograms (Welch, Hann window) as a 2-D array in ``fftshift`` order (``image2d``).

ops.name: tem_projected_potential
ops.summary: Atom positions to the potential projected along z, v_z(x, y) in V Å (periodic boundary, ``image2d``).

ops.name: tem_scherzer
ops.summary: Scherzer defocus and point resolution (table).

ops.name: tem_wavelength
ops.summary: Electron wavelength (with the relativistic correction) and interaction constant for an accelerating voltage ``kv`` in kV, as a table.

ops.name: thermo_optic_coefficient
ops.summary: dn/dT (absolute, in vacuum) of a glass and the index change Δn from the reference temperature, by the catalogue formula A.

ops.name: thick_lens
ops.summary: Closed-form thick lens in air: EFL, back/front focal lengths, principal points.

ops.name: thin_film_reflectance
ops.summary: The spectral reflectance of a thin film (thickness d, index n_film). The exact characteristic-matrix solution (all multiple reflections included).

ops.name: thin_film_rgb
ops.summary: Normal map + view → the **colour of thin-film interference**, (H, W, 3) in linear sRGB.

ops.name: thin_lens
ops.summary: Gaussian thin-lens imaging: where the image lands and how big it is.

ops.name: through_focus_mtf
ops.summary: Tangential and sagittal MTF at chosen spatial frequencies for a range of image-plane positions (``table``).

ops.name: tilted_plate_shift
ops.summary: Plane-parallel plate tilted by θ: lateral shift, focus shifts and astigmatism (``table``, closed form).

ops.name: tof_multipath_phase
ops.summary: Continuous-wave time-of-flight depth when several light paths reach one pixel: the phase of the phasor sum, and its bias against the direct path.

ops.name: tof_transport_depth
ops.summary: AMCW time-of-flight depth of a concave Lambertian cross-section (a room corner) with every interreflection delayed by its path length: complex radiosity, per-pixel depth bias.

ops.name: tolerance_analysis
ops.summary: Monte-Carlo manufacturing tolerances + per-parameter sensitivities (``table``).

ops.name: tolerance_compensators
ops.summary: Describe deterministic bounded re-optimisation variables in lensopt grammar.

ops.name: tolerance_criteria
ops.summary: Validate performance criteria and their optional ``min``/``max`` limits.

ops.name: tolerance_monte_carlo
ops.summary: Run deterministic fail-closed Monte Carlo and report yield with Wilson 95 % bounds.

ops.name: tolerance_report
ops.summary: Create a compact assembly report as a dict or plain text.

ops.name: tolerance_sensitivity
ops.summary: Central differences, distribution-aware linear RSS, and inverse tolerances.

ops.name: tolerance_table
ops.summary: Build validated tolerance rows, one independent manufacturing variable per row.

ops.name: tolerance_table_from_zmx
ops.summary: Read tolerance NOTE lines written by :func:`tolerance_table_zmx`.

ops.name: tolerance_table_zmx
ops.summary: Serialise rows as NOTE lines; public native TOL syntax was not assumed.

ops.name: trace_rays
ops.summary: Shoot a bundle of rays and return the first intersection (the public op the renderers are built on).

ops.name: trace_sensor_rays
ops.summary: Trace rays from sensor points through exit-pupil points **backwards** to object space -> dict.

ops.name: transport_matrix_radiosity
ops.summary: Light-transport matrix of a Lambertian concave cross-section: radiosity B = T E with T = (I − diag(ρ)F)^-1 diag(ρ).

ops.name: triangulation_speckle_limit
ops.summary: Speckle floor of laser triangulation (``table``): ``δz = C λ / (2π sin u_obs sin θ)``.

ops.name: underwater_image
ops.summary: The image of a scene recorded through water (revised Jaffe-McGlamery model) -> dict.

ops.name: underwater_inspection_image
ops.summary: A hull or pipe inspection image: a lamp at the camera lights a wall through water -> dict (image, per-pixel SNR).

ops.name: veiling_glare_index
ops.summary: Veiling glare (stray light) index: mean brightness at the centers of the black spots / mean brightness of the white background (following the approach of ISO 9358).

ops.name: video360_tile_coverage
ops.summary: Report which longitude-latitude streaming tiles a view path touches.

ops.name: video360_viewport_track
ops.summary: Extract a moving viewport from an equirectangular frame sequence.

ops.name: viewport_from_equirect
ops.summary: Extract a rectilinear viewer viewport from an equirectangular image.

ops.name: vignetting_vs_field
ops.summary: For each object height, the solid angle (area in slope space) of the bundle that reaches the image, relative to on axis (vignetting).

ops.name: vision_layout
ops.summary: Bundle sensor, lens, light and scene, and return the **derived quantities in closed form**.

ops.name: vision_setup_drawing
ops.summary: Machine-vision setup drawing (``table``, a drawing dict) — side and top views drawn from ``optscene.vision_layout``.

ops.name: ward_anisotropic
ops.summary: Ward's anisotropic reflection (an elliptical-Gaussian microfacet). The **stretched highlight** of a hairline finish.

ops.name: water_attenuation
ops.summary: Absorption, scattering and diffuse attenuation of water, and the transmittance over depth -> dict.

ops.name: wavefront_from_opd
ops.summary: OPD map → Zernike coefficients (waves) → RMS / PV / Strehl, in one call (``table``).

ops.name: wavefront_stats
ops.summary: Wavefront error statistics from a Zernike expansion: RMS, PV and Strehl.

ops.name: weave_normals
ops.summary: The normal field of a weave (cloth, carbon fibre, wire mesh). Two orthogonal periodic ridges.

ops.name: wet_dry_inspection_pair
ops.summary: The same textured plate rendered dry and wet, and the contrast of its defect in each -> dict.

ops.name: wet_surface_appearance
ops.summary: The darkening and the gloss of a surface under a thin water film (Lekner & Dorf 1988; Twomey et al. 1986) -> dict.
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('wet_surface_appearance', albedo=<number>, roughness=<number>, water_film_um=<number>, view_deg=<number>, light_deg=<number>)

ops.name: wetness
ops.summary: The base colour of a wet surface. **The diffuse gets darker** (and the specular grows).

ops.name: with_aiming
ops.summary: Copy of *system* with a ray-aiming mode and/or vignetting factors set (``table``).

ops.name: with_wavelength
ops.summary: The same prescription evaluated at another wavelength (indices re-resolved; default the F line).

ops.name: wood_grain
ops.summary: Build the **colour modulation** of wood grain (annual rings) and the **direction of its fibres**.

ops.name: ws_psnr
ops.summary: Compute cosine-latitude weighted spherical PSNR.

ops.name: anscombe_inverse
ops.summary: Invert :func:`anscombe_transform` — algebraically, or without bias.

ops.name: anscombe_transform
ops.summary: Anscombe variance-stabilising transform: Poisson counts -> ~unit-variance.

ops.name: dtof_cube_depth
ops.summary: Depth map from a ``(H, W, T)`` photon histogram cube — the dToF inversion.

ops.name: dtof_cube_simulate
ops.summary: Synthesise the ``(H, W, T)`` photon histogram cube a SPAD array produces.

ops.name: dtof_depth
ops.summary: Distance from a photon arrival-time histogram: ``d = c*t/2``.

ops.name: lifetime_fit
ops.summary: Mono-exponential fluorescence lifetime from a TCSPC decay histogram.

ops.name: lifetime_phasor
ops.summary: Phasor (frequency-domain) representation of a decay — the fit-free view.

ops.name: photon_sample
ops.summary: Poisson-sample an expected-photon image into an actual photon count image.

ops.name: photon_statistics
ops.summary: Poisson statistics of a photon-count frame: is it really shot-noise limited?

ops.name: photon_uncertainty
ops.summary: Per-pixel Poisson error bar of a photon-count frame.

ops.name: spad_deadtime_apply
ops.summary: Distort a true photon rate by the detector's dead time (counts lost).

ops.name: spad_deadtime_correct
ops.summary: Recover the true photon rate from a dead-time-distorted measured rate.

ops.name: tcspc_background_subtract
ops.summary: Remove the ambient-light / dark-count floor from an arrival-time histogram.

ops.name: tcspc_coates_correct
ops.summary: Undo TCSPC pile-up exactly (Coates's estimator) — the early-photon bias.

ops.name: tcspc_irf_convolve
ops.summary: Blur an arrival-time histogram by the instrument response (timing jitter).

ops.name: tcspc_simulate
ops.summary: Synthesise a single-pixel photon arrival-time histogram with a known answer.

ops.name: tcspc_stats
ops.summary: Descriptors of an arrival-time histogram: peak, centroid, width, background.

ops.name: correlation_quality
ops.summary: A ZNCC map that returns, point by point, **how well** a given displacement field matches.

ops.name: piv_cross_correlate
ops.summary: Computes the displacement field by per-window cross-correlation. Returns ``(flow, info)``.

ops.name: piv_deform_pass
ops.summary: 1 pass with window deformation. Correlates only after **first warping the images themselves** with the predicted displacement.

ops.name: piv_divergence
ops.summary: Divergence ``d(dy)/dy + d(dx)/dx``. **0 if the flow is incompressible** — usable as an independent cross-check.

ops.name: piv_ensemble_correlate
ops.summary: Searches for the peak **after summing** the correlation maps (ensemble correlation).

ops.name: piv_error_stats
ops.summary: Breakdown of the difference from the ground truth. Returns **bias and scatter separately**.

ops.name: piv_flow_magnitude
ops.summary: ``sqrt(dy^2 + dx^2)``. A **one-way** conversion that discards the direction.

ops.name: piv_flow_to_rgbimage
ops.summary: Standard flow visualisation with hue = direction and brightness = speed. Returns ``(h, w, 3)``.

ops.name: piv_line_integral_convolution
ops.summary: Line integral convolution (LIC) — an image whose pattern is white noise blurred along the flow.

ops.name: piv_multipass
ops.summary: Multi-pass PIV that steps down from coarse windows to fine windows. Returns ``(flow, info)``.

ops.name: piv_outlier_mask
ops.summary: Finds outlier vectors with the normalised median test (Westerweel & Scarano 2005).

ops.name: piv_peak_locking
ops.summary: Strength of peak locking: how far the distribution of the fractional parts deviates from uniform.

ops.name: piv_q_criterion
ops.summary: Q criterion ``-tr(J^2)/2``. It is positive where **rotation exceeds strain**.

ops.name: piv_quiver
ops.summary: Arrow plot (MATLAB's ``quiver``). Returns ``(h*upsample, w*upsample, 3)``.

ops.name: piv_replace_outliers
ops.summary: Fills outliers from their neighbourhood. With ``method="nan"`` they are **not filled but marked as missing**.

ops.name: piv_sample_at_windows
ops.summary: Drops a per-pixel field ``(2, H, W)`` onto the grid of window centers (nearest neighbor).

ops.name: piv_strain_rate
ops.summary: Magnitude of the strain rate ``sqrt(2 e_ij e_ij)``. It is 0 for a rigid-body rotation.

ops.name: piv_streamline_image
ops.summary: Streamline plot (MATLAB's ``streamslice``). Returns ``(h*upsample, w*upsample, 3)``.

ops.name: piv_streamlines
ops.summary: Traces streamlines with RK4 (corresponds to MATLAB's ``stream2`` / ``streamslice``).

ops.name: piv_swirling_strength
ops.summary: Swirling strength λ_ci — the magnitude of the imaginary part of the complex eigenvalues of the velocity-gradient tensor.

ops.name: piv_synth_pair
ops.summary: Creates an image pair with a known displacement field. Returns ``(image_a, image_b, truth)``.

ops.name: piv_synth_particles
ops.summary: Creates 1 image seeded with tracer particles. Returns ``(image, positions)``.

ops.name: piv_synth_sequence
ops.summary: Image sequence in which the same particles are moved repeatedly. Returns ``(frames, truth)``.

ops.name: piv_time_statistics
ops.summary: Image sequence → time average, RMS of the fluctuations and Reynolds stresses.

ops.name: piv_to_velocity
ops.summary: Pixels/frame → m/s. **Both are required arguments** (no default values are provided).

ops.name: piv_velocity_gradient
ops.summary: Returns the components of the velocity-gradient tensor together with the quantities derived from it.

ops.name: piv_vorticity
ops.summary: Vorticity ``d(dx)/dy - d(dy)/dx``. **Counter-clockwise is positive** (defined in image coordinates).

ops.name: speckle_quality
ops.summary: Returns 4 numbers indicating whether a captured speckle pattern is suitable for DIC.

ops.name: strain_from_displacement
ops.summary: Computes the strain field from a displacement field. Returns ``(exx, eyy, exy)``.

ops.name: contours_to_gcode
ops.summary: Turns contours (the table of ``mesh_slice_contours``) into a **table of paths that trace around them** (same columns as ``gcode_read``).

ops.name: engrave_lines
ops.summary: Copperplate engraving — parallel lines whose **width** carries the tone.

ops.name: gcode_extrusion_volume
ops.summary: Volume of extruded filament [mm³] = Σe × π (d / 2)² (``measurement``). The weight is density × volume (PLA ≈ 1.24 g/cm³).

ops.name: gcode_layer_image
ops.summary: Draws the path of one layer as a **raster with line width** ``image2d`` (material 1, background 0, travel 0.5 when drawn, y pointing down = rows).

ops.name: gcode_read
ops.summary: Reads G-code (RepRap / Marlin family) into a **table of line segments** ``table``: columns ``x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1`` (mm), ``e`` (filament length extruded on that segment in mm, 0 for a travel-only move), ``f`` (feed rate mm

ops.name: gcode_time_estimate
ops.summary: Lower bound on the run time [s] = Σ(segment length / feed rate) (ignoring acceleration and jerk, ``measurement``). Segments with feed rate 0 are not counted.

ops.name: gcode_write
ops.summary: Writes a table of line segments to G-code (G21 / G90 / M82, G1 with absolute coordinates and absolute E). Returns the path written (``text``).

ops.name: halftone_moire_period
ops.summary: The beat between two halftone screens — period and direction, in closed form.

ops.name: halftone_screen
ops.summary: A classic rotated halftone screen — dots whose area carries the tone.

ops.name: hatch_field
ops.summary: Cross-hatching that **follows the picture** — direction from the structure tensor.

ops.name: mesh_slice_contours
ops.summary: **Table of contours** ``table`` obtained by cutting a triangle mesh with the plane ``z``: columns ``ring`` (ring number), ``x``, ``y`` (mm).

ops.name: mesh_slice_stack
ops.summary: **Stack of layer masks** ``voxel`` (Z, Y, X) obtained by slicing a mesh in steps of ``layer_mm`` (0 / 1, Z from the bottom).

ops.name: mosaic_tiles_render
ops.summary: Paint each Voronoi cell with the **mean** of the pixels it owns.

ops.name: mosaic_tiles_sites
ops.summary: Lloyd's iteration on an image — the tile centres of a mosaic.

ops.name: mst_length
ops.summary: Length of the minimum spanning tree (Prim). **A closed tour cannot be shorter than this** (lower bound).

ops.name: print_layer_defect_map
ops.summary: **Signed defect map** ``image2d`` comparing an observed layer image with the expected layer image (``gcode_layer_image``): +1 = missing where material should be (gaps, clogs), −1 = present where nothing should be (string

ops.name: read_3mf
ops.summary: Reads 3MF (``3D/3dmodel.model`` inside the zip, 3MF Core Specification) into a triangle mesh ``mesh`` = (V, F).

ops.name: stipple_energy
ops.summary: Energy of weighted Lloyd ``Σ w(x) |x - c(x)|^2`` (for checking monotonic decrease).

ops.name: stipple_points_from_image
ops.summary: Maps grey levels to **point density** (weighted Lloyd = centroidal Voronoi). → ``pairs``

ops.name: stroke_resample_closed
ops.summary: Resamples a closed line at **equal arc length**. → ``pairs``

ops.name: stroke_tone_error
ops.summary: How much the **tone** resulting from drawing the lines differs from the target. → ``table``

ops.name: stroke_tour_closed
ops.summary: Reorders the points into a **closed tour** that visits each point exactly 1 time and returns. → ``pairs``

ops.name: write_3mf
ops.summary: Writes a triangle mesh to 3MF (minimal configuration: ``[Content_Types].xml`` / ``_rels/.rels`` / ``3D/3dmodel.model``, unit mm). Returns the path (``text``).

ops.name: profile_align
ops.summary: Aligns a measured contour to the design contour. Returns ``(aligned, info)``.

ops.name: profile_camber
ops.summary: Camber line (the midline between the upper and lower surfaces). Returns ``(x, yc)`` as an ``(n, 2)`` array.

ops.name: profile_chord_frame
ops.summary: Finds the chord (the 2 points farthest apart). Returns a dict.

ops.name: profile_deviation
ops.summary: The **signed deviation along the normal** from the design shape. Returns a dict.

ops.name: profile_leading_edge_radius
ops.summary: Leading-edge radius (as a fraction of the chord). Fits a circle to the points near the leading edge.

ops.name: profile_normalise
ops.summary: Normalises by rotation and translation so that the chord length is 1, the leading edge is at the origin and the chord points along +x.

ops.name: profile_perturb
ops.summary: Returns a contour with defects of known magnitude inserted. :data:`PERTURB_KINDS`.

ops.name: profile_resample
ops.summary: Resamples the contour at equal spacing. ``kind`` is ``"arclength"`` only (for now).

ops.name: profile_sides
ops.summary: Extracts the upper and lower surfaces as functions of the chordwise coordinate. Returns a dict.

ops.name: profile_synth_naca4
ops.summary: Generates a NACA 4-digit airfoil in closed form. Returns an ``(N, 2)`` outline traced in a single continuous stroke.

ops.name: profile_thickness
ops.summary: Thickness distribution ``t(x)``. Returns ``(x, t)`` as an ``(n, 2)`` array.

ops.name: profile_trailing_edge_gap
ops.summary: Trailing-edge gap (as a fraction of the chord). The distance between the trailing-edge ends of the upper and lower surfaces.

ops.name: iqft2
ops.summary: Inverse quaternion Fourier transform of a **centred** spectrum. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: monogenic_amplitude
ops.summary: Local amplitude ``sqrt(f^2 + R1^2 + R2^2)`` of a monogenic signal. → (H, W).

ops.name: monogenic_orientation
ops.summary: Local orientation ``atan2(R2, R1)`` of a monogenic signal. → (H, W).

ops.name: monogenic_phase
ops.summary: Local phase ``atan2(|R|, f)`` of a monogenic signal. → (H, W).

ops.name: monogenic_signal
ops.summary: The monogenic signal of an image at one scale. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: qft2
ops.summary: Quaternion (hypercomplex) 2-D Fourier transform. → (H, W, 4) centred spectrum.

ops.name: quat_color_filter
ops.summary: Keep or remove one colour direction, exactly. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: quat_color_rotate
ops.summary: Rotate every pixel's colour about an RGB axis: ``q x conj(q)``. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: quat_conjugate_image
ops.summary: Per-pixel quaternion conjugate ``(w, -x, -y, -z)``. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: quat_correlate
ops.summary: Quaternion cross-correlation ``sum_s conj(a(s)) * b(s+t)``. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: quat_image_multiply
ops.summary: Hamilton product of a quaternion image with a quaternion or a field. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: quat_norm
ops.summary: Per-pixel quaternion modulus ``|q| = sqrt(w^2+x^2+y^2+z^2)``. → (H, W).

ops.name: quat_normalize_image
ops.summary: Per-pixel normalisation to unit modulus. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: quaternion_to_rgb
ops.summary: Vector part of a quaternion image, as linear RGB. → (H, W, 3).

ops.name: rgb_to_quaternion
ops.summary: Embed a colour image as pure quaternions ``0 + R i + G j + B k``. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: riesz_displacement
ops.summary: Sub-pixel displacement field from the monogenic phase. → dict.

ops.name: riesz_displacement_series
ops.summary: Whole-frame displacement waveform from the monogenic phase. → (T, 2).

ops.name: riesz_motion_magnify
ops.summary: Scale a clip's in-band motion by *alpha*, by the Riesz route. → dict.

ops.name: riesz_transform
ops.summary: The 2-D Riesz transform of an image, as a pure quaternion field. → (H, W, 4).

ops.name: beamform_delay_sum
ops.summary: Delay-and-sum (Bartlett) angle spectrum for one range-Doppler cell.

ops.name: beamform_doa
ops.summary: Direction(s) of arrival for one range-Doppler cell, in degrees.

ops.name: fmcw_beat_simulate
ops.summary: Synthesise the complex ``(A, C, S)`` beat cube for known targets.

ops.name: fmcw_design
ops.summary: Bin widths, resolutions and aliasing limits of an FMCW configuration.

ops.name: fmcw_range_profile
ops.summary: Range-only profile: the fast-time FFT magnitude, averaged over the rest.

ops.name: fmcw_window_apply
ops.summary: Apply a periodic window along the range and/or Doppler axis of a beat cube.

ops.name: range_doppler_map
ops.summary: The 2-D FFT of a beat cube -> a ``(n_doppler, n_range)`` magnitude map.

ops.name: range_doppler_peaks
ops.summary: Detections from a range-Doppler map: bin indices back to metres and m/s.

ops.name: angle_to_matrix
ops.summary: Angle **[deg]** → the rotation ``matrix (3,3)`` about the z-axis. The exit from ``angle``.

ops.name: angles_to_normals
ops.summary: Azimuth/elevation pairs ``(N,2)`` **[deg]** → unit normals ``(N,3)``. The exit from ``pairs``.

ops.name: correlation_score
ops.summary: Two ``voxel`` → a normalised cross-correlation ``score`` volume. **The only entry into this type.**

ops.name: countrate_to_counts
ops.summary: Count rate ``[Hz]`` → ``counts``. The exit from ``countrate`` (**invertible**).

ops.name: counts_to_countrate
ops.summary: Counts → count rate ``[Hz]``. The inverse of :func:`countrate_to_counts`.

ops.name: cscalar_to_polar
ops.summary: Complex scalar → polar form ``pairs (1,2) = [|z|, arg z [deg]]``. The exit from ``cscalar``.

ops.name: curvature_to_shape_index
ops.summary: Principal curvatures ``(N,2)`` → shape index and curvedness, as ``pairs (N,2)``. The exit from ``curvature``.

ops.name: curvature_to_table
ops.summary: Curvature → a ``table`` summarising its distribution. **One-way** (a statistic's job is to throw information away).

ops.name: deformation_to_points
ops.summary: A TPS ``deformation`` → its control ``points (N,3)``. The exit from ``deformation``.

ops.name: descriptor_to_matrix
ops.summary: Descriptor → ``matrix``. The exit from ``descriptor`` (**invertible**).

ops.name: descriptor_to_table
ops.summary: Descriptor → a summary ``table``. **One-way.**

ops.name: flow_apply
ops.summary: Add a scattered flow ``(N,3)`` to a point set ``(N,3)`` → ``points``. The consuming side of ``flow``.

ops.name: flow_magnitude
ops.summary: Dense scene flow ``(3,D,H,W)`` → a speed volume ``voxel (D,H,W)``. The exit from ``flow``.

ops.name: flow_speed
ops.summary: Scattered flow ``(N,3)`` → a speed ``signal (N,)``. The exit from scattered ``flow``.

ops.name: flow_to_rgbimage
ops.summary: One slice of a dense scene flow → an ``rgbimage`` with hue = direction and value = speed.

ops.name: frame_axis
ops.summary: Frenet frame ``frame`` → the unit vectors of one axis ``normals (N,3)``. The exit from ``frame``.

ops.name: gaussians_to_points
ops.summary: ``gaussians`` → the point set of their centres ``(N,3)``. The exit from ``gaussians`` (**the centres are invertible**).

ops.name: gaussians_to_voxel
ops.summary: ``gaussians`` → a density ``voxel (D,H,W)``. The second exit from ``gaussians``.

ops.name: gradient_coherence
ops.summary: 3-D gradient → the structure tensor's **sheet-likeness** (coherence) ``voxel``, range [0, 1].

ops.name: gradient_magnitude
ops.summary: 3-D gradient ``gradient`` → a gradient-magnitude volume ``voxel``. The exit from ``gradient``.

ops.name: hessian_determinant
ops.summary: 3-D Hessian ``hessian`` → a volume of the determinant ``det H`` ``voxel`` (signed). The exit from ``hessian``.

ops.name: hessian_vesselness
ops.summary: 3-D Hessian → Frangi vesselness ``voxel``, range [0, 1].

ops.name: indices_to_labels
ops.summary: Indices ``(N,)`` → a selection mask ``labels``. The exit from ``indices`` (**invertible**).

ops.name: indices_to_positions
ops.summary: Indices ``indices`` → event positions ``positions`` (physical units). The entry into ``positions``.

ops.name: jones_state
ops.summary: Polarisation azimuth and ellipticity → a Jones vector ``jones`` (Ex, Ey). The entry into ``jones``.

ops.name: keypoints_from_image2d
ops.summary: A count/response image ``(H, W)`` → image coordinates ``(N,2) = (u, v)``. The way back of the round trip.

ops.name: keypoints_rowcol_to_uv
ops.summary: Image points ``(row, col)`` → ``(u, v) = (col, row)``. The bridge between the two conventions of the ``keypoints`` sort.

ops.name: keypoints_to_image2d
ops.summary: Image coordinates ``(N,2) = (u, v)`` → a count image ``(H, W)``. The second exit from ``keypoints``.

ops.name: keypoints_uv_to_points
ops.summary: Image coordinates ``(N,2) = (u, v)`` → a point set ``(N,3) = (z, y, x)``. The exit from ``keypoints``.

ops.name: keypoints_uv_to_rowcol
ops.summary: Image points ``(u, v) = (col, row)`` → ``(row, col)``. The reverse of :func:`keypoints_rowcol_to_uv`.

ops.name: knn_graph_to_conn_graph
ops.summary: k-nearest-neighbour graph ``graph`` → a weighted adjacency matrix ``conn_graph (n, n)``. The exit from ``graph``.

ops.name: labels_to_indices
ops.summary: ``labels`` → the indices ``(N,)`` of the non-background. The other direction of :func:`indices_to_labels`.

ops.name: match_component
ops.summary: The ``match`` sort (a 1-D result vector) → one of its components as a ``measurement``. The exit from ``match``.

ops.name: matrix_to_angle
ops.summary: A rotation matrix about the z-axis → the angle **[deg]**. The inverse of :func:`angle_to_matrix`.

ops.name: matrix_to_descriptor
ops.summary: ``matrix`` → descriptor. The inverse of :func:`descriptor_to_matrix`.

ops.name: matrix_to_rot_scale
ops.summary: A 2-D similarity transform ``(2,2)`` → ``(angle [deg], scale)``. The inverse of :func:`rot_scale_to_matrix`.

ops.name: normals_to_angles
ops.summary: Normals ``(N,3)`` → azimuth/elevation pairs ``(N,2)`` **[deg]**. The exit from ``normals``.

ops.name: normals_to_egi
ops.summary: Normals ``(N,3)`` → the extended Gaussian image, an ``image2d`` of ``(n_el, n_az)``.

ops.name: pairs_peak_x
ops.summary: Pairs ``pairs (x, y)`` → the x where y peaks (parabolic interpolation between samples) ``measurement``.

ops.name: pairs_to_image2d
ops.summary: Pairs ``(N,2)`` → a scatter-density image ``(H, W)``. The third exit from ``pairs``.

ops.name: pairs_to_signal
ops.summary: Pairs ``(N,2)`` → the dependent variable as a ``signal (N,)``. The second exit from ``pairs``.

ops.name: pairs_to_table
ops.summary: Pairs ``(N,2)`` → a summary ``table``. **One-way.**

ops.name: pointmap_to_points
ops.summary: Grid-organised 3-D points ``pointmap (H,W,3)`` → a point cloud ``points (N,3)``. The exit from ``pointmap``.

ops.name: points_to_gaussians
ops.summary: A point set ``(N,3)`` → isotropic ``gaussians``. **The only entry into this type.**

ops.name: points_to_position
ops.summary: A point set ``(N,3)`` → its centroid ``(z, y, x)``. **Not invertible** (the distribution is thrown away).

ops.name: points_zyx_to_keypoints_uv
ops.summary: A point set ``(N,3) = (z, y, x)`` → image coordinates ``(N,2) = (u, v)``.

ops.name: polar_to_cscalar
ops.summary: Polar form ``pairs (1,2) = [r, theta [deg]]`` → a complex scalar. The inverse of :func:`cscalar_to_polar`.

ops.name: pose_to_matrix
ops.summary: A rigid pose ``pose (R, t)`` → a 4×4 homogeneous transform ``matrix``.

ops.name: position_to_points
ops.summary: A position ``(z, y, x)`` → a one-point set ``(1, 3)``. The exit from ``position`` (**invertible**).

ops.name: rot_scale_to_matrix
ops.summary: ``(angle [deg], scale)`` → a 2-D similarity ``matrix (2,2)``. The exit from ``rot_scale``.

ops.name: score_to_image2d
ops.summary: A ``score`` volume → its maximum-intensity projection, an ``image2d``. The second exit from ``score``.

ops.name: score_to_position
ops.summary: A ``score`` volume → the location of its maximum, ``position (z, y, x)``. The exit from ``score``.

ops.name: select_points
ops.summary: A point set ``(N,3)`` and indices ``(M,)`` → the sub-set ``(M,3)``. The consuming side of ``indices``.

ops.name: shape_index_to_curvature
ops.summary: Shape index and curvedness ``(N,2)`` → principal curvatures ``(N,2)``. The inverse of :func:`curvature_to_shape_index`.

ops.name: shift_to_vector
ops.summary: An integer shift ``(dz, dy, dx)`` → a ``vector (3,)``. The exit from ``shift`` (**invertible**).

ops.name: synapse_table_from_table
ops.summary: A table ``table`` (column name → array) → a synapse table ``synapse_table (m, 3)``. The entry into ``synapse_table``.

ops.name: table_field_image2d
ops.summary: One field of a table ``table`` → a 2-D image ``image2d``. The bridge from ops that return a ``table`` to ops that take images.

ops.name: table_field_matrix
ops.summary: One field of a table ``table`` → a general matrix ``matrix``. Example: the ``swt`` field of ``swt_map`` → ``text_candidates``.

ops.name: table_field_measurement
ops.summary: One field of a table ``table`` → a single number ``measurement``. Example: ``width`` of ``label_extent``.

ops.name: table_field_signal
ops.summary: One field of a table ``table`` → a 1-D array ``signal``. Hands a CSV column or a dict series to signal ops.

ops.name: tokens_to_matrix
ops.summary: A token sequence ``tokens (T, d)`` → a general matrix ``matrix (T, d)``. The exit from ``tokens``.

ops.name: vector_to_shift
ops.summary: A ``vector (3,)`` → an integer shift ``(dz, dy, dx)``. The other direction of :func:`shift_to_vector`.

ops.name: crt_displacement
ops.summary: Local displacement from band phases at several wavelengths, unwrapped by CRT -> ``dict``.

ops.name: harmonic_rotation
ops.summary: Absolute in-plane rotation of ``image`` relative to ``reference`` over 360 degrees -> ``dict``.

ops.name: residue_crt
ops.summary: Weighted robust CRT over real periods -> ``dict``.

ops.name: residue_fault_locate
ops.summary: Which band is corrupted? (redundant residue number system) -> ``dict``.

ops.name: residue_integer_crt
ops.summary: Exact integer CRT (Garner's mixed-radix algorithm) -> ``dict``.

ops.name: profile_params
ops.summary: Profile roughness parameters Ra/Rq/Rz/Rt/Rp/Rv/Rsk/Rku (ISO 4287).

ops.name: robust_gaussian_profile
ops.summary: Robust Gaussian regression filter (profile): a mean line and roughness that outliers and scratches cannot drag.

ops.name: robust_gaussian_surface
ops.summary: Robust Gaussian regression filter (surface): waviness and roughness of a surface that scratches and spikes cannot drag.

ops.name: robust_spline_profile
ops.summary: Robust spline filter (profile): a mean line and roughness that outliers cannot drag.

ops.name: surface_filter
ops.summary: Separates a height field into roughness and waviness (Gaussian filter of ISO 16610-21).

ops.name: surface_form_remove
ops.summary: Removes a plane / quadric surface directly on the grid. Returns ``(residual, coeffs)``.

ops.name: surface_params
ops.summary: Areal roughness parameters Sa/Sq/Sp/Sv/Sz/Ssk/Sku/Sdq/Sdr (ISO 25178-2).

ops.name: surface_psd
ops.summary: Power spectral density of the height field. Returns ``(q, C)``. **The conventions are made explicit through the arguments.**

ops.name: surface_synth_psd
ops.summary: Synthesizes a height field from a specified PSD. Returns ``(z, sq_analytic)``.
ops.call: fullseye.op_run('surface_synth_psd', n=<number>, dx=<number>, hurst=<number>, lambda_lo=<number>, lambda_hi=<number>, sq=<number>)

ops.name: alpha_expansion
ops.summary: Multi-label α-expansion (Boykov–Veksler–Zabih 2001): E(f) = Σ (I_p − μ_(f_p))² + λ Σ w_pq V(f_p, f_q), where V is a metric (alpha_expansion).

ops.name: alpha_tree
ops.summary: α-tree: builds the minimum spanning tree of the grid weighted by neighbour differences (Kruskal in scipy) and returns the partition for each α using only the tree edges of weight ≤ α (alpha_tree).

ops.name: area_opening_attr
ops.summary: Attribute opening (Salembier et al. 1998): removes the component-tree nodes whose attribute < ``threshold`` and sets each pixel to the value of its nearest ancestor with attribute ≥ threshold (area_opening_attr).

ops.name: chan_vese_energy
ops.summary: Chan–Vese 2001 energy F = μ Length + ν Area(inside) + λ1 ∫_in |I − c1|² + λ2 ∫_out |I − c2|² (two-phase) (chan_vese_energy).

ops.name: chan_vese_evolve
ops.summary: Minimises the two-phase Chan–Vese 2001 energy (by default alternating minimisation of the convex relaxation; the level-set gradient descent can also be chosen) (chan_vese_evolve).

ops.name: check_difference
ops.summary: Pixels whose difference from the reference image exceeds tol, as a region (check_difference).

ops.name: class_2dim_sup
ops.summary: Supervised classification in a 2-channel feature space: pixels inside the distribution of ref_region (class_2dim_sup).

ops.name: class_2dim_unsup
ops.summary: Unsupervised k-means classification in a 2-channel feature space; returns a label image (class_2dim_unsup).

ops.name: class_ndim_norm
ops.summary: Classify N-D feature images with a learned normal-distribution class (Mahalanobis distance < thresh) (class_ndim_norm).

ops.name: classify_image_class_lut
ops.summary: Pixel classification through a gray-value LUT (threshold / label table) (classify_image_class_lut).

ops.name: cover_ratio_grade
ops.summary: Split a cover fraction (area share 0..1) into grades 0..len(edges) at **declared edges** ``edges``.

ops.name: curvature_flow
ops.summary: Level-set form of mean curvature flow (curve-shortening flow) φ_t = |∇φ| div(∇φ/|∇φ|) (inside where φ < 0; shrinks from the convex parts) (curvature_flow).

ops.name: distance_peaks
ops.summary: Returns an int marker array of the local maxima of the foreground distance transform, thinned out by ``min_distance`` NMS.

ops.name: drle_evolve
ops.summary: Edge-based distance-regularized level set evolution DRLSE (Li–Xu–Gui–Fox 2010). No re-initialisation (drle_evolve).

ops.name: edge_stop_g
ops.summary: Edge-stopping function g = 1 / (1 + |∇(G_σ * I)|² / k²) (the p = 2 form of Caselles–Kimmel–Sapiro 1997) (edge_stop_g).

ops.name: expand_gray
ops.summary: Grow a region from a seed by gray-value similarity (|delta| < tol) (expand_gray).

ops.name: fisher_lda_fit
ops.summary: Fit a two-class Fisher linear discriminant (closed form, no iteration).

ops.name: fisher_lda_score
ops.summary: Score features with a discriminant fitted by ``fisher_lda_fit`` (score > 0 means class 1).

ops.name: graph_cut_binary
ops.summary: Binary graph cut (Boykov–Jolly 2001): minimises E = Σ_p D_p(x_p) + λ Σ w_pq [x_p ≠ x_q] exactly by max-flow / min-cut (graph_cut_binary).

ops.name: gvf_field
ops.summary: Gradient vector flow (Xu–Prince 1998): the field (u, v) that smoothly diffuses the gradient of the edge map f away from the edges (gvf_field).

ops.name: hierarchical_watershed
ops.summary: Hierarchical watershed by dynamics: attaches the dynamics saliency to the edges of the minimum spanning forest of the relief ``image`` (low places are basins) and returns the components joined by edges with saliency ≤ ``

ops.name: learn_ndim_norm
ops.summary: Learn a normal-distribution class (mean and covariance) from feature vectors (learn_ndim_norm).

ops.name: lens_area
ops.summary: Closed-form overlap (lens) area of two equal-radius-r circles at centre distance d; 0 when d >= 2r (lens_area).

ops.name: level_set_reinit
ops.summary: Turns φ (inside where φ < 0) into the signed distance function of the same zero level set (level_set_reinit).

ops.name: max_tree
ops.summary: Component tree (max-tree): builds the tree of connected components of the upper level sets {f ≥ h} with Union-Find (pixels processed in descending order of value) (max_tree).

ops.name: morph_chan_vese
ops.summary: Morphological Chan–Vese (MorphACWE of Márquez-Neila–Baumela–Álvarez 2014). One iteration = data step + smoothing step (morph_chan_vese).

ops.name: morph_geodesic_ac
ops.summary: Morphological geodesic active contour (MorphGAC of Márquez-Neila et al. 2014). gimage = an image that is small on edges (the g of edge_stop_g) (morph_geodesic_ac).

ops.name: plant_color_index
ops.summary: Per-pixel plant colour indices from the three visible bands (ExG, ExR, ExGR, CIVE, NGRDI, VEG).

ops.name: quasi_flat_zones
ops.summary: α-quasi-flat zones (Soille 2008): the connected components joined only by neighbour edges with |f_p − f_q| ≤ α. Returns: ``labels`` (1..k), ``n_zones`` (quasi_flat_zones).

ops.name: quickshift
ops.summary: Quick shift (Vedaldi–Soatto 2008): estimates the Parzen density P_i = Σ_j exp(−D_ij²/(2σ²)) on the features (y, x, ratio · I) (window 3σ, σ = ``kernel_size``), links each pixel to the nearest point of higher density (ins

ops.name: regiongrowing_n
ops.summary: Segment the whole image by multi-channel feature similarity; returns a label image (regiongrowing_n).

ops.name: seg_boundary_f
ops.summary: Boundary F-measure at tolerance tau: precision = fraction of predicted boundary pixels within tau of a true boundary, recall the reverse (seg_boundary_f).

ops.name: seg_confusion_table
ops.summary: Label-correspondence contingency table (rows = truth, columns = prediction) with max-overlap matching and a uniqueness flag (seg_confusion_table).

ops.name: seg_dice_jaccard
ops.summary: Dice and Jaccard — once over the mask (union of non-background pixels), or per true label against its max-overlap partner (seg_dice_jaccard).

ops.name: seg_hausdorff
ops.summary: Hausdorff distance between the two boundary pixel sets, with a percentile variant such as HD95 (seg_hausdorff).

ops.name: seg_mean_surface_distance
ops.summary: Average symmetric surface distance (ASSD): mean of the both-direction boundary distances, plus the RMS (seg_mean_surface_distance).

ops.name: seg_object_counts_match
ops.summary: Object-count agreement: counts split / merged / missed / false / matched from the degrees of a 'mainly overlapping' bipartite graph (seg_object_counts_match).

ops.name: seg_score_card
ops.summary: All measures on one card: Dice/Jaccard, VI/split/merge, Rand/ARI, boundary F, Hausdorff/HD95/ASSD, over/under, split/merge/missed/false/matched and counts (seg_score_card).

ops.name: seg_under_over_segmentation
ops.summary: Counts over- and under-segmentation as the multiplicity of the contingency-table majority vote (Levine & Nazif style) (seg_under_over_segmentation).

ops.name: separate_touching
ops.summary: genuinely-new (B): an everyday wrapper that automatically separates touching objects in 1 call.

ops.name: snake_evolve
ops.summary: Semi-implicit update of the discrete snake (Kass–Witkin–Terzopoulos 1988): x_t = (A + γI)^(-1)(γ x_(t-1) − f_x) (eqs. (19)(20)) (snake_evolve).

ops.name: snic_superpixels
ops.summary: SNIC (Algorithm 1 of Achanta–Süsstrunk 2017): non-iterative superpixels grown from grid seeds with a priority queue (snic_superpixels).

ops.name: statistical_region_merging
ops.summary: Statistical region merging SRM (Nock–Nielsen 2004): processes pairs of neighbouring pixels in ascending order of |I_p − I_q| and merges them when the predicate P(R, R') holds (statistical_region_merging).

ops.name: superpixel_color_texture_features
ops.summary: Ten colour (plant indices, chromaticity) and texture (gradient, orientation coherence) features for every region of a label image.

ops.name: superpixel_quality
ops.summary: Superpixel scoring: boundary recall (the recall of ``segeval.seg_boundary_f``, tolerance τ), the corrected undersegmentation error CUSE = (1/N) Σ_k |S_k − G_max(S_k)| (Neubert–Protzel 2012, eq. (2) of the SNIC paper), AS

ops.name: threshold_isodata
ops.summary: ISODATA (Ridler–Calvard 1978): iterates t ← (μ_≤t + μ_>t)/2 **on the pixel values** until the partition stops changing (initial value = mean) (threshold_isodata).

ops.name: threshold_kapur
ops.summary: Maximum-entropy threshold (Kapur–Sahoo–Wong 1985): the bin t that maximises H(t) = −Σ_(i ≤ t) (p_i/P1) ln(p_i/P1) − Σ_(i > t) (p_i/P2) ln(p_i/P2) (only bins where both sides have positive probability). Returns: ``thresho

ops.name: threshold_kittler
ops.summary: Minimum-error threshold (Kittler–Illingworth 1986): at each bin t, splits into a low side (bins ≤ t) and a high side and minimises J(t) = 1 + 2(P1 ln σ1 + P2 ln σ2) − 2(P1 ln P1 + P2 ln P2) (σ is the standard deviation o

ops.name: threshold_triangle
ops.summary: Triangle method (Zack–Rogers–Latt 1977): the threshold is the bin (b, h_b) between the peak (b_p, h_p) and the end bin of the longer tail (b_e, 0) whose signed perpendicular distance from the line joining them is largest

ops.name: ultrametric_contour_map
ops.summary: Ultrametric contour map (UCM) of the dynamics hierarchy: the value between neighbouring pixels p, q = the smallest threshold at which p and q fall into the same region (ultrametric_contour_map).

ops.name: voronoi_cells
ops.summary: Voronoi partition of seeds inside a rectangle, returned as polygons with areas and internal edge lengths (brute-force half-planes, O(n^2)) (voronoi_cells).

ops.name: watershed_vol
ops.summary: Splits a 3D foreground into per-object labels with a watershed seeded from the distance transform (a thin composition of public ops).

ops.name: watersheds_marker
ops.summary: Marker-controlled watershed segmentation; markers is an int label image (0 = unassigned) (watersheds_marker).

ops.name: world_blobs_touching
ops.summary: World of overlapping discs (cells/grains): equal-radius circles placed in a chain, each overlapping only the previous one at centre distance 2r(1 - overlap) (world_blobs_touching).

ops.name: world_gradient_illumination
ops.summary: World of dark objects over an illumination gradient plus noise (global thresholding breaks; local thresholding / flat-field cut it) (world_gradient_illumination).

ops.name: world_grains_voronoi
ops.summary: Voronoi grain world: n jittered seeds on a lattice; labels = index of the nearest seed (1..n) (world_grains_voronoi).

ops.name: world_parts_with_shadow
ops.summary: World of industrial parts (rotated rectangles with circular holes) with oblique-lighting shadows, facet shading and highlights (world_parts_with_shadow).

ops.name: world_texture_regions
ops.summary: World of 2-4 regions that share the same mean but differ only in variance and period (uncuttable by thresholding) (world_texture_regions).

ops.name: world_thin_structures
ops.summary: World of 1-3 px lines (straight) and cracks (polylines); ground truth = centrelines and widths (world_thin_structures).

ops.name: add_frame_corners
ops.summary: Adds the four corners of the image (+ the edge midpoints) to the point set as fixed points.

ops.name: blend
ops.summary: Cross-dissolve (1-alpha)·a + alpha·b (a, b have the same shape and lie in [0,1]).

ops.name: contour_epicycle_chain
ops.summary: Returns the **chain of rotating pendulums** at phase ``t`` (``pairs``).

ops.name: contour_fourier_complex
ops.summary: Turns a closed contour into the coefficients of a complex Fourier series — ``z(t) = Σ c_k exp(2πi k t)``.

ops.name: contour_fourier_truncation_energy
ops.summary: The **predicted** error for each truncation order (``table``) — Parseval's exact formula.

ops.name: descriptor_distance
ops.summary: Distance between 2 shapes (smaller means more similar). Invariant to rotation/translation/starting point/(optionally) scale.

ops.name: elliptic_fourier
ops.summary: Computes the elliptic Fourier coefficients of a closed contour using the Kuhl–Giardina closed form.

ops.name: fit_circle_xld
ops.summary: Fit a circle to each XLD contour and return its centre row, column and radius (``table``).

ops.name: fourier_smooth
ops.summary: Smooths a contour by band-limiting it with a complex FFT.

ops.name: from_xld
ops.summary: Extracts the i-th contour from an XLD contour dict (``{"shape", "cs":[Nx2,...]}``).

ops.name: invariants
ops.summary: Shape descriptor invariant to rotation, translation, starting point and (optionally) scale ((N,2)).

ops.name: morph
ops.summary: Morphs 2 images A and B via corresponding points and produces the intermediate image at ratio alpha.

ops.name: morph_sequence
ops.summary: Morph sequence with alpha swept 0→1 in n steps (frames that change smoothly from A to B).

ops.name: normalize
ops.summary: Converts EFD coefficients into the coefficients of the "canonical pose" (aligned with respect to the 1st harmonic).

ops.name: reconstruct
ops.summary: Reconstructs a contour from EFD coefficients ((M,2)).

ops.name: warp_piecewise_affine
ops.summary: Piecewise affine warp that moves the content at src_pts of img to dst_pts.

ops.name: warp_tps_image
ops.summary: Smooth warp that moves src_pts of img to dst_pts using a thin-plate spline.

ops.name: generalized_procrustes
ops.summary: Generalised Procrustes analysis (GPA). Brings all individuals into a common frame. → ``(K, N, 3)``.

ops.name: landmark_asymmetry
ops.summary: **Signed** asymmetry for each left/right pair. → ``(M,)``.

ops.name: mirror_plane_from_pairs
ops.summary: Derives the median (midsagittal) plane from corresponding left/right landmarks. → ``(2, 3)`` (row 1 = point, row 2 = normal).

ops.name: procrustes_align
ops.summary: Points of *source* superimposed onto *target*. → ``(N, 3)`` (applies :func:`procrustes_fit`).

ops.name: procrustes_distance
ops.summary: Procrustes distance = per-point RMS after superimposition. → float.

ops.name: procrustes_fit
ops.summary: Similarity transform that superimposes *source* onto *target*. → ``(4, 4)`` homogeneous matrix.

ops.name: shape_explained_variance
ops.summary: Explained-variance ratio of each principal component (sums to 1). → ``(k,)``.

ops.name: shape_mahalanobis
ops.summary: How **abnormal** the shape is as seen from the model. → float.

ops.name: shape_mean
ops.summary: Mean shape after alignment by GPA. → ``(N, 3)``.

ops.name: shape_pca
ops.summary: Shape PCA (statistical shape model). → dict (``shapemodel``).

ops.name: shape_perturb
ops.summary: Applies 1 **known** deformation to a shape. → ``(N, 3)``.

ops.name: shape_project
ops.summary: Maps a shape into model coordinates (principal-component scores). → ``(k,)``.

ops.name: shape_reconstruct
ops.summary: Reconstructs a shape from scores. → ``(N, 3)``.

ops.name: shape_synth_family
ops.summary: Creates a family of shapes with known modes of deformation. → ``(n_shapes, n_points, 3)``.

ops.name: shape_synthesize
ops.summary: Generates 1 **plausible new shape** from the model. → ``(N, 3)``.

ops.name: signed_surface_distance
ops.summary: **Signed** distance from the query points to the surface. → ``(N,)``.

ops.name: simcal_discrepancy
ops.summary: Is there structure in the noise-normalised residuals that the model cannot produce (model discrepancy)?

ops.name: simcal_fit
ops.summary: Fit the free knobs of an observed simmodel to its images (weighted least squares) -> ``calresult``.

ops.name: simcal_identifiability
ops.summary: Fisher information, Cramér-Rao bound, correlations, collinearity and profile likelihood of every fitted knob.

ops.name: simcal_model
ops.summary: Build a ``simmodel``: a forward chain of ops whose arguments are knobs with units, ranges and a noise model.

ops.name: simcal_observe
ops.summary: Attach measured images to a simmodel: alignment, region of interest and exposure normalisation.

ops.name: simcal_report
ops.summary: One table of a calibration: each knob's value, unit, interval and class, the gates, and the reasons for refusals.

ops.name: simcal_screen
ops.summary: Which knobs move the images above the camera noise, which are confounded, and how many output directions exist.

ops.name: simcal_simulate
ops.summary: Run a simmodel's chain at given knob values -> one 2-D array per condition (``images``).

ops.name: simcal_uncertainty
ops.summary: Standard deviations and intervals of the determined knobs: Laplace (inverse Fisher) or parametric bootstrap.

ops.name: simcal_validate
ops.summary: Over-fitting gates on held-out images; any one failing rejects the calibration (the estimates are withdrawn).

ops.name: anomaly_image_auroc
ops.summary: Image-level AUROC from one anomaly score per image and a good/defective label per image (``table``).

ops.name: anomaly_image_f1_max
ops.summary: Best image-level F1 over all thresholds from one anomaly score per image and a good/defective label (``table``).

ops.name: anomaly_operating_point
ops.summary: Pick the highest threshold whose defect recall is guaranteed to be at least ``recall`` at ``confidence`` (``table``).

ops.name: anomaly_pixel_auroc
ops.summary: Pixel-level AUROC of anomaly score maps against ground-truth defect masks (``table``).

ops.name: anomaly_pixel_f1_max
ops.summary: Best pixel-level F1 over all thresholds of anomaly score maps against defect masks (``table``).

ops.name: anomaly_pro
ops.summary: Per-region overlap (PRO) curve and its normalised area AUPRO up to ``fpr_max`` (``table``).

ops.name: anomaly_region_overlap
ops.summary: Per-region overlap of a binary defect prediction with the ground-truth regions at one operating point (``table``).

ops.name: gum_expanded
ops.summary: Welch-Satterthwaite effective degrees of freedom, coverage factor k and expanded uncertainty U (``table``).

ops.name: gum_monte_carlo
ops.summary: Monte Carlo propagation of distributions (GUM Supplement 1, JCGM 101) (``table``).

ops.name: gum_propagate
ops.summary: Law of propagation of uncertainty (GUM 5.2, with correlations) (``table``).

ops.name: gum_standard_uncertainty
ops.summary: Convert uncertainty components from the **shape of their distribution** into standard uncertainties (``table``).

ops.name: gum_validate
ops.summary: **Validate** the propagation-law result against the Monte Carlo result (``table``).

ops.name: msa_anova_table
ops.summary: Analysis-of-variance table for a crossed two-factor design (part x operator x replicate) (``table``).

ops.name: msa_attribute_agreement
ops.summary: Agreement between appraisers on attribute (pass/fail) inspection (``table``).

ops.name: msa_bias_linearity
ops.summary: Bias against a reference value and how that bias depends on the reference (linearity) (``table``).

ops.name: msa_gauge_rr
ops.summary: Gauge repeatability and reproducibility by the analysis-of-variance method (``table``).

ops.name: patch_features
ops.summary: Classical patch features on a grid: one D-vector per patch (``table``).

ops.name: patchbank_fit
ops.summary: Build a memory bank of good patch features, thinned by greedy k-centre covering (``table``).

ops.name: patchbank_score
ops.summary: Score one image by the distance of each patch to its ``k`` nearest good patches in the bank (``table``).

ops.name: patchdist_fit
ops.summary: Learn a normal distribution of the patch feature at every grid position from good images (``table``).

ops.name: patchdist_score
ops.summary: Score one image against a per-position normal distribution: the Mahalanobis distance per patch (``table``).

ops.name: pod_ahat_fit
ops.summary: Fit the â-vs-a regression by maximum likelihood with left and right censoring (``table``).

ops.name: pod_decision_tradeoff
ops.summary: Trade-off table of (a50, a90, a90/95, false-call probability) as the decision threshold ``a_dec`` is varied (``table``).

ops.name: pod_false_call
ops.summary: Probability of a false call from the responses ``noise`` of unflawed sites and the decision threshold ``a_dec`` (``table``).

ops.name: pod_from_ahat
ops.summary: From the â-vs-a regression and the decision threshold ``a_dec``: the POD(a) curve and a50 / a90 / a90/95 (``table``).

ops.name: pod_hitmiss_fit
ops.summary: Fit POD(a) to binary found/missed data with a generalised linear model (``table``).

ops.name: proportion_interval
ops.summary: Return the point estimate and confidence limits for the binomial proportion ``k/n`` (``table``).

ops.name: spc_capability
ops.summary: Process capability indices Cp and Cpk from measurements and spec limits.

ops.name: spc_cusum
ops.summary: Tabular CUSUM chart for individual measurements.

ops.name: spc_ewma
ops.summary: EWMA control chart for individual measurements (Roberts 1959).

ops.name: spc_hotelling_t2
ops.summary: Multivariate SPC by Hotelling's T² with an F-distributed control limit.

ops.name: spc_mt_distance
ops.summary: Score observations against an MT-method unit space.

ops.name: spc_mt_sn_ratio
ops.summary: Larger-the-better SN ratio of abnormal-sample distances, in decibels.

ops.name: spc_mt_unit_space
ops.summary: Build an MT-method unit space from known-good observations.

ops.name: spc_xbar_r
ops.summary: Shewhart Xbar-R control chart from subgroup measurements.

ops.name: trials_for_all_success
ops.summary: Return the minimum trial count needed for all successes to establish ``p >= p_min`` at one-sided ``confidence`` (``scalar``).

ops.name: varmodel_alignment
ops.summary: Translation offset of every good sample against the typical position of the stack, and the margin to the tolerance (``table``).

ops.name: varmodel_band_k
ops.summary: Half-width ``k`` (in spread units) of the tolerance band for a declared two-sided per-pixel false-alarm rate (``table``).

ops.name: varmodel_calibrate
ops.summary: Re-derive the band half-width ``k`` from held-out good images, for data that break the normal assumption (``table``).

ops.name: varmodel_fit
ops.summary: Learn a per-pixel variation model (centre, spread, band half-width k) from a stack of good samples (``table``).

ops.name: varmodel_score
ops.summary: Score one image against a ``varmodel_fit`` model: z map in sigmas, out-of-band map and a per-region explanation (``table``).

ops.name: brdf_blinn_phong
ops.summary: Blinn's half-vector specular lobe. → (H, W) in [0, 1].

ops.name: brdf_microfacet
ops.summary: GGX / Trowbridge-Reitz microfacet specular BRDF. → (H, W), units 1/sr.

ops.name: deflectometry_phase_to_slope
ops.summary: Two absolute screen phases (fringes along u and v) → a normal map (H, W, 3) on the surface grid.

ops.name: deflectometry_render
ops.summary: Height field → the camera's image of the screen's mirror reflection (forward simulation). → list of images (each (H, W), [0, 1]).

ops.name: deflectometry_rig
ops.summary: Put the geometry of a deflectometry rig (camera, screen, field of view) into one table (dict).

ops.name: deflectometry_screen_pattern
ops.summary: The pattern shown on the screen (on the screen's pixel grid). → list of images (each (rows, cols), values [0, 1]).

ops.name: deflectometry_sensitivity
ops.summary: Before measuring, give the smallest detectable slope, the height-slope ambiguity coefficient and the focus blur in closed form. → dict.

ops.name: dichromatic_render
ops.summary: Forward dichromatic model: render a known highlight so a separation can be checked against it. → (H, W, 3).

ops.name: illuminant_from_dichromatic_planes
ops.summary: Recover the illuminant colour from two or more materials. → unit 3-vector.

ops.name: photometric_residual
ops.summary: How badly the Lambertian model fails, per pixel. → (H, W) RMS residual.

ops.name: photometric_stereo_robust
ops.summary: Photometric stereo that survives shadows and highlights. → (normals, albedo, inliers).

ops.name: polarization_dolp_map
ops.summary: Degree of linear polarisation, per pixel. → (H, W) in [0, 1].

ops.name: polarization_render
ops.summary: Forward model of a polariser sweep: turn a known split into the frames a polarisation camera would record. → (N, H, W).

ops.name: polarization_separate
ops.summary: Split a polariser sweep into its unpolarised and linearly polarised radiance. → (diffuse, specular), both (H, W).

ops.name: polarization_stokes
ops.summary: The scene-integrated Stokes vector of a polariser sweep. → (4,), ready for :func:`optics.stokes_analyze`.

ops.name: polarization_stokes_map
ops.summary: Per-pixel linear Stokes images with DoLP and AoLP maps from an analyser sweep (4 DoFP angles or any N >= 3, least squares). → dict of (H, W) maps.

ops.name: slope_to_curvature
ops.summary: Normal map (H, W, 3) → a curvature map (H, W). One derivative of the slopes, no integration to height.

ops.name: specular_coefficient_map
ops.summary: The scalar interface (specular) coefficient of the dichromatic model. → (H, W).

ops.name: specular_diffuse_split
ops.summary: Split a linear-RGB image into its diffuse (body) and specular (interface) parts. → (diffuse, specular), both (H, W, 3).

ops.name: specular_free_transform
ops.summary: Project out the illuminant direction: the part of the image a highlight cannot touch. → (H, W, 3).

ops.name: barcode_scan_profiles
ops.summary: Extract ``n_lines`` parallel scan lines perpendicular to the bars from an image (`table`).

ops.name: capture_degrade
ops.summary: Apply capture degradation (illumination, blur, sensor noise) to a reflectance image (`image2d`).

ops.name: decode_barcode_profile
ops.summary: Decode one symbol from a single scan line (a 1-D reflectance profile) (`table`).

ops.name: dm_decode_modules
ops.summary: Decode a Data Matrix module grid (with L finder and clock track, 0/1) and return the corrected codewords (`table`).

ops.name: dm_encode
ops.summary: Encode a string into a Data Matrix ECC200 module grid and its module-to-codeword map (`table`).

ops.name: dm_locate
ops.summary: Find a Data Matrix in an image and estimate the module-space to image homography (`table`).

ops.name: dm_read
ops.summary: Read a Data Matrix from an image: locate, sample, decode, and retry with inverted contrast (`table`).

ops.name: dm_sample
ops.summary: Sample the reflectance at Data Matrix module centres by bilinear interpolation and binarise with a global threshold (`table`).

ops.name: ean_check_digit
ops.summary: EAN/UPC check digit (weights 3, 1, 3, … from the rightmost digit, sum to a multiple of 10).

ops.name: encode_barcode1d
ops.summary: Encode a string into the element widths (in modules) of a 1-D bar code (`table`).

ops.name: grade_barcode1d
ops.summary: Return the print-quality grade of a 1-D symbol in an image (mean over ``n_scans`` scan lines) (`table`).

ops.name: grade_barcode_profile
ops.summary: Return the print-quality parameters and grades of one scan line (a 1-D reflectance profile) (`table`).

ops.name: grade_datacode2d
ops.summary: Return the print-quality grade of a 2-D symbol (QR / Data Matrix) in an image (`table`).

ops.name: ocr_classify
ops.summary: Classify feature vectors by k nearest neighbours and reject by distance and distance ratio (`table`).

ops.name: ocr_features
ops.summary: Build the 88-D feature vector (zoning densities + projections) from the ink map of one glyph (`signal`).

ops.name: ocr_font
ops.summary: Return the charset and glyph designs of a built-in font (5x7 dot matrix / stroke) (`table`).

ops.name: ocr_read_line
ops.summary: Read one text line in an image: segment + classify, rejected characters become ``?`` (`table`).

ops.name: ocr_read_trials
ops.summary: Capture a printed string ``trials`` times at each degradation level, read it by OCR and return one row per attempt (`table`).

ops.name: ocr_render_text
ops.summary: Render a string with a built-in font and return it with the true bounding box of each character (`table`).

ops.name: ocr_score
ops.summary: Score a reading against the truth by Levenshtein alignment, counting misreads and rejects separately (`table`).

ops.name: ocr_segment_line
ops.summary: Segment one text line into a bounding box per character (`table`).

ops.name: ocr_train
ops.summary: Render the font under nuisance variations and collect templates (features + labels) and the rejection thresholds (`table`).

ops.name: qr_decode_modules
ops.summary: Decode a QR module grid (no quiet zone, 1 = dark) and return the corrected codewords per block (`table`).

ops.name: qr_encode
ops.summary: Encode a string into a QR Code (Model 2) module grid and its module-to-codeword map (`table`).

ops.name: qr_locate
ops.summary: Find a QR Code in an image and estimate the module-space to image homography (`table`).

ops.name: qr_read
ops.summary: Read a QR Code from an image: locate, sample, decode, and retry on the inverted image (`table`).

ops.name: qr_sample
ops.summary: Sample the reflectance at QR module centres by bilinear interpolation and binarise with a global threshold (`table`).

ops.name: read_barcode1d
ops.summary: Read a 1-D bar code from an image (`table`).

ops.name: read_symbols_zxing
ops.summary: Read every symbol (1-D / 2-D) in an image with zxing-cpp (`table`).

ops.name: render_symbol
ops.summary: Render a symbol (1-D widths or a 2-D module grid) as the reflectance image of a plane (`image2d`).

ops.name: symbol_read
ops.summary: Read an image with the chosen reader and return ``{"ok", "text", "error"}`` (`table`).

ops.name: symbol_read_pod
ops.summary: From a table of read trials, return the POD (hit = the true string was read) and the misread upper bound (`table`).

ops.name: symbol_read_trials
ops.summary: Capture and read the symbol ``trials`` times at each degradation level and return one row per attempt (`table`).

ops.name: swt_map
ops.summary: Stroke Width Transform — writes, at every pixel, the width of the stroke that contains it.

ops.name: text_candidates
ops.summary: Narrows the connected components of the SWT down to character candidates (width spread, aspect ratio, size).

ops.name: text_lines
ops.summary: Groups character-candidate boxes into lines (vertically overlapping, horizontally close, similar stroke width).

ops.name: backproject_sinogram
ops.summary: Plain, **un-filtered** back-projection — the blurred baseline.

ops.name: basis_decomposition_crlb
ops.summary: Return in closed form the lower bound (Cramér–Rao) on the variance of the decomposition at basis thicknesses b.

ops.name: basis_material_decompose
