ops.summary: Channel signals → thickness maps of the basis materials (Alvarez–Macovski / Lehmann basis decomposition).

ops.name: beam_hardening_apply
ops.summary: Turn a monochromatic sinogram into a **polychromatic** one — cupping.

ops.name: beam_hardening_correct
ops.summary: Undo cupping — either the exact model inverse, or a calibrated polynomial.

ops.name: dual_energy_separability
ops.summary: How well two materials (thicknesses) can be told apart by the channels' log attenuations (closed-form d′ and error rate).

ops.name: dual_kvp_channels
ops.summary: The two channels of an energy-integrating (scintillator) detector imaged at two tube voltages.

ops.name: effective_z_map
ops.summary: Estimate an effective-atomic-number image from dual-energy images (R matched against the curves of the elements).

ops.name: ellipse_phantom
ops.summary: Rasterise a sum of uniform ellipses onto a *size* x *size* slice.

ops.name: ellipse_sinogram
ops.summary: The **closed-form** Radon transform of a sum of uniform ellipses.

ops.name: fbp_volume
ops.summary: Reconstruct every sinogram of a ``(Z, A, D)`` stack -> a ``(Z, S, S)`` volume.

ops.name: filtered_backprojection
ops.summary: Filtered back-projection (FBP) — the standard CT reconstruction.

ops.name: material_effective_z
ops.summary: Return the effective atomic number (Mayneord / Spiers power law) and the electron density from the composition.

ops.name: material_xray_attenuation
ops.summary: Return a material's X-ray attenuation as ``pairs`` (E [keV], value); the mass attenuation coefficient μ/ρ [cm²/g] by default.

ops.name: material_xray_constants
ops.summary: Return the X-ray constants at one energy (μ/ρ, μ_en/ρ, μ, half-value layer, mean free path) with their source.

ops.name: material_xray_table
ops.summary: List the materials whose X-ray column (mass attenuation coefficient μ/ρ) can be looked up.

ops.name: metal_trace_interpolate
ops.summary: Linear-interpolation metal artefact reduction (LI-MAR).

ops.name: photon_counting_channels
ops.summary: Energy windows of a photon-counting detector → channels (one count per photon).

ops.name: projection_angles
ops.summary: The angle sequence of a scan, in **degrees**, as a 1-D float64 array.

ops.name: r_value_map
ops.summary: Return the image of R = L_low / L_high (ratio of low- to high-energy log attenuation).

ops.name: radon_transform
ops.summary: Forward parallel-beam projection: a slice in, a **sinogram** out.

ops.name: radon_volume
ops.summary: Project every slice of a ``(Z, H, W)`` volume -> a ``(Z, A, D)`` stack.

ops.name: ring_artifact_apply
ops.summary: Give the detector a per-bin gain error — the source of ring artefacts.

ops.name: ring_artifact_remove
ops.summary: Remove per-detector-bin offsets by flattening the angle-averaged profile.

ops.name: sart_reconstruct
ops.summary: SART — simultaneous algebraic reconstruction, one angle at a time.

ops.name: scintillator_sensor_qe
ops.summary: Quantum efficiency of a scintillator-coupled sensor: one X-ray photon → absorption in the scintillator → light emission → electrons in the photodetector.

ops.name: sinogram_center_of_rotation
ops.summary: Where the axis of rotation actually is, in detector bins from the centre.

ops.name: sinogram_center_shift
ops.summary: Re-centre a sinogram on its axis of rotation.

ops.name: sinogram_design
ops.summary: What a scan geometry can and cannot resolve — **before** anything is built.

ops.name: xray_beam_quality
ops.summary: Beam quality of a spectrum: first and second half-value layers, homogeneity coefficient, mean energy and effective energy.

ops.name: xray_channel_projection
ops.summary: Thickness map per material → an image of the signal in each channel (C, H, W).

ops.name: xray_tube_spectrum
ops.summary: Return the photon spectrum of an X-ray tube as ``pairs`` (E [keV], photons / keV), normalised to Σ φ ΔE = 1.

ops.name: video_cube_cut
ops.summary: One cross-section of the cube (``image2d``). ``"xt"`` = slit scan of row ``position`` (T, W), ``"yt"`` = (T, H) of a column, ``"xy"`` = the frame at time ``position`` (H, W). ``position`` is a fraction in [0, 1] (what fr

ops.name: video_cube_orbit
ops.summary: Color video rotating the cube ``(n_frames, size, size, 3)`` float [0, 1] (``rgbvideo``).

ops.name: video_spacetime_cube
ops.summary: Turns a video (T, H, W) into a space × time cube ``(T, H, W)`` float [0, 1] (``voxel``).

ops.name: video_summary_keyframes
ops.summary: Indices of representative frames ``(k,)`` int64, ascending (``indices``).

ops.name: video_write_gif
ops.summary: Writes a frame sequence to an animated GIF (``text`` = the path written). A reusable exit point.

ops.name: vol_render_transfer
ops.summary: Renders the cube from an arbitrary viewpoint by **front-to-back α compositing** ``(size, size, 3)`` float [0, 1] (``rgb``).

ops.name: background_subtraction_window
ops.summary: Causal window-median background → per-frame 0/1 foreground masks ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: deflicker
ops.summary: Luminance deflicker per frame → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: exponential_background
ops.summary: Recursive background ``bg ← (1−α)·bg + α·frame`` per frame → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: exponential_foreground
ops.summary: Foreground masks ``|frame − exponential background| > threshold`` → 0/1 ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: frame_difference_causal
ops.summary: ``|frame t − frame t−1|`` with a zero first frame → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: motion_energy_image
ops.summary: Bobick–Davis Motion Energy Image per frame → 0/1 ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: motion_history_image
ops.summary: Bobick–Davis Motion History Image per frame → ``(T, H, W)`` in ``[0, 1]`` (``video``).

ops.name: moving_average_window
ops.summary: Causal per-pixel mean over the last *window* frames → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: optical_flow_magnitude_stream
ops.summary: Per-frame dense flow speed against the previous frame → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: running_gaussian_background
ops.summary: Adaptive single-Gaussian background (the running mean) per frame → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: running_gaussian_foreground
ops.summary: Adaptive single-Gaussian foreground masks per frame → 0/1 ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: running_mean_std
ops.summary: Welford per-pixel mean / population std over the clip → ``{"mean", "std", "n"}`` (``table``).

ops.name: scene_cut_detection
ops.summary: Shot-boundary chi-square histogram distance over a clip → ``{"distance", "cut", "n"}`` (``table``).

ops.name: temporal_bilateral
ops.summary: Causal temporal bilateral denoise per frame → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: temporal_median_window
ops.summary: Causal per-pixel median over the last *window* frames → ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: three_frame_difference
ops.summary: Collins three-frame-difference motion mask per frame → 0/1 ``(T, H, W)`` (``video``).

ops.name: vol_colorize_labels
ops.summary: 3-D label volume -> an RGB volume, ``(D, H, W, 3)`` float64.

ops.name: vol_label_color_flicker
ops.summary: **Count** the difference between "segment then colour" and "colour then segment".

ops.name: vol_label_legend
ops.summary: A legend table: which colour is which component, and what its measurements are.

ops.name: vol_label_mpr_rgb
ops.summary: The three orthogonal cuts of a coloured volume, laid out as **one RGB image**.

ops.name: vol_label_overlay
ops.summary: The original grey volume with coloured labels laid over it, as ``(D, H, W, 3)``.

ops.name: vol_label_palette
ops.summary: An RGB palette for labels ``0..n_labels``: ``(n_labels + 1, 3)`` float64.

ops.name: vol_label_shape_stats
ops.summary: Per-component quantities that can be had in **linear time** (volume, centroid, box, PCA shape indices).

ops.name: vol_label_slice_rgb
ops.summary: Take one RGB cross-section out of a coloured volume (axial / coronal / sagittal).

ops.name: vol_label_volume_render
ops.summary: A **composited projection** of the coloured labels, ``(H, W, 3)``, built with numpy alone.

ops.name: vol_labels_to_meshes
ops.summary: Run marching cubes per component, giving a **set of coloured meshes**.

ops.name: vol_select_labels
ops.summary: Sieve components by 3-D features (the 3-D counterpart of 2-D blob selection).

ops.name: vx_histogram
ops.summary: Histogram (Section 3.26): a pixel value I goes into the bin ``i = (I − offset) × numBins / range`` (offset ≤ I < offset + range, REQ-0230). Pixels outside the range are not counted. The bin is determined by integer divis

ops.name: vx_magnitude
ops.summary: Gradient magnitude (Section 3.31). The conceptual definition of REQ-0270 as is: ``z = uint16(sqrt(double(uint32(x·x) + uint32(y·y))) + 0.5)``, ``mag = z > 32767 ? 32767 : z``. Both input and output are S16.

ops.name: vx_nonlinear_filter
ops.summary: Nonlinear filter (Section 3.38): median / minimum (erosion) / maximum (dilation) of the values of the pixels where the mask is true (REQ-0325, 0330).

ops.name: vx_nonmax_suppression
ops.summary: Non-maximum suppression (Section 3.39). A pixel (x, y) survives only if, within the window, it is **≥ its preceding neighbors (the row above and the left in the same row) and > its following neighbors** (REQ-0337). This

ops.name: vx_phase
ops.summary: Gradient phase (Section 3.41): shifts ϕ = atan2(gy, gx) into 0 ≤ ϕ < 2π and maps it to 0–255 (REQ-0364). Output U8.

ops.name: vx_remap
ops.summary: remap (Section 3.44): output (x, y) = input (map_x[y, x], map_y[y, x]) (REQ-0392). The tables have the shape of the output; in the coordinates, input pixel centers are at integers.

ops.name: vx_table_lookup
ops.summary: Table lookup (Section 3.47): output = table[pixel value + offset] (REQ-0421). Accepts U8 and S16 (REQ-0422). The output dtype is the table's dtype.

ops.name: vx_warp_affine
ops.summary: Affine transform (Section 3.56). **Inverse mapping**: output pixel (x, y) is taken from input (x0, y0) (REQ-0498): ``x0 = M[0,0]·x + M[0,1]·y + M[0,2]``, ``y0 = M[1,0]·x + M[1,1]·y + M[1,2]``.

ops.name: vx_warp_perspective
ops.summary: Perspective transform (Section 3.57). Inverse mapping: ``x0 = M[0]·(x, y, 1)``, ``y0 = M[1]·(x, y, 1)``, ``z0 = M[2]·(x, y, 1)``, output (x, y) = input (x0/z0, y0/z0) (REQ-0508). Pixels with z0 = 0 are filled as outside.
